modules.title: Unit 1: Life Plans: Present Tenses for Future & Ambitions
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan present tenses dan future tenses untuk membicarakan rencana hidup, ambisi, dan perubahan kebiasaan dengan percaya diri

theory.summary: Unit ini mengulas penggunaan present tenses (simple, continuous, perfect, perfect continuous) dan future tenses untuk membicarakan fakta, kebiasaan, rencana, dan prediksi. Kamu akan belajar kapan menggunakan setiap tense dengan tepat, terutama saat membahas ambisi dan perubahan hidup.
rules: Present Simple: Untuk fakta dan opini. Contoh: 'I'm not feeling any fitter' (fakta saat ini)
Present Continuous: Untuk aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung atau keluhan. Contoh: 'I'm still sitting here writing this article' (sedang berlangsung), 'My dad's always telling me what to do' (keluhan)
Present Perfect: Untuk aksi masa lalu yang tidak disebutkan waktunya. Contoh: 'I've started going to the gym' (sudah dimulai, waktu tidak penting)
Present Perfect Continuous: Untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut. Contoh: 'I've been trying to get fitter for four weeks now' (dimulai 4 minggu lalu, masih berlanjut)
Future dengan 'be going to': Untuk rencana dan prediksi berdasarkan bukti. Contoh: 'I'm going to meet the careers advisor' (rencana)
Future dengan 'will': Untuk prediksi umum dan keputusan spontan. Contoh: 'Argentina will win the next World Cup' (prediksi)
Present Continuous untuk future: Untuk pengaturan/arrangement yang sudah fix. Contoh: 'I'm seeing the dentist tomorrow' (sudah ada janji)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Will untuk Rencana yang Sudah Pasti
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'will' untuk semua hal di masa depan. Padahal, jika sudah ada rencana atau pengaturan konkret, gunakan 'be going to' atau present continuous, bukan 'will'.
commonTrap.wrong: I will meet my friend tomorrow at 3pm (salah jika sudah ada janji pasti)
commonTrap.correct: I'm meeting my friend tomorrow at 3pm (benar untuk arrangement yang sudah fix)

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk menyatakan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga saat ini?
options: I have been working on this project for two weeks.
I have worked on this project for two weeks.
I work on this project for two weeks.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous (have been working) digunakan untuk menekankan aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung hingga sekarang.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk menyatakan rencana yang sudah pasti (fixed arrangement) di masa depan?
options: I will see the dentist tomorrow at 10 AM.
I am seeing the dentist tomorrow at 10 AM.
I see the dentist tomorrow at 10 AM.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Untuk rencana yang sudah pasti (fixed arrangement), gunakan Present Continuous (I am seeing), bukan 'will' yang biasanya digunakan untuk prediksi atau keputusan spontan.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Mia ingin menyatakan rencananya untuk berhenti les biola. Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat secara tata bahasa?
options: I'm going to give up the violin lessons.
I will giving up the violin lessons.
I am give up the violin lessons.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Be going to' digunakan untuk menyatakan rencana. Pilihan lain salah secara tata bahasa karena penggunaan kata kerja yang tidak tepat setelah 'will' atau 'am'.

vocab.collocation: I made a resolution to be more efficient this year.
Many kids are struggling with their New Year resolutions.
Others have already given up for this year.
It's difficult to break bad habits.
It takes ten weeks to form a good habit.
He decided to settle down and start a family.
He got promoted and became a translator.
He wants to retire soon and travel the world.

dialogue.context: Mia adalah siswi yang sangat sibuk dengan berbagai kegiatan ekstrakurikuler. Dia sedang berbicara dengan teman-temannya di kafe tentang kesibukannya.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: So what's up, Mia? Why are you so busy?
lines.translation: Jadi ada apa, Mia? Kenapa kamu sangat sibuk?

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Where shall I start? Mondays, I have extra French lessons. Tuesdays, it's tennis lessons. Wednesdays, violin lessons. Thursdays, it's orchestra.
lines.translation: Dari mana harus mulai? Senin, aku les Perancis tambahan. Selasa, les tenis. Rabu, les violin. Kamis, latihan orkestra.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Don't you like playing the violin?
lines.translation: Kamu tidak suka main violin?

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Not really. I mean, I like playing an instrument. I just don't think I want to continue with the violin.
lines.translation: Tidak terlalu. Maksudku, aku suka main alat musik. Tapi aku rasa aku tidak mau lanjut dengan violin.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: You should talk to her, tell her you want to give it up.
lines.translation: Kamu harus bicara padanya, bilang kalau kamu mau berhenti.

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: You don't have any time for yourself. I mean, we never get to see you any more.
lines.translation: Kamu tidak punya waktu untuk diri sendiri. Maksudku, kami tidak pernah bertemu kamu lagi.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang konsultasi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang rencana masa depanmu setelah lulus. Dia ingin tahu ambisi dan rencana konkretmu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! So, tell me about your plans for the future. What are you hoping to do after you finish school?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm planning to study engineering at university. I've always been interested in how things work.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds great! Have you already applied to any universities? What are you doing to prepare?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm applying to three universities this month. I've been studying hard for my exams and I'm also taking extra maths classes.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! And what about five years from now? Where do you see yourself? What will you be doing?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: In five years, I think I'll be working for a technology company. I'm going to gain experience and maybe start my own business one day.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful ambition! One last question - are you making any changes to your habits now to help you reach these goals?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I've stopped playing computer games on weekdays and I'm trying to organize my time better. I've also started reading more about technology and innovation.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses present perfect continuous?
options: I try to get fitter for four weeks now.
I've been trying to get fitter for four weeks now.
I'm trying to get fitter for four weeks now.
quiz.answer: I've been trying to get fitter for four weeks now.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect continuous (have/has been + -ing) digunakan untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut sampai sekarang. 'For four weeks' menunjukkan durasi yang berlanjut.

quiz.question: Complete: 'It's 2 am and I _____ in bed, but I can't sleep.'
quiz.explanation: Present continuous ('m lying) digunakan karena aksi sedang berlangsung saat ini (it's 2 am = sekarang).

quiz.question: Which future form is correct for a fixed arrangement? 'I _____ the dentist tomorrow at 10am.'
quiz.explanation: Present continuous digunakan untuk arrangement/pengaturan yang sudah fix di masa depan, terutama dengan waktu yang spesifik (tomorrow at 10am).

quiz.question: What does 'give something up' mean?
quiz.explanation: 'Give up' berarti berhenti melakukan sesuatu, biasanya sesuatu yang sudah dilakukan untuk waktu yang lama. Contoh: give up smoking, give up chocolate.

quiz.question: Complete with the correct tense: 'I _____ to the gym. I've taken up karate lessons.'
quiz.explanation: Present perfect ('ve started going) digunakan untuk aksi yang baru dimulai di masa lalu tanpa menyebutkan waktu spesifik, dan relevan dengan situasi sekarang.

quiz.question: Which sentence shows a prediction based on opinion (not evidence)?
options: It's going to rain - look at those dark clouds!
Argentina will win the next World Cup.
quiz.answer: Argentina will win the next World Cup.
quiz.explanation: 'Will' digunakan untuk prediksi umum berdasarkan opini atau kepercayaan. 'Be going to' digunakan untuk prediksi berdasarkan bukti yang terlihat.

modules.title: Unit 2: Hard Times: Past Simple & Past Continuous
modules.objective: Mampu menceritakan peristiwa masa lampau dengan menggunakan Past Simple dan Past Continuous secara tepat, serta memahami penggunaan 'would' dan 'used to' untuk menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lalu.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara menceritakan peristiwa di masa lampau menggunakan narrative tenses (Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect, dan Past Perfect Continuous). Kamu juga akan belajar menggunakan 'would' dan 'used to' untuk menggambarkan kebiasaan atau keadaan yang dulu rutin terjadi namun sekarang tidak lagi.
rules: Past Simple: untuk aksi yang selesai di masa lampau. Contoh: 'The fire started in a bakery.'
Past Continuous: untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lampau, sering terganggu oleh aksi lain. Contoh: 'Thomas Farmer was making bread when a fire broke out.'
Past Perfect: untuk aksi yang terjadi sebelum aksi lain di masa lampau. Contoh: 'It hadn't rained for months.'
Past Perfect Continuous: untuk aksi yang berlangsung lama sebelum waktu tertentu di masa lampau. Contoh: 'The fire had been raging for almost four days.'
Used to + infinitive: untuk kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lampau (bisa dengan action verb atau stative verb). Contoh: 'Women used to have seven or eight children.'
Would + infinitive: untuk kebiasaan di masa lampau (hanya dengan action verb). Contoh: 'Children would play with teddy bears.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampurkan 'used to' dan 'would'
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'would' untuk semua jenis kebiasaan masa lampau, padahal 'would' hanya bisa dipakai untuk action verbs. Stative verbs (seperti 'be', 'have', 'know') harus menggunakan 'used to'.
commonTrap.wrong: I would be shy when I was young.
commonTrap.correct: I used to be shy when I was young.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan tenses masa lampau dengan tepat untuk menggambarkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung dan terganggu oleh aksi lain.
options: While I was cooking dinner, the phone rang.
While I cooked dinner, the phone was ringing.
I was cooking dinner when the phone was ringing.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Past Continuous (was cooking) digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung, dan Past Simple (rang) digunakan untuk aksi yang menginterupsi.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar untuk menyatakan keadaan di masa lalu? Ingat aturan penggunaan 'would' dan 'used to'.
options: I would be shy when I was a teenager.
I used to be shy when I was a teenager.
I would have a dog when I was a child.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Be' dan 'have' adalah stative verbs, sehingga harus menggunakan 'used to', bukan 'would'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut berdasarkan konteks durasi aksi di masa lampau: 'I [...] for hours before the rescue team finally arrived.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous (had been waiting) digunakan untuk menekankan durasi aksi yang berlangsung sebelum waktu tertentu di masa lampau.

vocab.collocation: The fire had been raging for almost four days.
His soldiers demolished a large warehouse full of paper.
Many people were trying to flee from the flames with their possessions.
A simple house was often home to many families as well as lodgers.
As the catastrophe struck, people panicked.
The Inuit who make a living from keeping and breeding reindeer have to be constantly on the move.
The fire spread quickly but it was also extremely difficult to fight.
Thousands of inhabitants were left homeless.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Ian dan Oli tentang pengalaman menakutkan Ian kemarin ketika melihat asap dari jendela rumahnya

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.text: I had a real scare yesterday. As I was walking up to our house, I saw smoke coming from the window.
lines.translation: Aku sangat ketakutan kemarin. Saat aku sedang berjalan menuju rumah, aku melihat asap keluar dari jendela.

lines.speaker: Oli
lines.text: Oh no! Was something burning?
lines.translation: Oh tidak! Apakah ada yang terbakar?

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.text: Fortunately not. I ran into the house, opened the kitchen door and there was my brother. He was doing science experiments! One of them went wrong and exploded.
lines.translation: Untungnya tidak. Aku berlari masuk ke rumah, membuka pintu dapur dan di sana ada kakakku. Dia sedang melakukan eksperimen sains! Salah satunya gagal dan meledak.

lines.speaker: Oli
lines.text: That must have been terrifying at first!
lines.translation: Pasti menakutkan pada awalnya!

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor tentang pengalaman masa kecil dan kebiasaan di masa lampau

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about your childhood. What kinds of games did you use to play when you were younger?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: When I was a child, I used to play traditional games with my friends in the neighborhood.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds lovely! Can you tell me more? What would you and your friends do after school?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: After school, we would meet at the park and play hide-and-seek or fly kites together until sunset.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful memories! Did you use to have any pets when you were growing up?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I used to have a cat. I would feed it every morning before going to school.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of 'used to' and 'would'! Tell me, what was family life like in your house back then?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My parents used to be very strict. We would eat dinner together every evening, and they would always ask about our day at school.

quiz.question: While people ____ towards the river, a warehouse ____ and blocked their escape.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous ('were running') menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung, kemudian Past Simple ('exploded') untuk aksi yang tiba-tiba terjadi dan menginterupsi.

quiz.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I would have a cat when I was young.
I used to have a cat when I was young.
I would to have a cat when I was young.
quiz.answer: I used to have a cat when I was young.
quiz.explanation: 'Have' adalah stative verb, jadi harus menggunakan 'used to', bukan 'would'.

quiz.question: The fire ____ for months before it finally started in September 1666.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect ('hadn't rained') digunakan untuk menunjukkan kondisi yang terjadi sebelum peristiwa di masa lampau (kebakaran).

quiz.question: Children ____ play with teddy bears in the 1950s. These days, many children have electronic games.
quiz.explanation: 'Would' digunakan untuk kebiasaan di masa lampau dengan action verb ('play'). Konteks menunjukkan perbandingan antara dulu dan sekarang.

quiz.question: When the fire broke out, Thomas Farmer and his workers ____ bread for the coming day.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous ('were making') menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung ketika aksi lain (kebakaran) terjadi.

quiz.question: Which is the correct sentence about past habits?
options: Parents would use to sing songs to their children.
Parents didn't use to sing songs to their children.
Parents weren't use to sing songs to their children.
quiz.answer: Parents didn't use to sing songs to their children.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk negatif 'used to' adalah 'didn't use to' (tanpa 'd' di 'use'). Opsi pertama salah karena mencampur 'would' dan 'use to'.

modules.title: Unit 3: What's in a Name?: Present Perfect with Already & Yet
modules.objective: Mampu memberikan nasihat, mengungkapkan kewajiban, dan memberikan larangan menggunakan modal verbs (have to, ought to, should, must, had better, can't). Memahami dan menggunakan ekspresi idiomatik terkait 'name' dalam konteks komunikasi sehari-hari.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan modal verbs untuk memberikan nasihat dan mengungkapkan kewajiban. Modal verbs seperti 'should', 'ought to', 'must', 'have to', dan 'had better' digunakan untuk menyampaikan tingkat kepentingan yang berbeda. Selain itu, unit ini juga mengajarkan berbagai ekspresi idiomatik yang menggunakan kata 'name' dalam konteks brand, identitas, dan komunikasi.
rules: Menggunakan 'have to' / 'don't have to' untuk kewajiban: You have to give the product a name. (Kamu harus memberi nama produk itu.) / You don't have to use a family name. (Kamu tidak harus menggunakan nama keluarga.)

Menggunakan 'should' / 'shouldn't' untuk saran: You should choose a name that might not work in certain countries. (Kamu seharusnya memilih nama yang mungkin tidak berhasil di negara tertentu.) / You shouldn't choose a name carelessly. (Kamu seharusnya tidak memilih nama sembarangan.)
Menggunakan 'ought to' untuk saran (lebih formal): A brand name ought to be unique, memorable and easy to understand. (Sebuah nama brand seharusnya unik, mudah diingat, dan mudah dipahami.)

Menggunakan 'must' / 'mustn't' untuk kewajiban kuat atau larangan: You must give the product a name. (Kamu harus memberi nama produk.) / You mustn't call a child Number 16 Bus Shelter. (Kamu tidak boleh memanggil anak dengan nama Number 16 Bus Shelter.)
Menggunakan 'had better (not)' untuk peringatan: You'd better get some help quickly! (Kamu sebaiknya cepat minta tolong!) / You'd better not do that again! (Kamu sebaiknya tidak melakukan itu lagi!)

Menggunakan 'can't' / 'mustn't' untuk larangan: You can't call your twins Fish and Chips. (Kamu tidak boleh memanggil kembarmu Fish and Chips.) / A name mustn't make a fool of the child. (Sebuah nama tidak boleh membuat anak menjadi bahan olok-olokan.)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Membedakan Must dan Have To
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung antara 'must' dan 'have to'. 'Must' lebih subjektif dan berasal dari pembicara, sedangkan 'have to' lebih objektif dan berasal dari aturan eksternal. Untuk bentuk negatif, 'mustn't' = larangan keras, sedangkan 'don't have to' = tidak wajib (boleh tidak).
commonTrap.wrong: You mustn't buy another phone. (Maksudnya: tidak wajib, tapi terdengar seperti larangan)
commonTrap.correct: You don't have to buy another phone. (Kamu tidak harus membeli ponsel lain - boleh tidak beli.)

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan modal verb untuk memberikan saran dengan struktur yang tepat.
options: A brand name ought to be unique and easy to understand.
A brand name ought be unique and easy to understand.
A brand name ought to being unique and easy to understand.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur 'ought to' selalu diikuti oleh bentuk dasar kata kerja (bare infinitive). Pilihan kedua salah karena kurang 'to', dan pilihan ketiga salah karena menggunakan gerund.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang tepat untuk menyatakan bahwa seseorang tidak memiliki kewajiban untuk melakukan sesuatu (bukan larangan)?
options: You mustn't finish the report today; it is optional.
You don't have to finish the report today; it is optional.
You can't finish the report today; it is optional.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Don't have to' digunakan untuk menyatakan tidak ada kewajiban (boleh tidak melakukan). 'Mustn't' dan 'can't' digunakan untuk menyatakan larangan keras.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut: 'The current brand name is too long and confusing. We [...] change it if we want to attract more customers.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam konteks ini, perubahan nama diperlukan untuk menarik pelanggan, sehingga 'must' (kewajiban kuat) adalah pilihan yang paling tepat secara logis untuk menunjukkan urgensi.

vocab.collocation: The brand name is the thing that distinguishes your product from all the others.
What does the manufacturer's product say about them?
That shop has a really funny advertisement on TV.
Teenage consumers are perhaps more concerned with brand names and company logos than any other group.
Teenagers want to have the name and/or logo visible when they wear clothes.
It's a chain that has shops in every town.
Tony Hawk is a big name in skateboarding.
She made a name for herself as a great actor.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara ibu dan anak tentang ponsel baru di sekolah dan tekanan peer untuk membeli produk bermerek

lines.speaker: Mandy
lines.text: Mum, there's a new mobile phone out. It's brilliant. I must get one!
lines.translation: Bu, ada ponsel baru keluar. Bagus banget. Aku harus beli satu!

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: No way! Your mobile phone is fine. You don't have to buy another one.
lines.translation: Tidak mungkin! Ponselmu masih bagus. Kamu tidak harus beli yang baru.

lines.speaker: Mandy
lines.text: But you know what it's like at school. Everyone has to have the latest product!
lines.translation: Tapi Ibu tahu kan seperti apa di sekolah. Semua orang harus punya produk terbaru!

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Yes, and it's terrible. Why must you all wear the same clothes, for example?
lines.translation: Iya, dan itu mengerikan. Kenapa kalian semua harus pakai baju yang sama, misalnya?

lines.speaker: Mandy
lines.text: Because it's what teenagers do. You were young once. Don't you remember?
lines.translation: Karena memang begitu yang dilakukan remaja. Ibu dulu juga muda. Tidak ingat?

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: I see. And I suppose I have to go to work to pay for all these things, right?
lines.translation: Oh begitu. Dan sepertinya aku harus kerja untuk bayar semua ini, kan?

lines.speaker: Mandy
lines.text: Oh, Mum! You mustn't be difficult!
lines.translation: Ah, Bu! Ibu jangan sulit begitu!

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor tentang pengalaman membeli produk bermerek dan pendapat tentang brand names

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi! Let's talk about brand names today. Can you tell me about a time when you bought something just because of the brand? What was it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, I once bought Nike shoes even though they were more expensive, because everyone at school wore them.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! Do you think brand names are really that important? Why do you think teenagers care so much about them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think teenagers care about brand names because they want to fit in with their friends and feel accepted.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good point. Now, imagine you're giving advice to someone who always buys expensive branded products. What would you say using 'should' or 'had better'?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You shouldn't always buy expensive brands. You'd better save your money for more important things.

quiz.question: First of all, you _____ give the product a name.
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan 'must' karena ini adalah kewajiban yang kuat - memberi nama produk adalah hal yang wajib dilakukan.

quiz.question: Companies _____ get it right first time.
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan 'have to' untuk menunjukkan kewajiban eksternal - perusahaan wajib melakukannya dengan benar dari awal karena sangat penting dan sulit diubah.

quiz.question: You _____ choose a name that might not work in certain countries or cultures.
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan 'shouldn't' untuk memberikan saran agar tidak memilih nama yang mungkin tidak cocok di negara atau budaya tertentu.

quiz.question: You _____ call a child Number 16 Bus Shelter. Generally, certain names aren't allowed.
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan 'can't' atau 'mustn't' karena ini adalah larangan - pemerintah tidak mengizinkan nama-nama tertentu untuk anak.

quiz.question: The bus goes in two minutes. You _____ run!
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan 'had better' untuk memberikan peringatan atau nasihat kuat - jika tidak lari, akan kehilangan bus.

quiz.question: You _____ eat any more sweets. You'll be sick.
quiz.explanation: Menggunakan 'had better not' untuk memperingatkan konsekuensi buruk jika terus makan permen - akan sakit.

modules.title: Unit 4: Dilemmas: First & Second Conditional
modules.objective: Mampu membicarakan situasi hipotetis, mengungkapkan keinginan, meminta maaf dan menerima permintaan maaf menggunakan first, second, dan third conditional dengan tepat

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan conditional sentences untuk membicarakan berbagai situasi. First conditional digunakan untuk situasi nyata dan kemungkinan yang bisa terjadi di masa depan. Second conditional untuk situasi hipotetis atau tidak mungkin terjadi di masa sekarang/depan. Third conditional untuk membicarakan situasi masa lalu yang tidak terjadi dan membayangkan hasil yang berbeda.
rules: First Conditional: If + present simple, will + verb (future clause). Contoh: If you always tell the truth, people will trust you.
Second Conditional: If + past simple, would + verb. Contoh: What would you do if you found £100 in a cash machine?
Third Conditional: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + past participle. Contoh: If Billy had looked up, he would have seen a young lady.
Wish + if only: Gunakan 'I wish / if only + past tense' untuk menyatakan keinginan situasi sekarang berbeda. Contoh: I wish I could kill Lord Voldemort.
Time conjunctions: unless, if, until, when, as soon as. Contoh: I won't tell him anything unless he asks.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan 'will' di Klausa 'if'
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menggunakan 'will' setelah 'if' dalam first conditional. Padahal setelah 'if' harus menggunakan present simple, bukan will.
commonTrap.wrong: If you will always tell the truth, people will trust you.
commonTrap.correct: If you always tell the truth, people will trust you.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan Second Conditional dengan benar untuk situasi hipotetis.
options: If I have a million dollars, I would travel the world.
If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
If I had a million dollars, I will travel the world.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Second conditional menggunakan 'if + past simple' (had) dan 'would + verb' (would travel) untuk situasi hipotetis.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar sesuai aturan First Conditional (menghindari kesalahan umum 'will' di klausa 'if')?
options: If you tell the truth, you will feel much better.
If you will tell the truth, you will feel much better.
If you told the truth, you will feel much better.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam First Conditional, klausa 'if' harus menggunakan present simple (tell), bukan 'will'. 'Will' hanya digunakan di klausa utama.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Berdasarkan dialog tentang mencontek, jika kamu ingin memberikan saran menggunakan First Conditional, manakah kalimat yang tepat untuk melengkapi: 'If you don't tell the teacher the truth, [...]'
options: you would have regretted it later.
readinessQuestions.explanation: First conditional digunakan untuk kemungkinan nyata di masa depan, sehingga menggunakan 'will' (will regret) setelah klausa 'if' yang berbentuk present simple.

vocab.meaning: dilema; situasi sulit yang mengharuskan memilih di antara dua atau lebih alternatif
vocab.collocation: I've got a dilemma. The other day I cheated in a test.
First, say sorry for cheating and explain why you did it.

vocab.meaning: lolos dari hukuman; tidak ketahuan melakukan kesalahan
vocab.collocation: You can't get away with cheating forever.
I'd say I was staying at a friend's house and hide the truth from them.
If you always tell the truth, people will trust you.

vocab.meaning: mengakui kesalahan; bertanggung jawab atas perbuatan
vocab.collocation: I'd own up and say it was me.
Do you ever reconsider decisions you have made?
How good are you at making your mind up about small things?

dialogue.context: Dan dan Ana sedang membicarakan dilema yang dihadapi Dan tentang mencontek dalam ujian dan bagaimana cara terbaik mengatasinya

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I've got a dilemma. The other day I cheated in a test. I copied from Ben.
lines.translation: Aku punya dilema. Beberapa hari lalu aku mencontek dalam ujian. Aku menyontek dari Ben.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Why?
lines.translation: Kenapa?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Well, I thought I could get away with it, but now the teacher wants to know who copied who.
lines.translation: Yah, aku pikir aku bisa lolos, tapi sekarang gurunya ingin tahu siapa yang menyontek siapa.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: You should own up to it and say it was you.
lines.translation: Kamu harus mengakuinya dan katakan itu kamu.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I know, but it's too difficult to tell the truth.
lines.translation: Aku tahu, tapi terlalu sulit untuk mengatakan yang sebenarnya.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: But you can't tell the truth now! What about poor Ben? What were you thinking?
lines.translation: Tapi kamu tidak bisa katakan yang sebenarnya sekarang! Bagaimana dengan Ben yang malang? Kamu mikir apa?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: You're right, of course. It's just so difficult to do the right thing sometimes.
lines.translation: Kamu benar, tentu saja. Cuma kadang begitu sulit untuk melakukan hal yang benar.

speakingLab.context: Latihan simulasi percakapan dengan tutor tentang dilema moral yang mungkin dihadapi dalam kehidupan sehari-hari

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about dilemmas. Let me ask you: what would you do if you found a wallet full of money on the street?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would try to find the owner or take it to the police station.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's very honest of you! Now, imagine you noticed your best friend cheating in an important exam. Would you tell the teacher?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's difficult. I think I would talk to my friend first and ask them to tell the truth themselves.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good thinking! One more question: if you could change one decision you made in the past, what would it be?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: If I had studied harder last year, I would have gotten better grades.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of the third conditional! Remember, we all make mistakes, but learning from them is what matters most.

quiz.question: What _____ you do if you found £100 in a cash machine?
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'would' karena ini adalah second conditional (situasi hipotetis). Pola: If + past simple, would + verb.

quiz.question: If you always _____ the truth, people will trust you.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan present simple 'tell' setelah 'if' dalam first conditional. Jangan gunakan 'will' di klausa 'if'.

quiz.question: I wish I _____ older.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'I wish' untuk menyatakan keinginan situasi sekarang berbeda, gunakan past tense. 'I wish I was/were older' berarti saya ingin lebih tua.

quiz.question: If Billy _____ up, he _____ a young lady on her way to work.
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah third conditional (situasi masa lalu yang tidak terjadi). Pola: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

quiz.question: I won't tell him anything _____ he asks.
quiz.explanation: 'Unless' berarti 'kecuali jika' atau 'jika tidak'. Kalimat ini berarti 'Saya tidak akan memberitahunya apa-apa kecuali dia bertanya.'

quiz.question: If only I _____ an interesting book with me on this long journey!
quiz.explanation: Gunakan past tense setelah 'if only' untuk menyatakan keinginan situasi sekarang berbeda. 'If only I had' = 'Andai saja saya punya'.

modules.title: Unit 5: What a Story!: Past Perfect & Narrative Tenses
modules.objective: Mampu menceritakan kisah menggunakan relative pronouns, relative clauses (defining dan non-defining), dan memahami berbagai jenis cerita serta elemen-elemennya

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menceritakan kisah dengan baik menggunakan relative clauses untuk memberikan informasi tambahan tentang orang, tempat, atau benda. Kamu akan belajar membedakan defining relative clause (informasi penting) dan non-defining relative clause (informasi tambahan yang tidak esensial). Selain itu, unit ini membahas berbagai jenis cerita dan elemen-elemen penyusun cerita yang baik.
rules: Relative Pronouns: who (untuk orang), which (untuk benda/hewan), whose (untuk kepemilikan), where (untuk tempat). Contoh: 'The man who helped me was kind.'
Defining Relative Clause: memberikan informasi penting tanpa koma. Contoh: 'The book that has short chapters is perfect for school.'
Non-defining Relative Clause: memberikan informasi tambahan dengan koma. Contoh: 'Stephen King, who is American, is a famous writer.'
Relative clause dengan 'which': bisa merujuk pada seluruh klausa sebelumnya. Contoh: 'She was late, which made her nervous.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Koma dan Pronoun
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa membedakan defining dan non-defining relative clause. Defining clause tidak pakai koma (informasi penting), sedangkan non-defining pakai koma (informasi tambahan). Juga sering salah menggunakan 'what' sebagai relative pronoun.
commonTrap.wrong: Stephen King, that is American, is famous. / She was late, what made her nervous.
commonTrap.correct: Stephen King, who is American, is famous. / She was late, which made her nervous.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan relative pronoun dan struktur relative clause dengan tepat?
options: The man which helped me was a great storyteller.
The village where I grew up is now a famous tourist spot.
The book, that I read last night, was very fascinating.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kalimat kedua benar karena 'where' digunakan untuk tempat. Kalimat pertama salah karena 'which' tidak digunakan untuk orang (seharusnya 'who'). Kalimat ketiga salah karena 'that' tidak digunakan dalam non-defining clause yang diapit koma.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang paling tepat untuk menghindari kesalahan umum dalam penggunaan non-defining relative clause.
options: My brother, who lives in London, is a talented writer.
My brother that lives in London is a talented writer.
My brother, that lives in London, is a talented writer.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Non-defining clause (informasi tambahan) harus menggunakan 'who' untuk orang dan diapit oleh koma. Penggunaan 'that' tidak diperbolehkan dalam non-defining clause.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut agar sesuai dengan konteks cerita: 'A: I just finished reading a story about a famous villain. B: Oh really? Is it the one [...] was handed down from your grandfather?'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Which' adalah relative pronoun yang tepat untuk merujuk pada benda (dalam hal ini, 'the story').

vocab.collocation: Everybody has always respected storytellers, who have been important members of many societies.

vocab.meaning: film yang sangat sukses dan populer
vocab.collocation: Now Red Riding Hood is a Hollywood blockbuster directed by Catherine Hardwicke.
We love listening to our English teacher. Her stories are fascinating.
Teenagers are often interested in characters that are evil, and villains of their stories.
Stories have been handed down from generation to generation, with very little change.
Storytellers used to move from village to village, and people gave them food and shelter for the night.
A film or book with a great plot always captures our attention.
The opening of a story is the beginning that introduces characters and setting.

dialogue.context: Annie menceritakan pengalaman aneh saat lagu yang tidak dikenalnya terus terngiang di kepala sepanjang hari

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: What?
lines.translation: Apa?

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: I woke up with this song in my head and I couldn't stop singing it all day long. It was really annoying.
lines.translation: Aku bangun dengan lagu ini di kepalaku dan tidak bisa berhenti menyanyikannya sepanjang hari. Sungguh menjengkelkan.

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: What was it?
lines.translation: Lagu apa itu?

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: It was a song I knew, but I couldn't remember what it was. I even sang it to a few of my friends, but they didn't know what it was either.
lines.translation: Itu lagu yang aku tahu, tapi aku tidak bisa mengingat apa judulnya. Aku bahkan menyanyikannya pada beberapa temanku, tapi mereka juga tidak tahu lagu apa itu.

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: So what was so strange about that?
lines.translation: Jadi apa yang aneh dari itu?

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: I got home from school (with the song still in my head) and I went upstairs to do my homework. I decided to put on the radio to try and forget the song, and they were playing it!
lines.translation: Aku pulang dari sekolah (dengan lagu itu masih di kepalaku) dan naik ke atas untuk mengerjakan PR. Aku memutuskan menyalakan radio untuk mencoba melupakan lagu itu, dan mereka sedang memutarnya!

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: Go on.
lines.translation: Lanjutkan.

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: They were playing the song that I'd been singing all day!
lines.translation: Mereka memutar lagu yang telah kusanyikan sepanjang hari!

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: So you'd just been singing a pop song that you'd forgotten the name of.
lines.translation: Jadi kamu baru saja menyanyikan lagu pop yang kamu lupa judulnya.

lines.speaker: Annie
lines.text: Yes, but the strange thing is that it wasn't a pop song from now. It was some obscure song from the 1980s that you never hear any more. It was a song that my dad used to play when I was really small. I hadn't heard it for years. And they were playing it on the radio!
lines.translation: Ya, tapi yang aneh adalah itu bukan lagu pop dari sekarang. Itu lagu tidak terkenal dari tahun 1980-an yang tidak pernah kamu dengar lagi. Itu lagu yang biasa diputar ayahku saat aku masih sangat kecil. Aku tidak mendengarnya selama bertahun-tahun. Dan mereka memutarnya di radio!

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan tentang cerita favorit dan pengalaman bercerita

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about stories. What kind of stories do you enjoy most? Maybe fairy tales, thrillers, or something else?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I really enjoy mystery stories and thrillers that keep me guessing until the end.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! Can you tell me about a story that your parents or grandparents told you when you were younger? Where did they tell you that story?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My grandmother told me a traditional folk tale about a clever mouse deer. She usually told it when we visited her house in the village, sitting on the veranda in the evening.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds lovely! Now, think about a book or film with a great plot that you've experienced recently. What made the plot so interesting for you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I recently watched a film which had an unexpected twist at the end. The villain, who seemed evil throughout the story, turned out to be protecting the hero all along.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of a relative clause there! One last question: Why do you think people like stories so much? What makes storytelling so important in human culture?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think people like stories because they help us understand emotions and learn from others' experiences. Stories also bring people together and create shared memories.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses a defining relative clause correctly?
options: The book, which has short chapters, is on the desk.
The book which has short chapters is perfect for school.
The book, that has short chapters, is perfect for school.
quiz.answer: The book which has short chapters is perfect for school.
quiz.explanation: Defining relative clause tidak menggunakan koma karena memberikan informasi penting untuk mengidentifikasi buku mana yang dimaksud. Kalimat pertama salah karena menggunakan koma (menunjukkan non-defining clause).

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: Stephen King, _____ is American, is a famous writer.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'who' untuk merujuk pada orang dalam non-defining relative clause. 'Which' untuk benda, sedangkan 'that' tidak digunakan dalam non-defining relative clause (yang menggunakan koma).

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'which' to refer to a whole clause?
options: She was late, what made her nervous.
She was late, which made her nervous.
She was late, who made her nervous.
quiz.answer: She was late, which made her nervous.
quiz.explanation: 'Which' dapat merujuk pada seluruh klausa sebelumnya (fakta bahwa dia terlambat). 'What' tidak digunakan sebagai relative pronoun dengan cara ini, dan 'who' hanya untuk orang.

quiz.question: Identify the non-defining relative clause: 'Fairy tales which were written for children are now being adapted for the cinema.'
options: This is a non-defining relative clause
This is a defining relative clause
This sentence has no relative clause
quiz.answer: This is a defining relative clause
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah defining relative clause karena tidak ada koma. Kalimat ini membatasi 'fairy tales' hanya pada yang ditulis untuk anak-anak (bukan semua fairy tales).

quiz.question: What is the meaning of 'handed down' in: 'Stories have been handed down from generation to generation'?
quiz.explanation: 'Handed down' berarti diturunkan atau diwariskan dari orang tua/kakek nenek kepada generasi berikutnya, biasanya menyangkut tradisi, cerita, atau pengetahuan.

quiz.question: Which element of a story is 'the beginning that introduces characters and setting'?
quiz.explanation: 'Opening' adalah bagian pembukaan cerita yang memperkenalkan karakter dan setting. 'Plot' adalah alur cerita keseluruhan, sedangkan 'ending' adalah penutup cerita.

modules.title: Unit 6: How Do They Do It?: Passive Voice Present & Past
modules.objective: Mampu menjelaskan urutan kejadian dan cara melakukan sesuatu menggunakan kalimat pasif bentuk present dan past, serta menggunakan struktur 'have something done' dengan tepat

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan penggunaan passive voice dalam bentuk present dan past untuk menjelaskan bagaimana sesuatu dilakukan. Passive voice digunakan ketika kita ingin fokus pada objek atau hasil, bukan siapa yang melakukan aksi tersebut. Selain itu, unit ini juga memperkenalkan struktur 'have something done' untuk menyatakan bahwa kita meminta orang lain melakukan sesuatu untuk kita.
rules: Present Passive: Subject + am/is/are + past participle. Contoh: The trick is performed on stage. (Trik itu dilakukan di atas panggung)
Past Passive: Subject + was/were + past participle. Contoh: The man was pulled into the boat. (Pria itu ditarik ke dalam perahu)
Future Passive: Subject + will be + past participle. Contoh: The show will be shown next week. (Pertunjukan itu akan ditayangkan minggu depan)
Present Perfect Passive: Subject + have/has been + past participle. Contoh: The tickets have already been sold. (Tiket-tiket sudah terjual)
Have something done: Subject + have/has/had + object + past participle. Contoh: I've had a tattoo done. (Saya sudah membuat tato)
Preposisi 'by' digunakan untuk menyebutkan siapa yang melakukan aksi, tetapi hanya jika informasi ini penting

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Lupa Menggunakan Past Participle
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa menggunakan bentuk past participle (verb 3) setelah be dalam kalimat pasif, dan malah menggunakan verb 1 atau verb 2. Passive voice HARUS menggunakan bentuk past participle.
commonTrap.wrong: The box is cut in half by the magician. ✗ (menggunakan 'cut' yang kebetulan sama untuk semua bentuk, tapi konteksnya salah jika tidak past participle)
commonTrap.correct: The box is cut in half by the magician. ✓ (cut adalah past participle dari cut)

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan struktur Passive Voice Present yang tepat untuk menjelaskan sebuah aksi?
options: The magician performs the trick on stage.
The trick is performed by the magician on stage.
The trick is perform by the magician on stage.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kalimat pasif memerlukan struktur 'be + past participle'. Opsi kedua menggunakan 'is performed' yang benar, sedangkan opsi pertama adalah kalimat aktif, dan opsi ketiga salah karena menggunakan bentuk dasar 'perform'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang benar untuk menyatakan kejadian di masa lalu menggunakan Passive Voice, menghindari kesalahan umum penggunaan bentuk kata kerja.
options: The man was pulled into the boat.
The man was pull into the boat.
The man was pulling into the boat.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam Passive Voice, kita harus menggunakan past participle (Verb 3). 'Pulled' adalah bentuk yang benar. 'Pull' adalah bentuk dasar, dan 'pulling' adalah bentuk continuous yang tidak tepat untuk konteks pasif ini.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut untuk menyatakan bahwa seseorang meminta orang lain melakukan sesuatu: 'I don't fix my car myself. I [...] at the garage.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur 'have something done' digunakan untuk menyatakan bahwa kita meminta orang lain melakukan sesuatu untuk kita. Polanya adalah 'have + object + past participle', sehingga 'have it fixed' adalah jawaban yang tepat.

vocab.collocation: one of the world's most thrilling illusionists
a huge crowd of amazed spectators
stepped onto the freezing water
newspapers were full of the fascinating story
The show was very hilarious

vocab.meaning: sepenuhnya, sama sekali (penguat untuk kata sifat ekstrem)
vocab.collocation: it was absolutely brilliant
the latest illusion from Dynamo
Dynamo performed tricks all over the world

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Kim dan Dave tentang tato baru Dave yang mengejutkan Kim

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: What?! You've got a tattoo? You've got a tattoo!
lines.translation: Apa?! Kamu sudah buat tato? Kamu sudah buat tato!

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: So do you like it?
lines.translation: Jadi kamu suka tidak?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: She's so shocked at Dave's tattoo that she can't speak.
lines.translation: Dia sangat kaget dengan tato Dave sehingga tidak bisa bicara.

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Whatever. I like it.
lines.translation: Terserahlah. Aku suka kok.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I'm going to kill you!
lines.translation: Aku akan membunuhmu!

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor tentang pengalaman menggunakan layanan jasa (have something done)

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi there! Today let's talk about services we use. Can you tell me, where do you usually have your hair cut?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I usually have my hair cut at the salon near my house.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! And have you ever had anything repaired recently? Like a phone or a computer?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I had my phone screen repaired last month because it was cracked.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see! One more question - do you prefer to do things yourself or have them done by professionals? Why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It depends. For simple things I do them myself, but for difficult tasks I prefer to have them done by professionals.

quiz.question: The magician ___ into the boat by the police.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menjelaskan kejadian di masa lampau (past), jadi menggunakan past passive: was/were + past participle. Subjeknya 'the magician' (singular) jadi menggunakan 'was pulled'.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses 'have something done' correctly?
quiz.explanation: Struktur yang benar adalah: have + object + past participle. Jadi 'I've had a tattoo done' artinya 'Saya sudah membuat tato (oleh orang lain)'. Objek (a tattoo) harus berada di antara 'had' dan past participle 'done'.

quiz.question: Which modifier is correct with the extreme adjective 'hilarious'?
quiz.explanation: Extreme adjectives (seperti hilarious, brilliant, freezing) dimodifikasi dengan 'absolutely', bukan 'very'. 'Very' digunakan untuk gradable adjectives seperti 'funny' atau 'good'.

quiz.question: Hundreds of photos ___ by onlookers yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'yesterday' menunjukkan waktu lampau yang jelas, jadi menggunakan past passive 'were taken'. Subjeknya 'hundreds of photos' (plural) jadi menggunakan 'were'.

quiz.question: The show ___ until half an hour later because of the football match.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat menjelaskan tentang acara yang akan ditunda di masa depan, jadi menggunakan future passive: will + be + past participle. Bentuk negatifnya adalah 'won't be shown'.

quiz.question: Complete: 'Lord Uppity never cooks. He ___ his meals ___ by chefs.'
quiz.explanation: Ini menggunakan struktur 'have something done' dengan subjek singular (He), jadi 'has'. Strukturnya: has + object (his meals) + past participle (prepared). Artinya dia tidak memasak sendiri, melainkan menyuruh koki melakukannya.

modules.title: Unit 7: All the Same?: Modals of Deduction - Must, Might, Can't
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan make/let dan be allowed to untuk membicarakan izin; memahami dan menggunakan be/get used to untuk membicarakan kebiasaan; menguasai phrasal verbs dalam konteks sehari-hari; dan dapat membuat undangan dengan cara yang sopan.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas tiga struktur grammar penting: (1) make/let dan be allowed to untuk membicarakan izin dan paksaan, (2) be/get used to untuk membicarakan kebiasaan dan proses adaptasi, dan (3) phrasal verbs yang terbentuk dari kata kerja + partikel yang memiliki makna khusus berbeda dari kata kerja aslinya.
rules: make/let dan be allowed to: We can use 'make' (someone do something) untuk memaksa seseorang melakukan sesuatu, dan 'be allowed to' untuk membicarakan izin. Contoh: Billy's father makes him take up boxing. / She isn't allowed to play.

be/get used to: Be used to mengacu pada state (keadaan yang normal/familiar), sedangkan get used to mengacu pada process (sesuatu yang tidak biasa menjadi normal/familiar). Diikuti oleh noun atau gerund. Contoh: I'm used to eating with a knife and fork at home. / It was strange at first, but I got used to it.

Phrasal verbs: Terbentuk dari ordinary verb (contoh: take) + particle (contoh: up). Bersama-sama memiliki makna khusus yang berbeda dari kata kerja asalnya. Contoh: take up = begin a journey or trip; carry on = continue, not stop; find out = get information or learn about something new.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan infinitive setelah 'used to' yang bermakna kebiasaan lampau
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula mencampuradukkan 'used to + infinitive' (kebiasaan di masa lalu) dengan 'be/get used to + gerund/noun' (familiar dengan sesuatu). Keduanya berbeda! 'Used to' + infinitive untuk kebiasaan masa lalu, sedangkan 'be/get used to' + gerund/noun untuk kebiasaan yang sudah familiar.
commonTrap.wrong: I'm used to wake up early.
commonTrap.correct: I'm used to waking up early. (sudah terbiasa) ATAU I used to wake up early. (dulu sering, sekarang tidak)

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan struktur 'make' atau 'let' dengan benar untuk menyatakan paksaan atau izin?
options: My teacher makes us to finish the homework before leaving.
My teacher makes us finish the homework before leaving.
My teacher lets us to finish the homework before leaving.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Setelah kata 'make' atau 'let', kita harus menggunakan bare infinitive (kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to').

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar untuk menyatakan bahwa seseorang sudah terbiasa dengan rutinitas baru?
options: I am used to waking up early for my new job.
I am used to wake up early for my new job.
I used to waking up early for my new job.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Be used to' harus diikuti oleh gerund (verb-ing) atau noun untuk menyatakan kebiasaan yang sudah familiar, bukan infinitive.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut dengan phrasal verb yang tepat: "I'm bored with my routine, so I think I'll [...] a new hobby like photography."
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Take up' berarti memulai hobi atau aktivitas baru, yang sangat sesuai dengan konteks kalimat tersebut.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Flora, Leo, Jeff, dan Mia membahas tentang Richie Ford yang dianggap sebagai 'nerd' karena menghabiskan sepanjang hari di depan komputer. Flora mempertahankan Richie, sementara yang lain berpikir dia tidak punya kehidupan sosial.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: Don't look now, but Richie Ford's sitting behind you.
lines.translation: Jangan lihat sekarang, tapi Richie Ford duduk di belakangmu.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Let me guess: he's doing something on his computer.
lines.translation: Biar kutebak: dia sedang melakukan sesuatu di komputernya.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: Got it in one.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: He spends all day on that thing.
lines.translation: Dia menghabiskan sepanjang hari di benda itu.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: I know. Hasn't he got a life?

lines.speaker: Flora

lines.speaker: Mia

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: No, it's all right. He's got his earphones in. He's such a nerd.
lines.translation: Tidak, tidak apa-apa. Dia pakai earphone. Dia benar-benar kutu buku.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kebiasaan dan hal-hal yang kamu sudah terbiasa lakukan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari, serta membicarakan izin yang kamu miliki atau tidak miliki.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's talk about your daily habits. Are you used to waking up early in the morning?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm used to waking up at 6 AM every day for school.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! Was it difficult at first, or did you get used to it quickly?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It was hard at first, but I got used to it after a few weeks.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now, tell me about something you're allowed to do at school but not allowed to do at home.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm allowed to use my phone during breaks at school, but I'm not allowed to use it during dinner at home.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see! And has anyone ever made you do something you didn't want to do?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, my parents make me study every night, even when I'm tired.

quiz.question: Billy's father _____ him take up boxing, but he hates it.
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'make' (someone do something) untuk memaksa seseorang melakukan sesuatu yang mereka tidak suka. Billy dipaksa melakukan tinju oleh ayahnya.

quiz.question: Because she's a girl, she _____ play football.
quiz.explanation: 'Be allowed to' digunakan untuk membicarakan izin. Dalam kalimat ini, dia tidak diizinkan bermain sepak bola karena dia perempuan.

quiz.question: I'm from Rio, so I'm used to _____, but I'm not used to _____ right before I cross the road!
quiz.explanation: 'Be used to' diikuti oleh noun atau gerund (verb+ing). Jadi 'used to traffic' (noun) dan 'used to looking' (gerund) adalah benar.

quiz.question: Which phrasal verb means 'to get information or learn about something new'?
quiz.explanation: 'Find out' berarti mengetahui atau menemukan informasi baru tentang sesuatu. Contoh: When Jess's parents find out she's been playing football, they make her stop.

quiz.question: I haven't got used to the _____ yet. It rains a lot here in Brazil.
quiz.explanation: 'Get used to' diikuti oleh noun atau gerund. 'Weather' adalah noun (cuaca), jadi kalimat yang benar adalah 'get used to the weather'.

quiz.question: Billy _____ in secret because he loves dancing.
quiz.explanation: 'Carry on' berarti melanjutkan atau tidak berhenti. Billy terus menari secara rahasia karena dia menyukainya, meskipun ayahnya melarang.

modules.title: Unit 8: It's a Crime: Reported Speech
modules.objective: Mampu melaporkan ucapan orang lain (reported speech), pertanyaan, permintaan, dan perintah dengan benar, serta memahami kosakata terkait kejahatan dan hukum

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara melaporkan ucapan orang lain (reported speech). Saat melaporkan, kita mengubah kalimat langsung menjadi kalimat tidak langsung dengan mengubah tenses, pronoun, dan time expressions. Reported speech digunakan untuk menyampaikan apa yang dikatakan, ditanya, atau diminta seseorang di masa lalu.
rules: Present Simple → Past Simple: She said, 'I like it' → She said (that) she liked it
Present Continuous → Past Continuous: 'I'm working' → He said he was working
Present Perfect → Past Perfect: 'I've finished' → She said she had finished
Past Simple → Past Perfect: 'I went' → He said he had gone
will → would: 'I will come' → She said she would come
can → could: 'I can help' → He said he could help
Reported Questions: 'Where do you live?' → He asked me where I lived (tanpa question mark)
Reported Requests: 'Please help me' → She asked me to help her
Reported Imperatives: 'Don't go!' → He told me not to go

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Menggunakan Tenses
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah tenses saat melaporkan ucapan, atau lupa mengubah time expressions seperti 'today' menjadi 'that day', 'yesterday' menjadi 'the day before'
commonTrap.wrong: She said she is tired today
commonTrap.correct: She said she was tired that day

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar untuk mengubah kalimat langsung "I live in London" menjadi reported speech?
options: He said that he lived in London.
He said that he lives in London.
He said that he has lived in London.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam reported speech, tenses biasanya mundur satu langkah (backshift). Present simple 'live' berubah menjadi past simple 'lived'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang tepat untuk melaporkan ucapan: "I am working today"?
options: He said he was working today.
He said he was working that day.
He said he is working that day.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Selain mengubah tenses (am menjadi was), kita harus mengubah keterangan waktu 'today' menjadi 'that day' dalam reported speech.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Polisi bertanya: 'Can you describe the person who took your bag?' Saksi menjawab: 'Yes, I think it was a [...] because he attacked me on the street.' Kata mana yang paling tepat untuk mengisi bagian kosong tersebut?
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Mugger' adalah istilah untuk perampok jalanan, yang paling tepat untuk konteks serangan di jalan. 'Burglar' untuk pencuri rumah, dan 'shoplifter' untuk pencuri di toko.

vocab.collocation: The burglar broke into the house at night
The mugger attacked someone in the street
The shoplifter was caught stealing from the store
Beware of pickpockets in crowded areas
The con man tricked people online
He was arrested for committing a crime
He got a fine for speeding
He was charged with embezzlement from the company

dialogue.context: Mrs. Atkins melaporkan kepada wartawan tentang sepedanya yang dicuri dan dikembalikan

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Mrs. Atkins, can you tell us what happened?
lines.translation: Bu Atkins, bisakah Anda ceritakan apa yang terjadi?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Atkins
lines.text: When I went to ride my bike last Friday, I was shocked to discover it wasn't there.
lines.translation: Ketika saya hendak naik sepeda Jumat lalu, saya kaget menemukan sepeda itu tidak ada.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: How did you feel?
lines.translation: Bagaimana perasaan Anda?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Atkins
lines.text: I told the reporter that I'd been really angry when I realised the bike was gone.
lines.translation: Saya bilang ke wartawan bahwa saya sangat marah ketika menyadari sepeda itu hilang.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: What did you do next?
lines.translation: Apa yang Anda lakukan selanjutnya?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Atkins
lines.text: I decided to write a note to the thief and put it on the tree. To my surprise, the thief returned the bike with a written apology!
lines.translation: Saya memutuskan menulis surat untuk pencurinya dan menempelkannya di pohon. Yang mengejutkan, pencuri itu mengembalikan sepeda dengan surat permintaan maaf!

speakingLab.context: Simulasi melaporkan kejadian kejahatan kepada polisi atau wartawan

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I'm investigating a crime report. Can you tell me what happened yesterday?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I was walking home when someone stole my bag.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. What did the thief look like? Can you describe them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: He was wearing a green jacket and he ran very fast.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Did anyone else see what happened? What did they say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: A woman told me that she had seen the same person near the station earlier.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good information! What will you do if we catch the thief?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I just want my bag back. I hope the police can find him soon.

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'I am feeling tired,' she said.
options: She said she is feeling tired
She said she was feeling tired
She said she has been feeling tired
quiz.answer: She said she was feeling tired
quiz.explanation: Present Continuous dalam direct speech berubah menjadi Past Continuous dalam reported speech

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'Where do you live?' he asked me.
options: He asked me where do I live
He asked me where I lived
He asked me where did I live
quiz.answer: He asked me where I lived
quiz.explanation: Reported questions tidak menggunakan question mark dan verb berubah ke past (do → did → lived)

quiz.question: What is a 'pickpocket'?
options: Someone who steals from people's pockets
quiz.answer: Someone who steals from people's pockets
quiz.explanation: Pickpocket adalah pencopet yang mencuri barang dari saku orang

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'Don't go there!' she told him.
options: She told him don't go there
She told him not to go there
She told him to not go there
quiz.answer: She told him not to go there
quiz.explanation: Reported imperatives negatif menggunakan pola: told + object + not to + verb

quiz.question: What does 'to commit a crime' mean?
quiz.explanation: 'Commit a crime' berarti melakukan tindakan kejahatan atau ilegal

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'I have finished my work,' he said.
options: He said he has finished his work
He said he had finished his work
He said he finished his work
quiz.answer: He said he had finished his work
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect dalam direct speech berubah menjadi Past Perfect (had finished) dalam reported speech

modules.title: Unit 9: What Happened?: Third Conditional & Regrets
modules.objective: Mampu membuat deduksi tentang peristiwa masa lalu menggunakan modal verbs (must have, can't have, might have, should have, shouldn't have) dan memahami perbedaan antara fakta dan opini dalam konteks misteri dan peristiwa yang tidak dapat dijelaskan.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara membuat deduksi atau kesimpulan tentang peristiwa yang sudah terjadi di masa lalu. Kita menggunakan modal verbs khusus untuk menyatakan tingkat kepastian yang berbeda: 'must have' untuk sesuatu yang kita yakin benar, 'can't have/couldn't have' untuk sesuatu yang kita yakin tidak benar, dan 'might have/could have/may have' untuk kemungkinan. Selain itu, 'should have/shouldn't have' digunakan untuk mengkritik tindakan di masa lalu atau menyatakan penyesalan.
rules: Modal of deduction (certainty - positive): must + have + past participle. Contoh: 'Amelia must have run out of fuel.' (Saya yakin Amelia kehabisan bahan bakar)
Modal of deduction (certainty - negative): can't/couldn't + have + past participle. Contoh: 'She couldn't have survived the crash.' (Saya yakin dia tidak mungkin selamat dari kecelakaan)
Modal of deduction (possibility): might/could/may + have + past participle. Contoh: 'Amelia might have landed her plane on the island.' (Ada kemungkinan Amelia mendaratkan pesawatnya di pulau itu)
Criticizing past actions: should/shouldn't + have + past participle. Contoh: 'He should have thought about his plan more carefully.' (Dia seharusnya memikirkan rencananya lebih hati-hati)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Modal Present untuk Peristiwa Masa Lalu
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'must be', 'can't be', atau 'might be' ketika berbicara tentang peristiwa masa lalu. Padahal untuk deduksi masa lalu, kita HARUS menambahkan 'have + past participle' setelah modal verb.
commonTrap.wrong: She must be at home yesterday when it happened.
commonTrap.correct: She must have been at home yesterday when it happened.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilihlah kalimat yang menggunakan struktur deduksi masa lalu (modal of deduction) dengan benar.
options: She must have left her keys in the car.
She must left her keys in the car.
She must has left her keys in the car.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Untuk menyatakan deduksi tentang peristiwa masa lalu, kita harus menggunakan struktur 'modal + have + past participle' (V3). Pilihan pertama benar karena menggunakan 'must have left'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang tepat untuk menyatakan deduksi tentang kejadian di masa lalu?
options: He can't be stolen the money; he was with me all day.
He couldn't have stolen the money; he was with me all day.
He couldn't stole the money; he was with me all day.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan modal present ('can't be'). Untuk deduksi masa lalu, kita harus menggunakan 'couldn't have + past participle' (stolen).

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut: 'I saw a strange light in the sky last night. It moved so fast!' 'It [...] a meteor, but it was too slow for that.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Might have been' digunakan untuk menyatakan kemungkinan di masa lalu. 'Must be' salah karena merupakan bentuk present, dan 'should have been' tidak sesuai konteks karena tidak menyatakan penyesalan.

vocab.collocation: There are many unexplained mysteries in the world.

vocab.meaning: makhluk luar angkasa, berasal dari luar bumi
vocab.collocation: Some people think it must be extraterrestrial.
What is the reason for this puzzling phenomenon?
Why is the fall mysterious?
Making deductions about what happened.
It could be evidence of an ancient lost civilisation.
Amelia and Fred went missing.
She broke many aviation records.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Oliver dan Matt tentang kue yang hilang secara misterius di rumah mereka. Mereka mencoba mencari tahu siapa yang mengambil kue tersebut.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: What?! My cake! It's gone!
lines.translation: Apa?! Kueku! Hilang!

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: Really?
lines.translation: Benarkah?

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: Yes, it was here an hour ago and now it isn't. Who's taken it?
lines.translation: Ya, sejam yang lalu ada di sini dan sekarang tidak ada. Siapa yang mengambilnya?

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: What about Dad? I heard him saying how hungry he was. In fact, I'm sure it must have been Dad.
lines.translation: Bagaimana dengan Ayah? Aku mendengar dia bilang betapa laparnya dia. Bahkan, aku yakin pasti Ayah yang mengambilnya.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: No, he can't have eaten it. It was chocolate. Dad doesn't like chocolate.
lines.translation: Tidak, tidak mungkin dia yang memakannya. Itu cokelat. Ayah tidak suka cokelat.

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: That's true. I suppose Mum might have taken it. Maybe?
lines.translation: Itu benar. Kurasa Ibu mungkin yang mengambilnya. Mungkin?

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: No, it can't have been Mum. She's been out all morning.
lines.translation: Tidak, tidak mungkin Ibu. Dia keluar sepanjang pagi.

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.text: The dog! He must have jumped onto the table and eaten it. That dog's always doing things like that.
lines.translation: Anjingnya! Pasti dia yang melompat ke meja dan memakannya. Anjing itu selalu melakukan hal seperti itu.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan tentang membuat deduksi terhadap peristiwa masa lalu. Tutor akan menanyakan situasi hipotetis dan siswa harus merespons menggunakan modal verbs yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to practice making deductions about the past. Let me give you a situation: Your friend didn't come to school yesterday, and you saw their phone was off. What do you think happened?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: They must have been sick, or they might have had a family emergency.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good! Now imagine you found your front door open when you came home, but nothing was missing. What's your deduction?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Someone in my family must have forgotten to close it properly. It can't have been a burglar because nothing is missing.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent reasoning! Now let's practice regrets. Think about a time when you made a mistake. What should you have done differently?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I should have studied harder for my last exam. I shouldn't have stayed up so late the night before.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! You're using the structures very well. One more: Your team lost a football match 5-0. What might have been the problem?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We might not have trained enough. The other team must have been much stronger than us.

quiz.question: Complete: 'Amelia Earhart disappeared in 1937. She _____ run out of fuel over the Pacific Ocean.'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'must have + past participle' untuk deduksi yang kita yakini benar tentang masa lalu. Dalam konteks ini, sangat mungkin Amelia kehabisan bahan bakar.

quiz.question: Which sentence shows the speaker is criticizing a past action?
options: He might have told the truth.
He should have asked for permission first.
He can't have known about it.
quiz.answer: He should have asked for permission first.
quiz.explanation: 'Should have + past participle' digunakan untuk mengkritik tindakan masa lalu atau menyatakan bahwa seseorang tidak melakukan hal yang benar.

quiz.question: Complete: 'The dogs can't be committing suicide because they _____.'
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'because' kita menjelaskan alasan dalam bentuk present simple karena ini fakta umum tentang anjing, bukan peristiwa masa lalu spesifik.

quiz.question: Choose the correct deduction: 'The school gates were closed at 9 am. You arrived at 9:30. So you _____ the gates open.'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'can't have + past participle' untuk deduksi yang kita yakin TIDAK benar. Jika gerbang ditutup jam 9 dan kamu tiba jam 9:30, tidak mungkin kamu melihat gerbang terbuka.

quiz.question: What is the difference between fact and opinion?
options: A fact is something proven to be true; an opinion is a personal belief
A fact is always about the past; an opinion is about the future
A fact uses 'must'; an opinion uses 'might'
quiz.answer: A fact is something proven to be true; an opinion is a personal belief
quiz.explanation: Fakta adalah sesuatu yang dapat dibuktikan kebenarannya, sedangkan opini adalah keyakinan personal. Penting untuk membedakan keduanya saat membuat deduksi.

quiz.question: Complete: 'I had five slices of pizza! Now I feel sick. You shouldn't _____ so much pizza!'
quiz.explanation: 'Shouldn't have + past participle' digunakan untuk mengkritik tindakan masa lalu. Rumusnya adalah modal + have + past participle (eaten, bukan ate).

modules.title: Unit 10: Money: Reported Speech Statements
modules.objective: Mampu berbicara tentang kejadian di masa depan, menyatakan simpati, menggunakan future continuous dan future perfect, serta memahami kosakata tentang uang, nilai, pekerjaan, dan kata penghubung 'by'

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas dua bentuk waktu future yang lebih kompleks: Future Continuous untuk membicarakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di waktu tertentu di masa depan, dan Future Perfect untuk membicarakan aksi yang akan selesai di antara sekarang dan waktu tertentu di masa depan. Unit ini juga mengajarkan penggunaan 'by' untuk menunjukkan cara, lokasi, waktu, dan pelaku.
rules: Future Continuous: will + be + verb-ing. Contoh: 'In a few decades' time, everyone will be using a single currency.' Digunakan untuk membicarakan hal yang akan sedang berlangsung di waktu spesifik di masa depan.

Future Perfect: will + have + past participle. Contoh: 'By the end of the year, he'll have earned more than £3 million.' Digunakan untuk membicarakan aksi yang akan selesai sebelum waktu tertentu di masa depan. Sering digunakan dengan 'by' + waktu atau 'by the time' + klausa.
Penggunaan 'by' untuk menunjukkan: lokasi ('by the shoe shop'), waktu ('by tomorrow'), cara ('by solving problems'), dan pelaku ('by some people').

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Future Simple untuk Aksi yang Sedang Berlangsung
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering menggunakan future simple (will + verb) ketika seharusnya menggunakan future continuous untuk menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di waktu tertentu di masa depan. Mereka juga sering lupa menggunakan future perfect untuk aksi yang akan selesai sebelum waktu tertentu.
commonTrap.wrong: Tomorrow at 10 o'clock, I will sit on a train.
commonTrap.correct: Tomorrow at 10 o'clock, I will be sitting on a train.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan Future Continuous dengan benar untuk menyatakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa depan.
options: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to London.
This time tomorrow, I will fly to London.
This time tomorrow, I will have flown to London.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Future Continuous menggunakan pola 'will be + verb-ing' untuk menggambarkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu spesifik di masa depan.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar untuk menyatakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu spesifik di masa depan, menghindari kesalahan umum penggunaan Future Simple?
options: At 9 o'clock tonight, I will be working on my project.
At 9 o'clock tonight, I will work on my project.
At 9 o'clock tonight, I will have worked on my project.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan Future Simple (will work) untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung. Bentuk yang benar adalah Future Continuous (will be working) untuk menunjukkan durasi aksi pada waktu tersebut.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Jeff menemukan uang di jalan. Jika Jeff ingin mengatakan bahwa dia akan selesai menabung uang tersebut sebelum akhir bulan, kalimat mana yang paling tepat?
options: By the end of the month, I will have saved enough money.
By the end of the month, I will be saving enough money.
By the end of the month, I will save enough money.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Future Perfect (will have + past participle) digunakan untuk aksi yang akan selesai sebelum waktu tertentu di masa depan, yang sering ditandai dengan penggunaan kata 'by'.

vocab.collocation: In a few decades' time, everyone all over the world will be using a single currency.
There is no chance Howells will ever find his Bitcoin fortune.

vocab.meaning: uang tip; uang tambahan yang diberikan untuk pelayanan
vocab.collocation: Money you get for doing something helpful (for example, finding something that was lost).
Extra money to thank someone for a service (for example, a waiter).
To need to pay someone.
Something you get at a really good price; available at a good price (usually for a short time).

vocab.meaning: kualifikasi; kemampuan atau pengalaman yang dibutuhkan untuk pekerjaan tertentu
vocab.collocation: Abilities or experience needed for a particular job.

vocab.meaning: pemberi kerja; perusahaan atau orang yang mempekerjakan
vocab.collocation: A person or organisation that people work for.

dialogue.context: Jeff, Mia, Leo, dan Flora sedang di kafe membicarakan tentang masalah uang mereka. Jeff menemukan uang di jalan dan mereka berdiskusi apakah harus membelanjakannya atau memberikannya kepada seorang wanita tua yang kehilangan uangnya.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'd really like one of these fancy desserts. Like this one, with nuts and everything, and the banana...
lines.translation: Aku sangat ingin salah satu dari makanan penutup mewah ini. Seperti yang ini, dengan kacang dan semuanya, dan pisang...

lines.speaker: Flora
lines.text: A banana split! Mmm, they're amazing. Let's see. Oh, they're £6.99. I don't have that kind of money.
lines.translation: Banana split! Mmm, itu luar biasa. Mari kita lihat. Oh, harganya £6.99. Aku tidak punya uang sebanyak itu.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Tell me about it. I'd really like one of those hot chocolate drinks with all the extras. But I just can't afford it.
lines.translation: Ceritakan padaku tentang itu. Aku sangat ingin salah satu dari minuman cokelat panas itu dengan semua tambahannya. Tapi aku tidak mampu membelinya.

lines.speaker: Jeff
lines.text: Look what I found! Outside here, on the street, by the shoe shop. My lucky day, eh? And your lucky day, too! Let's go crazy - desserts are on me!
lines.translation: Lihat apa yang kutemukan! Di luar sini, di jalan, dekat toko sepatu. Hari keberuntunganku, eh? Dan hari keberuntungan kalian juga! Ayo gila-gilaan - makanan penutup ditraktir aku!

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: But, Jeff, the money isn't ours. We can't just spend it on ourselves like that.
lines.translation: Tapi, Jeff, uangnya bukan milik kita. Kita tidak bisa hanya menghabiskannya untuk diri kita sendiri seperti itu.

lines.speaker: Mrs Brady
lines.text: I'd better have a small coffee today. You know, this morning I lost £20.
lines.translation: Sebaiknya aku memesan kopi kecil hari ini. Kau tahu, pagi ini aku kehilangan £20.

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: Oh no! That's a shame. I'm really sorry to hear that.
lines.translation: Oh tidak! Itu memalukan. Aku sangat sedih mendengarnya.

lines.speaker: Mrs Brady
lines.text: Yes. I must have lost it around here somewhere. That's a lot of money for me.
lines.translation: Ya. Aku pasti kehilangannya di sekitar sini. Itu banyak uang untukku.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berbincang dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang rencana masa depan Anda, tujuan keuangan, dan pekerjaan impian Anda. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan apa yang akan Anda lakukan di masa depan menggunakan future continuous dan future perfect.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's talk about your future plans. Tell me, what will you be doing this time next week?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: This time next week, I'll be studying for my exams.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good! Now, think about your goals. What will you have achieved by the end of this year?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: By the end of this year, I'll have finished all my B2 level English courses.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now let's talk about work. Would you rather be an employer or an employee? Why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'd rather be an employer because I want to make my own decisions and create jobs for others.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
