turns.text: That's a great ambition! One more question: what's the most valuable thing that teenagers usually own?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think the most valuable thing teenagers own is their mobile phone because it's essential for communication and learning.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: Tomorrow at 8 o'clock tonight, I ___ my holidays.
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan future continuous (will be + verb-ing) untuk membicarakan aksi yang akan sedang berlangsung di waktu spesifik di masa depan. Jam 8 malam besok adalah waktu spesifik, dan pada saat itu aksi 'enjoying' sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence using future perfect:
options: By 2030, the government builds lots of new houses.
By 2030, the government will build lots of new houses.
By 2030, the government will have built lots of new houses.
quiz.answer: By 2030, the government will have built lots of new houses.
quiz.explanation: Future perfect (will have + past participle) digunakan untuk membicarakan aksi yang akan selesai sebelum waktu tertentu di masa depan. 'By 2030' menunjukkan batas waktu, jadi kita menggunakan 'will have built'.

quiz.question: What does 'a bargain' mean?
options: Something you get at a really good price
Money you need to pay someone
Money paid back to you after returning something
quiz.answer: Something you get at a really good price
quiz.explanation: 'A bargain' adalah barang yang didapat dengan harga yang sangat bagus atau murah, biasanya dalam waktu terbatas.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses 'by' correctly to show method/way?
options: He got the Bitcoins by the shoe shop.
He got the Bitcoins by solving complicated Maths problems.
He got the Bitcoins by tomorrow.
quiz.answer: He got the Bitcoins by solving complicated Maths problems.
quiz.explanation: 'By' dapat digunakan untuk menunjukkan cara atau metode melakukan sesuatu. 'By solving' menunjukkan bagaimana dia mendapatkan Bitcoin. Opsi pertama menunjukkan lokasi, dan ketiga menunjukkan waktu.

quiz.question: Complete: 'By the time I'm 50, I ___ to work any more.'
quiz.explanation: Meskipun 'by the time' sering digunakan dengan future perfect, dalam kalimat ini kita berbicara tentang keadaan di masa depan (tidak perlu bekerja), bukan aksi yang akan selesai. Jadi future simple 'won't need' lebih tepat.

quiz.question: What are 'qualifications'?
options: Jobs paid for by the government
Abilities or experience needed for a particular job
An area of work related to managing money
quiz.answer: Abilities or experience needed for a particular job
quiz.explanation: 'Qualifications' adalah kualifikasi, yaitu kemampuan, pengalaman, atau sertifikat yang dibutuhkan untuk mendapatkan pekerjaan tertentu, seperti ijazah atau pengalaman kerja.

modules.title: Unit 11: Help!: Reported Questions & Requests
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan verbs followed by gerund or infinitive, struktur to/in order to/so as to untuk menyatakan tujuan, serta so and such untuk penekanan. Mampu memahami dan menggunakan kosakata terkait bahaya, keselamatan, dan adjectives dengan negative prefixes.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan kata kerja yang diikuti gerund atau infinitive, cara menyatakan tujuan dengan to/in order to/so as to, serta penggunaan so dan such untuk memberikan penekanan pada kalimat. Topik ini sangat berguna untuk menjelaskan alasan dan tujuan dalam situasi darurat atau penyelamatan.
rules: Verbs followed by gerund: enjoy, (don't) mind, (can't) stand, finish, imagine, feel like, suggest, practise, miss, avoid. Contoh: He enjoyed helping people.
Verbs followed by infinitive: hope, promise, learn, expect, decide, afford, offer, choose, want. Contoh: Mr Reeder decided to do something.
to + infinitive untuk menyatakan tujuan. Contoh: The farmer ran over to see what had happened.
in order to / so as to + infinitive untuk tujuan yang lebih formal. Contoh: He couldn't throw a rope down in order to pull the donkey out.
so + adjective/adverb untuk penekanan. Contoh: I'm so hungry!
such + (a/an) + (adjective) + noun untuk penekanan. Contoh: The Prime Minister is such a good-looking man.
so/such ... that untuk menunjukkan hasil. Contoh: We were so late that we had to take a taxi.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Gerund dan Infinitive
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula bingung kapan menggunakan gerund (-ing) dan kapan menggunakan infinitive (to + verb). Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan bentuk yang salah setelah kata kerja tertentu.
commonTrap.wrong: He avoided to walk along the seafront. / I hope seeing you soon.
commonTrap.correct: He avoided walking along the seafront. / I hope to see you soon.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan pola kata kerja (verb pattern) yang benar sesuai aturan tata bahasa:
options: I hope to see you at the safety meeting later.
I hope seeing you at the safety meeting later.
I hope for see you at the safety meeting later.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kata kerja 'hope' harus diikuti oleh infinitive (to + verb), bukan gerund (-ing) atau bentuk lainnya.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar dalam penggunaan kata kerja 'avoid' dan 'decide' untuk menghindari kesalahan umum?
options: He avoided to talk about the dangerous incident.
He decided to avoid talking about the dangerous incident.
He decided avoiding to talk about the dangerous incident.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kata kerja 'decide' diikuti oleh infinitive (to avoid) dan 'avoid' diikuti oleh gerund (talking). Pilihan lainnya mencampur pola tersebut secara keliru.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut untuk menyatakan tujuan tindakan penyelamatan: 'The rescue team arrived early [...] ensure everyone was safe.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'In order to' digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan (diikuti infinitive). 'Such as' berarti 'seperti', dan 'so that to' tidak tepat secara tata bahasa.

vocab.collocation: The helicopter emergency services managed to pull the victim out of the sea.
He was in a terrible accident, but he didn't die.
We were lucky to survive the accident.
The mine had a poor safety record.
33 miners were trapped underground.
Rescue teams began drilling into the ground to bring out the men.
A rescue diver was swimming through the wreck of the tugboat.
An air ambulance helicopter arrived and the baby was taken to hospital.

dialogue.context: Percakapan tentang kisah kepahlawanan Mr Reeder yang menyelamatkan bayi dari kecelakaan di laut

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: Mr Reeder, can you tell us what happened that morning?
lines.translation: Pak Reeder, bisakah Anda ceritakan apa yang terjadi pagi itu?

lines.speaker: Mr Reeder
lines.text: I was carrying out my regular duties when I heard a noise. I cycled over as fast as I could.
lines.translation: Saya sedang menjalankan tugas rutin ketika saya mendengar suara. Saya langsung bersepeda secepat mungkin.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: What did you see when you arrived?
lines.translation: Apa yang Anda lihat saat tiba di sana?

lines.speaker: Mr Reeder
lines.text: I saw a baby's buggy in the sea. The baby was strapped into the buggy and was in the water. I went over and pulled the buggy over to the sea wall.
lines.translation: Saya melihat kereta bayi di laut. Bayinya masih terikat di kereta dan ada di dalam air. Saya menghampiri dan menarik kereta itu ke dinding laut.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: That was incredibly brave. How did you feel?
lines.translation: Itu sangat berani sekali. Bagaimana perasaan Anda?

lines.speaker: Mr Reeder
lines.text: I didn't really think. It was everyone – from Tanya doing the CPR to the helicopter pilot. I'm just glad I could help.
lines.translation: Saya tidak sempat berpikir. Semua orang membantu – dari Tanya yang melakukan CPR hingga pilot helikopter. Saya hanya senang bisa membantu.

speakingLab.context: Latihan berbicara tentang pengalaman menyelamatkan atau ditolong seseorang dalam situasi darurat

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about helping others in emergencies. Have you ever helped someone in a difficult situation, or has anyone helped you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I once helped my neighbor when they fell down the stairs.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! Can you tell me more about it? What did you do to help them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I called an ambulance immediately and stayed with them until help arrived. I also tried to keep them calm.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! You did exactly the right thing. How did you feel when you were helping them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I felt nervous at first, but I knew I had to stay calm to help them properly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That shows real courage. Do you think it's important for everyone to learn basic first aid?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, definitely. It can help save lives in an emergency situation.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: He enjoyed _____ the baby and the helicopter had gone.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'enjoy' selalu diikuti oleh gerund (-ing form), bukan infinitive. Pola: enjoy + verb-ing.

quiz.question: Choose the correct form: Some other people helped _____ a rope to the buggy.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'help' bisa diikuti infinitive dengan 'to' (to tie) atau tanpa 'to' (tie). Dalam konteks formal, 'to tie' lebih umum digunakan.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of using 'in order to'? The farmer ran over _____ see what had happened.
quiz.explanation: 'To' + infinitive digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan atau maksud. 'In order to' adalah bentuk yang lebih formal dengan arti yang sama.

quiz.question: Complete with 'so' or 'such': I'm _____ hungry! Can you tell them to hurry up, please?
quiz.explanation: 'So' digunakan sebelum adjective atau adverb (so hungry, so quickly), sedangkan 'such' digunakan sebelum noun phrase (such a good person).

quiz.question: Which negative prefix fits? Mr Reeder was ___concerned about his own safety.
quiz.explanation: Prefix 'un-' digunakan dengan 'concerned' untuk membuat makna negatif. Pola umum: un- + adjective (uncomfortable, unhappy, unsafe).

quiz.question: Choose the correct verb form: They managed _____ it out of the water.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'manage' selalu diikuti oleh 'to + infinitive'. Pola: manage to do something (berhasil melakukan sesuatu).

modules.title: Unit 12: A First Time for Everything: Wish / If Only & Future in the Past
modules.objective: Mampu mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang masa lalu menggunakan I wish dan If only dengan past perfect, serta memahami dan menggunakan phrasal verbs yang dapat dipisahkan dan tidak dapat dipisahkan dalam konteks kenangan dan pengalaman pertama kali.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang hal-hal yang sudah terjadi di masa lalu. Kita menggunakan I wish atau If only diikuti past perfect tense untuk menyatakan keinginan agar sesuatu di masa lalu berbeda. Selain itu, unit ini juga membahas phrasal verbs, yaitu kata kerja yang digabung dengan preposisi atau adverb. Beberapa phrasal verbs dapat dipisahkan (objek bisa di antara verb dan partikel), sementara yang lain harus tetap bersama.
rules: I wish / If only + past perfect: Untuk mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang masa lalu. Contoh: 'I wish I'd gone up there!' (Andai saja aku ke sana!), 'If only I'd taken a photo!' (Kalau saja aku mengambil foto!)

Phrasal verbs yang dapat dipisahkan: Objek bisa ditempatkan di antara verb dan partikel, atau setelahnya. Contoh: 'I couldn't blow the candles out' atau 'I couldn't blow out the candles', 'He sorted the problem out' atau 'He sorted out the problem'
Phrasal verbs yang tidak dapat dipisahkan: Harus tetap bersama, tidak boleh dipisahkan. Contoh: 'They're looking into it' (BUKAN 'looking it into'), 'I look forward to seeing you' (selalu bersama)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Memisahkan Phrasal Verbs yang Tidak Boleh Dipisahkan
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula mencoba memisahkan semua phrasal verbs, padahal ada beberapa yang harus tetap bersama. Cara mengeceknya adalah dengan menggunakan kamus: 'look sth up' berarti bisa dipisahkan, sedangkan 'look into sth' tidak bisa dipisahkan.
commonTrap.wrong: They're looking it into. / I'm looking to forward it.
commonTrap.correct: They're looking into it. / I'm looking forward to it.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang benar untuk mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang kejadian di masa lalu.
options: I wish I had arrived on time.
I wish I arrived on time.
I wish I would arrive on time.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Untuk mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang masa lalu, kita harus menggunakan 'I wish' diikuti oleh past perfect tense (had + V3).

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah penggunaan phrasal verb 'look into' (menyelidiki) yang benar?
options: The manager is looking the issue into.
The manager is looking into the issue.
The manager is looking it into.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Look into' adalah phrasal verb yang tidak dapat dipisahkan (inseparable), sehingga objek harus diletakkan setelah partikel 'into', bukan di tengahnya.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut: 'I am really [...] meeting you next week.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Look forward to' adalah phrasal verb yang tidak dapat dipisahkan dan selalu diikuti oleh 'to' sebelum kata kerja bentuk -ing.

vocab.collocation: I couldn't blow the candles out on my birthday cake.
They carried out research into early memories.
We can look forward to more fascinating discoveries about memories.
A mechanic came to sort it out when our car broke down.
I was so terrified that I started biting my nails.
I was really sweating when I stood there with the rope round my ankle.
I started to tremble and my mouth went dry before the speech.
Our memories change in the early years, but at around the age of ten, they crystallise.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Oliver dan Amelia di sebuah kafe. Amelia terlihat tidak enak badan setelah makan terlalu banyak kue.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: What's the matter, Amelia?
lines.translation: Ada apa, Amelia?

lines.speaker: Amelia
lines.text: It was that third piece of cake. I wish I hadn't eaten it.
lines.translation: Ini karena potongan kue yang ketiga. Andai saja aku tidak memakannya.

lines.speaker: Oliver
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you should lie down for a few minutes.
lines.translation: Turut prihatin mendengarnya. Mungkin kamu sebaiknya berbaring sebentar.

lines.speaker: Amelia
lines.text: That isn't a bad idea. I think I will.
lines.translation: Itu ide yang bagus. Sepertinya aku akan melakukannya.

lines.speaker: Amelia
lines.text: I've eaten too much. I'm feeling ill.
lines.translation: Aku makan terlalu banyak. Aku merasa tidak enak badan.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalaman pertama kali dan penyesalan di masa lalu

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about first experiences and regrets. Can you tell me about your first day at school? What do you remember about it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I remember my first day at school. I was six and I cried because I didn't want to leave my mum.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a common experience! Now, think about something you've done recently that you regret. Can you tell me about it using 'I wish' or 'If only'?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I wish I'd studied harder for my English test last week. I didn't get a good grade.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a great example! And if you could give advice to your past self, what would you say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would tell myself to work out a study plan and not leave everything to the last minute.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! You're using the grammar structures really well. Have you ever done something for the first time that was scary but exciting?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I went to a waterslide last summer. I was terrified at first, but in the end it was amazing!

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'I wish I _____ (go) to the party last night. Everyone said it was amazing!'
quiz.explanation: Untuk mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang masa lalu, gunakan 'I wish + past perfect'. Past perfect dari 'go' adalah 'had gone'.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses a separable phrasal verb?
quiz.explanation: 'Sort out' adalah phrasal verb yang dapat dipisahkan, jadi 'sorted the problem out' benar. 'Look into' tidak dapat dipisahkan, jadi harus 'looked into it' bukan 'looked it into'.

quiz.question: If only I _____ (take) a photo at the wedding!
quiz.explanation: 'If only' digunakan seperti 'I wish' untuk menyatakan penyesalan. Gunakan past perfect: 'had taken'.

quiz.question: What does 'carry out' mean in this sentence: 'The researchers carried out a study on children's memories'?
quiz.explanation: 'Carry out' dalam konteks ini berarti 'melaksanakan' atau 'menjalankan' penelitian atau tugas.

quiz.question: Which phrasal verb CANNOT be separated?
quiz.explanation: 'Look forward to' adalah phrasal verb yang tidak dapat dipisahkan. Harus selalu 'look forward to it', tidak bisa 'look it forward to'.

quiz.question: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses regret about the past:
options: I wish I study more for the exam.
I wish I'd studied more for the exam.
I wish I will study more for the exam.
quiz.answer: I wish I'd studied more for the exam.
quiz.explanation: Untuk menyatakan penyesalan tentang masa lalu, gunakan 'I wish + past perfect'. 'I'd studied' adalah bentuk pendek dari 'I had studied'.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan B2.1: Evaluasi Komprehensif Vantage Foundations
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level B2.2

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan B2.1 ini mengevaluasi kemampuan komprehensif Anda dalam empat keterampilan berbahasa: mendengarkan, membaca, menulis, dan berbicara. Ujian mencakup narrative tenses (Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect) untuk menceritakan peristiwa masa lalu, modals of deduction (must/might/can't have done) untuk menyimpulkan kemungkinan, passive voice dalam berbagai tenses, dan conditional sentences (zero, first, second, third) untuk situasi hipotesis. Anda akan menghadapi transkrip audio autentik, artikel kompleks, tugas menulis dengan struktur gramatikal presisi, dan simulasi debat/roleplay yang menuntut respons diplomatik dan persuasif. Passing score 75% menandakan kesiapan Anda untuk materi B2.2 yang lebih advanced.
rules: Narrative Tenses: Past Simple untuk aksi utama (I went), Past Continuous untuk latar belakang (I was walking), Past Perfect untuk aksi sebelum aksi lain (I had finished before she arrived)
Modals of Deduction: must have done (95% yakin positif), might/could have done (kemungkinan 50%), can't have done (95% yakin negatif) - She must have missed the train; He might have forgotten
Passive Voice: be + past participle - Present: is made, Past: was built, Present Perfect: has been designed, Future: will be launched - untuk fokus pada objek/hasil

Conditionals: Zero (If + present, present - fakta), First (If + present, will - kemungkinan masa depan), Second (If + past simple, would - hipotesis sekarang), Third (If + past perfect, would have - hipotesis masa lalu)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dalam Ujian Komprehensif B2.1
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa mencampuradukkan narrative tenses, terutama lupa menggunakan Past Perfect untuk menunjukkan urutan waktu yang jelas. Kesalahan lain adalah menggunakan modal deduction dengan tense yang salah (must do vs must have done) dan tertukar antara second dan third conditional.
commonTrap.wrong: When I arrived, she already left and was waiting for an hour. He must forget his keys yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: When I arrived, she had already left and had been waiting for an hour. He must have forgotten his keys yesterday.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan narrative tenses dengan benar untuk menunjukkan urutan kejadian di masa lalu?
options: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
By the time the police arrived, the thief escaped.
By the time the police arrived, the thief was escaping.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Past Perfect ('had escaped') digunakan untuk aksi yang terjadi lebih dulu sebelum aksi lain di masa lalu ('arrived').

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar untuk menyatakan deduksi logis tentang kejadian di masa lalu?
options: He must forget his keys because he is still outside.
He must have forgotten his keys because he is still outside.
He must be forgetting his keys because he is still outside.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Untuk deduksi masa lalu, struktur yang benar adalah 'must have + past participle' (must have forgotten).

readinessQuestions.prompt: Emma berkata: 'I always struggle with understanding native speakers at natural speed.' Manakah respons yang paling tepat dan mendukung sesuai konteks percakapan?
options: You should just stop listening to them until you are better at grammar.
It is impossible to understand them unless you have lived in an English-speaking country.
Don't worry, focus on the main ideas and context clues instead of every single word.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Fokus pada ide utama dan petunjuk konteks adalah strategi yang disarankan dalam dialog untuk membantu memahami native speaker.

vocab.collocation: The comprehensive exam covered all four language skills we had studied throughout the semester.
Based on her deduction from the evidence, she must have been at the scene when it happened.
The scientist's hypothesis about climate change was proven correct after years of research.
She gave a diplomatic response to avoid offending anyone during the heated debate.
His persuasive arguments convinced the committee to approve the new policy proposal.
Achieving proficiency in English at B2 level requires consistent practice in all four skills.
The evaluation of your speaking skills will be based on fluency, accuracy, and coherence.
The essay required a synthesis of ideas from multiple sources to support the argument.
Your answer should be coherent and logically structured to score high marks in writing.
The instructions were ambiguous, so many students misunderstood what they had to do.

dialogue.context: Dua mahasiswa, Emma dan David, berdiskusi tentang persiapan ujian kelulusan B2.1 mereka di perpustakaan kampus sehari sebelum ujian.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I've been reviewing narrative tenses all morning, but I'm still confused about when to use Past Perfect.
lines.translation: Aku sudah mengulang narrative tenses sepanjang pagi, tapi masih bingung kapan harus menggunakan Past Perfect.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: It's easier than you think. You use it when one past action happened before another past action. Like, 'I had already eaten when she arrived.'
lines.translation: Lebih mudah dari yang kamu pikirkan. Kamu menggunakannya ketika satu aksi masa lalu terjadi sebelum aksi masa lalu lainnya. Seperti, 'Aku sudah makan ketika dia tiba.'

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: That makes sense! What about the listening section? I always struggle with understanding native speakers at natural speed.
lines.translation: Itu masuk akal! Bagaimana dengan bagian listening? Aku selalu kesulitan memahami native speaker dengan kecepatan alami.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Try to focus on key words and context clues rather than every single word. You don't need to understand everything to get the main idea.
lines.translation: Coba fokus pada kata kunci dan petunjuk konteks daripada setiap kata. Kamu tidak perlu memahami semuanya untuk mendapatkan ide utama.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Good advice! I'm most worried about the speaking section though. What if I freeze up during the roleplay?
lines.translation: Saran yang bagus! Tapi aku paling khawatir tentang bagian speaking. Bagaimana kalau aku grogi saat roleplay?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Just remember to stay calm and use the phrases we practiced. Even if you make mistakes, keep talking and show you can communicate effectively.
lines.translation: Ingat saja untuk tetap tenang dan gunakan frasa yang sudah kita latih. Meskipun kamu membuat kesalahan, terus bicara dan tunjukkan bahwa kamu bisa berkomunikasi dengan efektif.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: You're right. I guess I've prepared as much as I can. We should both get a good night's sleep before tomorrow.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Sepertinya aku sudah mempersiapkan sebanyak yang bisa. Kita berdua harus tidur yang cukup sebelum besok.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Absolutely. We'll do great if we trust our preparation. Good luck, Emma!
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Kita akan hebat kalau kita percaya pada persiapan kita. Semoga berhasil, Emma!

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih dengan Mr. Khoirul untuk mempersiapkan bagian speaking dalam ujian kelulusan B2.1. Beliau akan memberikan skenario roleplay di mana Anda harus memberikan argumen persuasif dan respons diplomatik.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Welcome to your speaking practice session. Today we'll simulate the exam scenario. Imagine you're in a debate about online versus traditional education. You'll argue for online education. Are you ready?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm ready, Mr. Khoirul. I believe online education offers incredible flexibility and accessibility that traditional classrooms can't match.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting point. But don't you think face-to-face interaction is crucial for developing social skills? How would you respond to that criticism?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's a valid concern, but online platforms now offer video conferencing, group projects, and discussion forums that facilitate meaningful interaction. Students can collaborate globally, which actually enhances their communication skills.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good argument! Now, let's switch gears. Tell me about a time when you had to change your plans unexpectedly. Use narrative tenses to describe what happened.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Last year, I had been planning a trip for months when suddenly the pandemic restrictions were announced. I had already booked my flights when I heard the news, so I had to cancel everything and reorganize.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of Past Perfect! One final question: If you could have studied anything differently during B2.1, what would it have been?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: If I had practiced speaking more consistently from the beginning, I would have felt more confident now. I realize I should have prioritized conversation practice alongside grammar study.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Good morning, listeners. Yesterday's train accident near Manchester has raised serious questions about rail safety. Witnesses reported that the train had been traveling at high speed when it suddenly derailed. Investigators believe the driver might have missed a warning signal, though this hasn't been confirmed yet. The accident could have been much worse if the emergency brakes hadn't been activated in time.' Based on the audio, what can we deduce about the accident?
options: The driver definitely missed the warning signal
The accident might have been caused by a missed signal
The emergency brakes failed to work
The train was traveling slowly when it derailed
quiz.answer: The accident might have been caused by a missed signal
quiz.explanation: Kata 'might have missed' menunjukkan modal of deduction dengan tingkat kepastian sedang (kemungkinan). Pilihan pertama terlalu pasti (definitely), pilihan ketiga salah karena rem bekerja, dan pilihan keempat bertentangan dengan 'high speed'.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Maria, I can't believe you've already finished the report! When I left the office at 6 PM yesterday, you were still gathering data. You must have worked until very late.' 'Actually, I had completed most of the analysis before you left. I just needed to write the summary, which took about an hour.' What had Maria done before her colleague left?
options: She had completed most of the analysis
She must have worked until very late
quiz.answer: She had completed most of the analysis
quiz.explanation: Maria secara eksplisit mengatakan 'I had completed most of the analysis before you left', menggunakan Past Perfect untuk menunjukkan aksi yang selesai sebelum waktu lampau lainnya (before you left). Ini adalah penggunaan narrative tenses yang tepat.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'The new community center will be opened by the mayor next month. It has been designed by award-winning architects and is being built with sustainable materials. Local residents say the project should have been completed last year, but delays couldn't have been avoided due to funding issues.' Which statement about the community center is correct?
options: It was opened last month by the mayor
It is being built with sustainable materials
The delays could have been avoided easily
It had been designed by local residents
quiz.answer: It is being built with sustainable materials
quiz.explanation: Kalimat 'is being built with sustainable materials' menggunakan Present Continuous Passive yang benar untuk proyek yang sedang berlangsung. Pilihan lain salah: proyek belum dibuka (will be opened), delays couldn't be avoided (bukan could have been), dan yang mendesain adalah arsitek, bukan residents.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'If we had invested in renewable energy ten years ago, we wouldn't be facing this crisis now. But it's not too late. If we start implementing changes today, we will see significant improvements within five years. However, if governments don't take action soon, the situation might become irreversible.' Which conditional is NOT used in this transcript?
quiz.explanation: Transkrip menggunakan third conditional ('If we had invested... we wouldn't be facing'), first conditional ('If we start... we will see'), dan implied second conditional. Zero conditional (If + present, present) untuk fakta umum tidak muncul dalam transkrip ini.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Climate scientists have long warned that rising global temperatures are causing irreversible damage to ecosystems. Recent studies suggest that if current trends continue, many species could become extinct within the next century. However, the situation might not be entirely hopeless. Innovative conservation programs have been implemented across the globe, and some endangered populations are showing signs of recovery. These programs must have cost billions of dollars, but experts argue the investment is essential for planetary survival.' What can we infer about conservation programs?
options: They have definitely cost billions of dollars
They are probably very expensive based on the context
They haven't been successful at all
They will completely reverse climate change
quiz.answer: They are probably very expensive based on the context
quiz.explanation: Frasa 'must have cost billions' adalah modal of deduction yang menunjukkan kesimpulan logis dengan tingkat kepastian tinggi (95%), bukan fakta pasti. Penulis menyimpulkan biaya tinggi berdasarkan skala global program. Pilihan pertama terlalu absolut, pilihan ketiga salah (ada tanda recovery), pilihan keempat tidak disebutkan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'The industrial revolution transformed society in ways nobody could have predicted. Before factories were built, most people had been working in agriculture for centuries. When mechanization was introduced, traditional ways of life were disrupted almost overnight. Workers who had spent their entire lives farming suddenly found themselves in urban factories. If the government had provided better support during this transition, the social upheaval might have been less severe.' According to the passage, what happened to agricultural workers?
options: They continued farming after factories were built
They had been working in agriculture before the industrial revolution
They predicted the industrial revolution accurately
quiz.answer: They had been working in agriculture before the industrial revolution
quiz.explanation: Kalimat 'most people had been working in agriculture for centuries' menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous untuk menunjukkan aktivitas berkelanjutan di masa lalu sebelum perubahan terjadi. Ini adalah narrative tense yang menggambarkan latar belakang sebelum peristiwa utama (industrialisasi).

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the job market. Many routine tasks are now being automated by machines, and experts predict that millions of jobs will be replaced by AI within the next decade. While some people fear this technological revolution, others argue that new opportunities are being created in fields like AI development, data analysis, and digital marketing. The key question is whether workers can be retrained quickly enough to adapt to these changes.' What is currently happening to routine tasks?
options: They will be automated in the future
They have been automated by machines
They are being automated by machines now
quiz.answer: They are being automated by machines now
quiz.explanation: Kalimat 'are now being automated' menggunakan Present Continuous Passive untuk menekankan proses yang sedang berlangsung saat ini. Passive voice digunakan karena fokus pada 'routine tasks' (objek) yang mengalami otomasi, bukan pada mesin (subjek) yang melakukan otomasi.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Dr. Sarah Chen's groundbreaking research on neural networks has earned her international recognition. Her team discovered that if certain algorithms are modified in specific ways, machine learning systems can achieve unprecedented accuracy. She stated, "If we had known about these modifications five years ago, we would have saved countless hours of research. But now that we understand the principles, future developments should proceed much faster."' What does Dr. Chen suggest about past research?
options: It would have been more efficient with current knowledge
It was completely unnecessary and wasteful
It will be improved next year
It should proceed much faster now
quiz.answer: It would have been more efficient with current knowledge
quiz.explanation: Dr. Chen menggunakan third conditional ('If we had known... we would have saved') untuk mengekspresikan penyesalan tentang masa lalu—situasi hipotesis yang tidak terjadi. Dia menyiratkan penelitian masa lalu bisa lebih efisien jika mereka sudah tahu modifikasi tersebut, tanpa mengatakan penelitian itu sia-sia.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Rewrite using the passive voice: 'The committee will announce the exam results next Friday.'
options: The exam results will be announced by the committee next Friday.
The exam results are announced by the committee next Friday.
The exam results will announce next Friday.
The exam results have been announced by the committee next Friday.
quiz.answer: The exam results will be announced by the committee next Friday.
quiz.explanation: Future passive dibentuk dengan 'will be + past participle'. Pilihan kedua salah tense (present), pilihan ketiga tidak grammatikal (results tidak bisa 'announce' sendiri), pilihan keempat salah tense (present perfect tidak cocok dengan 'next Friday').

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete with the correct modal of deduction: 'Look at all these empty coffee cups on her desk. She ___ working all night on the project.'
quiz.explanation: 'Must have been' menunjukkan deduksi dengan kepastian tinggi (95%) tentang situasi masa lalu berdasarkan bukti present (empty coffee cups). 'Must have been working' menggunakan Past Perfect Continuous untuk aksi berkelanjutan di masa lalu yang disimpulkan dari bukti sekarang.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct conditional form: 'If the train ___ on time yesterday, I ___ late for the interview.'
quiz.explanation: Third conditional digunakan untuk situasi hipotesis di masa lalu yang tidak terjadi. Struktur: If + past perfect, would have + past participle. Konteks 'yesterday' mengkonfirmasi ini adalah situasi past unreal, bukan present atau future.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Identify the error in narrative tenses: 'When I arrived at the cinema, the movie already started and my friends were waiting for me for 30 minutes.'
options: Should be: had already started / had been waiting
Should be: already starts / are waiting
Should be: has already started / have been waiting
The sentence is correct as written
quiz.answer: Should be: had already started / had been waiting
quiz.explanation: Kedua aksi (movie starting, friends waiting) terjadi SEBELUM 'I arrived', sehingga memerlukan Past Perfect untuk menunjukkan urutan waktu. 'Had already started' untuk aksi selesai, 'had been waiting for 30 minutes' untuk aksi berkelanjutan sebelum titik waktu lampau tersebut.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your colleague criticizes your presentation style aggressively in a meeting. What is the most diplomatic response?
options: I appreciate your feedback, though I'd be happy to discuss specific suggestions after the meeting.
You're completely wrong and don't understand my approach at all.
Why are you always so negative about everything I do?
That's your opinion, but I don't really care what you think.
quiz.answer: I appreciate your feedback, though I'd be happy to discuss specific suggestions after the meeting.
quiz.explanation: Respons diplomatis mengakui perspektif orang lain ('I appreciate') sambil menetapkan batasan profesional ('after the meeting'). Ini menunjukkan kematangan emosional dan kemampuan mengelola konflik secara konstruktif—keterampilan penting di level B2 untuk situasi profesional.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] In a debate about remote work, your opponent says: 'Remote work destroys company culture completely.' How do you respond persuasively?
options: I understand your concern, but research shows remote teams can build strong culture through intentional virtual activities and clear communication.
That's absolutely ridiculous and shows you know nothing about modern work.
I don't agree with you at all.
quiz.answer: I understand your concern, but research shows remote teams can build strong culture through intentional virtual activities and clear communication.
quiz.explanation: Argumen persuasif yang efektif dimulai dengan validasi ('I understand your concern'), kemudian memberikan counter-argument berdasarkan bukti ('research shows') dengan solusi konkret. Ini menunjukkan kemampuan berdebat secara intelektual dan diplomatis di level B2.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You need to decline your manager's request to work overtime this weekend. What's the most appropriate way to refuse?
options: I'd really like to help, but I have prior commitments this weekend that I can't reschedule. Could we discuss alternative solutions?
No, I don't work weekends ever.
That's not in my job description, so I refuse.
I suppose I could, but I really don't want to.
quiz.answer: I'd really like to help, but I have prior commitments this weekend that I can't reschedule. Could we discuss alternative solutions?
quiz.explanation: Penolakan profesional menunjukkan keinginan untuk membantu ('I'd like to help'), memberikan alasan valid tanpa detail berlebihan ('prior commitments'), dan menawarkan kolaborasi ('alternative solutions'). Ini adalah soft skill komunikasi penting untuk lingkungan profesional.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] During a group discussion, two team members strongly disagree. As the moderator, what should you say?
options: Both perspectives have merit. Let's explore what common ground we can find and build from there.
You're both wrong, so let's just move on.
Stop arguing and just agree with each other.
I think one of you should just leave the meeting.
quiz.answer: Both perspectives have merit. Let's explore what common ground we can find and build from there.
quiz.explanation: Moderasi yang efektif mengakui validitas kedua sisi ('both perspectives have merit'), mengarahkan diskusi ke solusi konstruktif ('common ground'), dan mempertahankan lingkungan kolaboratif. Ini mendemonstrasikan leadership communication skills yang diharapkan di level B2 dalam konteks profesional.

modules.title: Corporate Governance, Ethics & Whistleblowing Policies
modules.objective: Mendiskusikan etika korporasi, tanggung jawab hukum perusahaan, dan perlindungan pelapor pelanggaran.

theory.summary: Corporate governance mengacu pada sistem aturan, praktik, dan proses yang mengatur bagaimana perusahaan diarahkan dan dikendalikan. Di level B2, Anda perlu menguasai kosakata formal untuk mendiskusikan etika bisnis, akuntabilitas korporat, dan mekanisme perlindungan whistleblower (pelapor pelanggaran). Topik ini sering muncul dalam konteks profesional seperti rapat dewan direksi, audit kepatuhan, dan diskusi kebijakan perusahaan. Kemampuan menggunakan struktur formal seperti passive voice, modal verbs untuk kewajiban (must, should, ought to), dan conditional sentences sangat penting untuk menyampaikan argumen yang kredibel.
rules: Gunakan passive voice untuk menekankan tindakan dan kebijakan, bukan pelaku: 'Violations must be reported' lebih formal daripada 'Employees must report violations'
Modal verbs untuk kewajiban dan rekomendasi: 'shall' (kewajiban hukum), 'must' (kewajiban kuat), 'should/ought to' (rekomendasi), 'may' (izin). Contoh: 'The board shall establish an ethics committee'
Formal conjunctions dan discourse markers: 'furthermore', 'consequently', 'notwithstanding', 'whereby'. Contoh: 'The company implemented a hotline, whereby employees can report anonymously'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Register Formal vs Informal
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar B2 mencampur register informal dalam konteks korporat formal. Dalam dokumen kebijakan atau presentasi bisnis, hindari phrasal verbs informal dan gunakan padanan formal.
commonTrap.wrong: The company needs to look into the complaint and figure out what went wrong.
commonTrap.correct: The organization must investigate the allegation and determine the root cause of the misconduct.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan passive voice dengan tepat untuk kebijakan formal?
options: The compliance department must investigated the misconduct.
Misconduct must be investigated by the compliance department.
The compliance department must be investigate the misconduct.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Passive voice dibentuk dengan 'be + past participle' (must be investigated). Pilihan 0 dan 2 salah secara tata bahasa karena penggunaan kata kerja yang tidak tepat setelah modal verb.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang paling tepat untuk dokumen kebijakan formal (menghindari phrasal verbs informal).
options: We need to look into the issue and figure out what happened.
The organization must investigate the allegation and determine the root cause.
The company has to check out the problem and sort it out.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam konteks korporat formal, hindari phrasal verbs seperti 'look into', 'figure out', 'check out', dan 'sort out'. Gunakan kata kerja formal seperti 'investigate' dan 'determine' untuk menjaga profesionalisme.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut: 'The company implemented a new system, [...] employees can submit reports without fear of identification.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Whereby' adalah formal conjunction yang berarti 'by which' atau 'melalui sistem tersebut', yang sangat tepat digunakan dalam konteks kebijakan formal untuk menjelaskan mekanisme suatu proses.

vocab.collocation: The board of directors is responsible for ensuring effective corporate governance across all departments.

vocab.meaning: pelapor pelanggaran, orang yang melaporkan tindakan tidak etis dalam organisasi
vocab.collocation: The company has established a confidential hotline to protect whistleblowers from retaliation.

vocab.meaning: akuntabilitas, tanggung jawab untuk mempertanggungjawabkan tindakan
vocab.collocation: Senior executives must demonstrate accountability for their strategic decisions and financial performance.
Our compliance officer ensures that all operations adhere to regulatory requirements and industry standards.

vocab.meaning: fidusia, berkaitan dengan kepercayaan mengelola aset orang lain
vocab.collocation: Board members have a fiduciary duty to act in the best interests of shareholders.

vocab.meaning: pelanggaran, perilaku tidak profesional atau tidak etis
vocab.collocation: The investigation revealed serious misconduct involving falsification of financial records.
Greater transparency in executive compensation has become a priority for stakeholders.
The policy explicitly prohibits any form of retaliation against employees who report violations.
Effective governance requires balancing the interests of various stakeholders including employees, investors, and customers.
The audit committee is reviewing allegations of insider trading involving senior management.

dialogue.context: Sarah, seorang Compliance Officer, sedang menjelaskan kebijakan whistleblowing yang baru kepada David, seorang manager departemen, dalam rapat pelatihan etika korporat.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: David, I'd like to walk you through our updated whistleblowing policy. The board has mandated enhanced protections for employees who report misconduct.
lines.translation: David, saya ingin menjelaskan kebijakan whistleblowing terbaru kita. Dewan direksi telah mewajibkan perlindungan yang lebih kuat bagi karyawan yang melaporkan pelanggaran.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That's reassuring. What specific measures have been implemented to prevent retaliation against whistleblowers?
lines.translation: Itu menenangkan. Langkah-langkah spesifik apa yang telah diterapkan untuk mencegah pembalasan terhadap pelapor pelanggaran?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Firstly, we've established a confidential hotline managed by an independent third party. Employees can report anonymously without fear of identification.
lines.translation: Pertama, kami telah membuat hotline rahasia yang dikelola oleh pihak ketiga independen. Karyawan dapat melaporkan secara anonim tanpa takut identitasnya terungkap.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: What happens after an allegation is submitted? How does the investigation process work?
lines.translation: Apa yang terjadi setelah tuduhan diajukan? Bagaimana proses investigasinya berjalan?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: The ethics committee reviews all allegations within 48 hours. Serious cases involving senior management are escalated directly to the audit committee for impartial investigation.
lines.translation: Komite etika meninjau semua tuduhan dalam waktu 48 jam. Kasus serius yang melibatkan manajemen senior langsung dieskalasi ke komite audit untuk investigasi yang tidak memihak.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I appreciate the transparency. How should I communicate this policy to my team effectively?
lines.translation: Saya menghargai transparansinya. Bagaimana sebaiknya saya mengomunikasikan kebijakan ini kepada tim saya secara efektif?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Emphasize that reporting is not only protected but encouraged. Whistleblowers play a crucial role in maintaining our organizational integrity and stakeholder trust.
lines.translation: Tekankan bahwa pelaporan tidak hanya dilindungi tetapi juga didorong. Pelapor pelanggaran berperan penting dalam menjaga integritas organisasi dan kepercayaan pemangku kepentingan kita.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Understood. I'll schedule a team meeting next week to ensure everyone is aware of their rights and responsibilities under this policy.
lines.translation: Mengerti. Saya akan menjadwalkan rapat tim minggu depan untuk memastikan semua orang memahami hak dan tanggung jawab mereka dalam kebijakan ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang Ethics Director yang sedang melakukan sesi role-play dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang cara menangani laporan pelanggaran etika dari seorang karyawan. Praktikkan penggunaan bahasa formal dan struktur argumen yang jelas.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon. Thank you for meeting with me confidentially. I'm here representing an employee who has witnessed potential financial misconduct. How should we proceed?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon. I appreciate you coming forward. First, let me assure you that all allegations are treated with strict confidentiality. Could you describe the nature of the misconduct you've observed?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: The employee noticed irregularities in expense reports submitted by a senior manager—specifically, claims for personal expenses being categorized as business-related. What protections are available?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's a serious allegation. Our whistleblower policy prohibits any form of retaliation against employees who report in good faith. We also offer anonymous reporting options if the employee prefers.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: The employee is concerned about career implications, given the manager's influence. How does the company ensure protection in practice?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We maintain strict documentation of the reporting timeline. If any adverse employment action occurs afterward, our policy presumes retaliation unless proven otherwise. Additionally, the investigation will be conducted by an independent committee.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's encouraging. What's the expected timeline for the investigation, and how will the employee be kept informed?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The ethics committee will initiate a preliminary review within 48 hours. We'll provide periodic updates while maintaining confidentiality. The employee can expect a resolution within three to four weeks, depending on complexity.

quiz.question: The board of directors has a ___ duty to act in the best interests of the shareholders and ensure proper oversight.
quiz.explanation: Fiduciary duty adalah istilah hukum yang merujuk pada kewajiban kepercayaan untuk mengelola kepentingan orang lain (dalam hal ini pemegang saham). Kata 'mandatory' berarti wajib tetapi tidak spesifik untuk konteks kepercayaan korporat, dan 'voluntary' berarti sukarela yang bertentangan dengan konsep kewajiban.

quiz.question: The company implemented a confidential hotline ___ employees can report ethical violations without fear of identification.
quiz.explanation: Whereby adalah conjunction formal yang berarti 'dengan cara mana' atau 'melalui mana', digunakan untuk menjelaskan metode atau mekanisme. 'Therefore' menunjukkan akibat, dan 'although' menunjukkan kontras, keduanya tidak sesuai dengan konteks menjelaskan fungsi hotline.

quiz.question: Any form of ___ against whistleblowers is strictly prohibited under our corporate governance policy.
quiz.explanation: Retaliation (pembalasan) adalah istilah yang tepat untuk tindakan balas dendam terhadap pelapor pelanggaran. 'Compensation' berarti kompensasi (positif), dan 'appreciation' berarti apresiasi, keduanya tidak masuk akal dalam konteks larangan.

quiz.question: The audit committee must investigate all ___ of financial misconduct, regardless of the seniority of the individuals involved.
quiz.explanation: Allegations (tuduhan) adalah istilah formal untuk klaim pelanggaran yang belum terbukti, yang harus diselidiki. 'Confirmations' berarti konfirmasi (sudah pasti), sementara 'celebrations' berarti perayaan, keduanya tidak relevan dengan konteks investigasi pelanggaran.

quiz.question: Effective corporate governance requires balancing the interests of various ___, including employees, investors, customers, and the wider community.
quiz.explanation: Stakeholders (pemangku kepentingan) adalah istilah standar dalam corporate governance untuk semua pihak yang terpengaruh oleh keputusan perusahaan. 'Spectators' berarti penonton (pasif), dan 'competitors' berarti pesaing (eksternal), keduanya tidak mencakup pengertian pihak berkepentingan yang luas.

modules.title: Advanced Inversion for Dramatic Emphasis & Formal Oratory
modules.objective: Menguasai struktur inversi negatif (Never have I..., Seldom do we..., Not only... but also...).

theory.summary: Inversi adalah teknik membalik urutan subjek dan kata kerja bantu untuk memberikan penekanan dramatis, terutama dalam pidato formal, tulisan akademis, dan konteks retoris. Di level B2, kamu akan menguasai inversi dengan kata keterangan negatif (negative adverbials) yang memberikan nuansa kuat dan meyakinkan pada pernyataanmu. Struktur ini sangat berguna dalam presentasi profesional, esai argumentatif, dan diskusi formal.
rules: Formula Inversi Negatif: Negative Adverbial + Auxiliary Verb + Subject + Main Verb. Contoh: 'Never have I seen such dedication' (bukan 'I have never seen'). Kata negatif di awal kalimat memicu inversi seperti pertanyaan.

Kata Negatif yang Memicu Inversi: Never, seldom, rarely, hardly, scarcely, barely, not only, no sooner, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way, little, only after, only when. Contoh: 'Seldom do we encounter such opportunities' atau 'Rarely has the team performed this well'.

Struktur 'Not only... but also': Not only + auxiliary + subject + verb..., but (subject) also + verb. Contoh: 'Not only did she complete the project, but she also exceeded expectations.' Inversi hanya terjadi pada klausa pertama setelah 'not only'.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Inversi dengan Kata Kerja Utama
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering melakukan inversi langsung dengan kata kerja utama tanpa auxiliary verb, terutama dengan Simple Present dan Simple Past. Ingat: kamu HARUS menggunakan 'do/does/did' sebagai auxiliary jika tidak ada auxiliary verb lain (have, will, can, etc.).
commonTrap.wrong: Never saw I such a beautiful sunset. / Seldom goes he to the gym.
commonTrap.correct: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset. / Seldom does he go to the gym.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan struktur inversi negatif dengan benar untuk memberikan penekanan dramatis.
options: Rarely have I seen such an unprecedented level of commitment from the team.
Rarely I have seen such an unprecedented level of commitment from the team.
Rarely I seen such an unprecedented level of commitment from the team.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur inversi negatif yang benar adalah Negative Adverbial (Rarely) + Auxiliary Verb (have) + Subject (I) + Main Verb (seen).

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar dalam menerapkan aturan inversi untuk kalimat Simple Present?
options: Seldom he goes to the office on weekends.
Seldom does he go to the office on weekends.
Seldom goes he to the office on weekends.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam Simple Present, kita harus menggunakan auxiliary verb 'does' untuk melakukan inversi. Opsi 0 tidak melakukan inversi, dan opsi 2 salah karena melakukan inversi langsung dengan kata kerja utama.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi dialog berikut untuk memberikan penekanan pada keberhasilan proyek: 'Our new marketing campaign was a huge success. [...]'
options: Not only did it attract new customers, but it also boosted our brand awareness.
Not only it attracted new customers, but also it boosted our brand awareness.
Not only did it attract new customers, but it boosted also our brand awareness.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur 'Not only... but also' memerlukan inversi pada klausa pertama (did it attract) dan penempatan 'also' yang tepat sebelum kata kerja kedua.

vocab.meaning: seni berbicara di depan umum; pidato formal
vocab.collocation: His oratory skills impressed the entire conference audience.
Scarcely had we arrived when the ceremony began.
Never before have we witnessed such unprecedented economic growth.
Seldom do politicians admit their mistakes publicly.
Not only was her argument compelling, but it was also backed by solid evidence.
Under no circumstances should you compromise your integrity.
Barely had the meeting started when technical issues arose.
Little did they know that effective rhetoric would change the outcome.
Only by using inversion can we achieve such dramatic emphasis.
Rarely have I witnessed such dedication to a single cause.

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang melatih koleganya, James, untuk presentasi penting di hadapan dewan direksi. Mereka membahas cara menggunakan inversi untuk membuat argumen lebih bertenaga.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: James, your content is solid, but it lacks punch. Try this: 'Never before have we faced such a critical moment in our company's history.'
lines.translation: James, kontenmu bagus, tapi kurang bertenaga. Coba ini: 'Tidak pernah sebelumnya kita menghadapi momen sekritis ini dalam sejarah perusahaan kita.'

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Oh, I see! So instead of saying 'We have never faced,' I put 'never' first and flip the order?
lines.translation: Oh, aku paham! Jadi daripada mengatakan 'Kita tidak pernah menghadapi,' aku taruh 'never' di depan dan balik urutannya?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Exactly! It creates dramatic emphasis. You can also use 'not only... but also.' For example: 'Not only will this strategy increase revenue, but it will also strengthen our market position.'
lines.translation: Tepat sekali! Ini menciptakan penekanan dramatis. Kamu juga bisa pakai 'not only... but also.' Contoh: 'Strategi ini tidak hanya akan meningkatkan pendapatan, tapi juga memperkuat posisi pasar kita.'

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: That's powerful! What about other negative words? Can I use 'rarely' or 'seldom'?
lines.translation: Itu kuat! Bagaimana dengan kata negatif lain? Bisakah aku pakai 'rarely' atau 'seldom'?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Absolutely. 'Seldom do we get opportunities like this' sounds much more formal than 'We seldom get opportunities.' Just remember to use the auxiliary verb.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. 'Seldom do we get opportunities like this' terdengar jauh lebih formal daripada 'We seldom get opportunities.' Ingat saja untuk pakai kata kerja bantu.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Got it. So 'Rarely has our team achieved such results' instead of 'Our team has rarely achieved'?
lines.translation: Mengerti. Jadi 'Rarely has our team achieved such results' daripada 'Our team has rarely achieved'?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Perfect! You're getting it. Use this technique at key moments in your presentation—the opening, crucial arguments, and closing. It'll make your speech memorable.
lines.translation: Sempurna! Kamu paham. Gunakan teknik ini di momen kunci presentasimu—pembukaan, argumen penting, dan penutup. Ini akan membuat pidatomu berkesan.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Under no circumstances will I forget this advice! See what I did there?
lines.translation: Dalam kondisi apapun aku tidak akan lupa saran ini! Lihat apa yang baru kulakukan?

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berlatih pidato formal bersama Mr. Khoirul untuk sebuah konferensi akademis. Mr. Khoirul akan membimbingmu menggunakan struktur inversi untuk membuat argumenmu lebih meyakinkan dan bertenaga.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice using inversion to make your academic presentation more powerful. Let's start with your opening. How would you normally say 'We have never seen such rapid technological change'?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would say: Never have we seen such rapid technological change.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! That's much more dramatic. Now, try using 'not only... but also' to discuss the benefits of your research. Give me a sentence about how your study helps both theory and practice.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Not only does this research advance theoretical understanding, but it also provides practical applications for industry.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect inversion! Now let's try 'seldom' or 'rarely.' Tell me about how often researchers have this kind of data access. Make it sound formal and emphatic.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Seldom do researchers have access to such comprehensive datasets in this field.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful! For your closing, use 'under no circumstances' to emphasize something that should never happen regarding ethics or methodology. What would you say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Under no circumstances should we compromise the integrity of our research methods or overlook ethical considerations.

quiz.question: Never ___ such a compelling argument in a business presentation.
quiz.explanation: Setelah kata negatif 'never' di awal kalimat, kita harus melakukan inversi dengan membalik posisi auxiliary verb 'have' dan subjek 'I'. Formula: Never + auxiliary + subject + past participle.

quiz.question: Not only ___ the deadline, but she also exceeded all quality expectations.
quiz.explanation: Dalam struktur 'not only... but also', inversi terjadi pada klausa pertama setelah 'not only'. Karena menggunakan Simple Past dan tidak ada auxiliary verb lain, kita perlu 'did' sebagai auxiliary: Not only + did + subject + verb.

quiz.question: Seldom ___ politicians admit their mistakes in public forums.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'seldom' di awal kalimat, kita perlu inversi dengan auxiliary verb. Subjeknya adalah 'politicians' (jamak), jadi kita gunakan 'do', bukan 'does'. Formula: Seldom + do + subject (plural) + verb.

quiz.question: Under no circumstances ___ compromise our ethical standards for profit.
quiz.explanation: Frasa negatif 'under no circumstances' di awal kalimat memicu inversi. Modal verb 'should' berpindah ke depan subjek 'we'. Formula: Under no circumstances + modal + subject + verb.

quiz.question: Rarely ___ witnessed such dedication to environmental conservation.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'rarely', terjadi inversi dengan auxiliary verb 'has' (karena subjek 'the community' adalah singular) berpindah ke depan subjek. Formula: Rarely + has + singular subject + past participle.

modules.title: Global Supply Chains, Geopolitics & Logistics Crisis Management
modules.objective: Menganalisis disrupsi rantai pasok global, embargo dagang, dan manajemen krisis transportasi internasional.

theory.summary: Rantai pasok global (global supply chain) adalah jaringan kompleks yang menghubungkan pemasok, produsen, distributor, dan konsumen di seluruh dunia. Di level B2, Anda perlu menguasai bahasa teknis untuk menganalisis disrupsi seperti embargo dagang, krisis transportasi, dan strategi mitigasi risiko. Modul ini mengajarkan vocabulary spesialis logistik, struktur kalimat untuk risk assessment, serta cara menyampaikan contingency planning dalam konteks bisnis internasional. Anda akan belajar menggunakan conditional sentences untuk skenario krisis, passive voice untuk laporan formal, dan modal verbs untuk rekomendasi strategis.
rules: Gunakan present perfect untuk mendeskripsikan disrupsi yang berdampak hingga sekarang: 'The blockage has disrupted shipping routes for weeks' atau 'Sanctions have severely impacted our procurement process'

Gunakan conditional type 2 dan 3 untuk analisis skenario: 'If the conflict escalated, supply chains would collapse' (hipotesis) atau 'If we had diversified suppliers earlier, we would have avoided this bottleneck' (masa lalu)
Gunakan passive voice dalam laporan formal: 'Alternative routes are being explored' atau 'The embargo was imposed without prior notice' untuk fokus pada tindakan, bukan pelaku
Gunakan modal verbs untuk rekomendasi: 'We should diversify suppliers', 'Companies must implement risk assessment protocols', 'We might need to consider nearshoring strategies'
Gunakan causative structures untuk menjelaskan dampak: 'The trade restrictions have caused delays' atau 'Geopolitical tensions are forcing companies to rethink their strategies'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Tenses dalam Risk Analysis
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak learner B2 salah menggunakan simple past untuk situasi yang masih berlangsung, atau lupa menggunakan conditional yang tepat saat membahas skenario hipotetis. Dalam konteks supply chain crisis, penting membedakan antara kejadian selesai vs dampak berkelanjutan.
commonTrap.wrong: The sanctions disrupted our supply chain (terlalu sederhana, tidak menunjukkan dampak berkelanjutan)
commonTrap.correct: The sanctions have disrupted our supply chain, and we are still facing significant delays (present perfect + present continuous menunjukkan dampak yang masih berlangsung)

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang paling tepat untuk mendeskripsikan disrupsi rantai pasok yang dampaknya masih terasa hingga saat ini.
options: The trade embargo has disrupted our production, and we are still struggling to find alternatives.
The trade embargo disrupted our production last month.
The trade embargo is disrupting our production since last month.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Present perfect ('has disrupted') digunakan untuk kejadian yang dimulai di masa lalu dan dampaknya masih berlanjut hingga sekarang. Pilihan kedua menggunakan simple past (kejadian sudah selesai), dan pilihan ketiga salah secara tata bahasa karena menggabungkan 'is disrupting' dengan 'since'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk menunjukkan dampak berkelanjutan dari sebuah krisis logistik?
options: The port congestion caused delays in our shipments last week.
The port congestion has caused significant delays in our shipments, and the situation remains critical.
The port congestion had caused significant delays in our shipments last week.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Untuk menunjukkan dampak yang masih berlangsung, kita harus menggunakan present perfect ('has caused') diikuti dengan keterangan situasi saat ini. Simple past atau past perfect menyiratkan bahwa masalah tersebut sudah selesai atau terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Sarah dan David sedang mendiskusikan krisis pasokan. Lengkapi kalimat David berikut: 'If we had diversified our suppliers earlier, we [...] this bottleneck.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: Ini adalah Conditional Type 3 yang digunakan untuk situasi hipotetis di masa lalu. Rumusnya adalah 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle'. Pilihan 'would avoid' adalah Conditional Type 2 (untuk masa kini/depan), dan 'will avoid' adalah Conditional Type 1.

vocab.collocation: The pandemic caused massive disruptions to global supply chains, forcing companies to seek alternative suppliers.
The government imposed a trade embargo on the country, prohibiting all exports of strategic materials.
Port congestion has created a major bottleneck in the distribution network, delaying shipments by weeks.
We need to develop a comprehensive contingency plan to address potential supply chain failures.
Our procurement team is exploring alternative sources to mitigate the risk of supplier dependency.
Economic sanctions have restricted access to key components, forcing manufacturers to redesign products.
Building supply chain resilience requires investment in redundancy and diversification strategies.
Geographic diversification of suppliers can reduce vulnerability to regional disruptions and political instability.
Air freight costs have skyrocketed due to limited capacity and increased demand during the crisis.
Risk mitigation strategies include maintaining buffer inventory and establishing relationships with multiple vendors.

dialogue.context: Sarah, seorang Supply Chain Manager, sedang berdiskusi dengan David, Chief Operations Officer, mengenai dampak ketegangan geopolitik terhadap operasional perusahaan mereka dan strategi mitigasi yang perlu diterapkan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: David, I need to brief you on the latest developments. The trade sanctions imposed last week have severely disrupted our component procurement from Eastern Europe.
lines.translation: David, saya perlu memberi briefing tentang perkembangan terkini. Sanksi perdagangan yang diberlakukan minggu lalu telah sangat mengganggu pengadaan komponen kita dari Eropa Timur.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: How critical is the situation? Are we looking at a complete halt in production, or do we have some buffer inventory to work with?
lines.translation: Seberapa kritis situasinya? Apakah kita menghadapi penghentian produksi total, atau kita punya stok penyangga untuk digunakan?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: We have approximately three weeks of inventory left. I've already activated our contingency plan and reached out to alternative suppliers in Southeast Asia and Latin America.
lines.translation: Kita punya persediaan sekitar tiga minggu lagi. Saya sudah mengaktifkan rencana darurat kita dan menghubungi pemasok alternatif di Asia Tenggara dan Amerika Latin.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Good thinking. What about freight costs? I imagine air freight would be prohibitively expensive given the current capacity constraints.
lines.translation: Pemikiran yang bagus. Bagaimana dengan biaya angkutan? Saya bayangkan angkutan udara akan sangat mahal mengingat keterbatasan kapasitas saat ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. Air freight costs have tripled, so I'm proposing a hybrid approach: emergency air shipments for critical components and sea freight for less urgent materials, even though it adds two weeks to lead time.
lines.translation: Anda benar. Biaya angkutan udara naik tiga kali lipat, jadi saya mengusulkan pendekatan hybrid: pengiriman udara darurat untuk komponen kritis dan angkutan laut untuk material yang kurang mendesak, meskipun ini menambah dua minggu waktu tunggu.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That sounds reasonable. Have you conducted a comprehensive risk assessment for the new suppliers? We can't afford another disruption if these alternatives prove unreliable.
lines.translation: Kedengarannya masuk akal. Sudahkah kamu melakukan penilaian risiko komprehensif untuk pemasok baru? Kita tidak bisa mengalami gangguan lagi jika alternatif ini ternyata tidak dapat diandalkan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Absolutely. I've evaluated their financial stability, production capacity, and geopolitical risk factors. I'm also recommending we maintain relationships with at least three suppliers per critical component moving forward to build greater resilience.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Saya telah mengevaluasi stabilitas keuangan mereka, kapasitas produksi, dan faktor risiko geopolitik. Saya juga merekomendasikan kita mempertahankan hubungan dengan setidaknya tiga pemasok per komponen kritis ke depannya untuk membangun ketahanan yang lebih besar.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Excellent work, Sarah. Please prepare a detailed presentation for the board meeting next Tuesday. They'll want to understand both the immediate mitigation measures and our long-term supply chain diversification strategy.
lines.translation: Kerja yang sangat baik, Sarah. Tolong siapkan presentasi detail untuk rapat dewan Selasa depan. Mereka akan ingin memahami baik langkah-langkah mitigasi segera maupun strategi diversifikasi rantai pasok jangka panjang kita.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang Logistics Coordinator yang sedang melaporkan situasi krisis rantai pasok kepada Mr. Khoirul, yang berperan sebagai Regional Manager. Diskusikan disrupsi yang terjadi, dampaknya terhadap operasional, dan proposal solusi Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning. I understand we're facing some significant supply chain challenges. Can you walk me through the current situation and how it's affecting our operations?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Khoirul. Yes, we've experienced major disruptions due to the port strike in Rotterdam. Our main shipping route has been blocked for ten days now, and we have approximately 40 containers stuck at the terminal.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's concerning. What's the financial impact so far, and have you identified alternative routes? Time is critical here.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The delay has cost us roughly 200,000 euros in penalties and lost sales. I've been negotiating with carriers to reroute through Hamburg and Antwerp, though this will add 5-7 days to our delivery schedule and increase freight costs by about 30 percent.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. What about our customers? Are they aware of the situation, and how are we managing their expectations?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I've already contacted our top 15 clients to inform them of the delays. Most have been understanding, but three major accounts are threatening to switch to competitors if we can't guarantee delivery within two weeks.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: This is a critical situation. What contingency measures are you proposing to prevent similar disruptions in the future?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I recommend we implement a multi-port strategy, diversifying our entry points across at least three major European ports. We should also increase our safety stock levels by 20 percent and establish partnerships with backup carriers to ensure capacity during crises.

quiz.question: The recent political tensions have ___ significant disruptions to international shipping routes, forcing companies to seek alternative transportation methods.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'caused' (present perfect: have caused) karena kalimat mendeskripsikan tindakan di masa lalu yang memiliki dampak berkelanjutan hingga sekarang. 'Been caused' salah karena kita perlu active voice (ketegangan politik yang menyebabkan, bukan disebabkan). 'Causing' tidak cocok dengan struktur 'have' dalam present perfect.

quiz.question: If we ___ our supplier base two years ago, we wouldn't be facing these critical shortages now.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'had diversified' untuk third conditional (conditional type 3) yang membahas situasi hipotesis di masa lalu dengan konsekuensi di masa sekarang. Struktur: If + past perfect, ... would/wouldn't + base verb. Ini menunjukkan penyesalan atas keputusan masa lalu yang tidak diambil.

quiz.question: The logistics team ___ implementing a comprehensive risk assessment protocol to identify potential supply chain vulnerabilities.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'is currently' karena 'team' adalah collective noun yang dianggap singular dalam British English context ini. Adverb 'currently' diletakkan setelah auxiliary verb 'is' dalam present continuous. Struktur: subject + is/are + adverb + verb-ing menunjukkan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: Companies must develop ___ to ensure business continuity when facing unexpected trade restrictions or transportation disruptions.
quiz.explanation: Frasa yang benar adalah 'contingency plans' (rencana darurat/kontingensi). 'Contingency' di sini berfungsi sebagai noun modifier yang mendeskripsikan jenis rencana. 'Contingent plans' salah karena 'contingent' adalah adjective yang artinya berbeda (tergantung pada). 'Contingencies plan' salah secara grammar.

quiz.question: The embargo has been ___ for six months, yet many companies still haven't adjusted their procurement strategies accordingly.
quiz.explanation: Idiom yang benar adalah 'in place' yang artinya 'berlaku/diterapkan'. Frasa 'has been in place' dengan present perfect menunjukkan bahwa embargo telah diterapkan dan masih berlaku hingga sekarang. 'In the place' dan 'on place' bukan idiom yang benar dalam konteks ini.

modules.title: Causative Verbs & Passive Reporting Structures: Have/Get Something Done & It is Alleged
modules.objective: Menggunakan bentuk kausatif dan struktur pasif impersonal untuk pelaporan berita dan investigasi.

theory.summary: Causative verbs dan passive reporting structures adalah dua struktur penting dalam bahasa Inggris formal, khususnya untuk konteks profesional, akademis, dan jurnalistik. Causative verbs (have/get something done) digunakan ketika kita menyuruh atau meminta orang lain melakukan sesuatu untuk kita, bukan kita yang melakukannya sendiri. Passive reporting structures (It is said that.../She is believed to...) digunakan untuk melaporkan informasi tanpa menyebutkan sumber secara spesifik, sangat umum dalam berita, laporan investigasi, dan tulisan akademis. Kedua struktur ini memberikan kesan profesional dan objektif dalam komunikasi.
rules: HAVE something DONE: Subject + have + object + past participle. Digunakan untuk menyatakan bahwa subjek mengatur orang lain melakukan sesuatu (lebih formal). Contoh: 'I had my car serviced yesterday.' (Saya menyuruh orang servis mobil saya kemarin.)

GET something DONE: Subject + get + object + past participle. Sama dengan 'have' tetapi lebih informal dan sering menyiratkan usaha atau kesulitan. Contoh: 'We finally got the report finished.' (Kami akhirnya berhasil menyelesaikan laporan tersebut.)

IMPERSONAL PASSIVE dengan IT: It + is/was + past participle + that-clause. Contoh: 'It is believed that the company will merge.' / 'It is alleged that he took bribes.' Digunakan untuk melaporkan opini, klaim, atau tuduhan tanpa menyebutkan sumber.

IMPERSONAL PASSIVE dengan SUBJECT: Subject + is/was + past participle + to-infinitive. Contoh: 'The minister is reported to have resigned.' / 'She is thought to be the best candidate.' Struktur ini lebih formal dan sering digunakan dalam berita.

VERB PATTERNS untuk reporting: Gunakan reporting verbs seperti say, believe, think, allege, report, claim, consider, know, expect, understand. Contoh: 'It is said that...' / 'He is considered to be...' / 'The proposal is understood to have been rejected.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Mencampurkan Active dan Passive dalam Causative
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar B2 keliru menggunakan bentuk active verb setelah have/get dalam struktur kausatif, atau lupa menggunakan past participle. Ingat bahwa dalam causative, kita tidak melakukan aksi tersebut sendiri, maka objek diikuti past participle (bentuk pasif).
commonTrap.wrong: I had my assistant to prepare the documents. / She got her hair cutting yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: I had my assistant prepare the documents. / I had the documents prepared by my assistant. / She got her hair cut yesterday.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan struktur kausatif 'have something done' dengan benar?
options: I had my laptop repaired by the technician yesterday.
I had my laptop repairing by the technician yesterday.
I had my laptop to repair by the technician yesterday.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur 'have something done' memerlukan past participle (repaired) setelah objek (my laptop), bukan bentuk -ing atau to-infinitive.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang benar untuk menghindari kesalahan umum dalam struktur kausatif (get something done).
options: He got his house painting last week.
He got his house painted last week.
He got his house to paint last week.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam struktur kausatif 'get something done', kita harus menggunakan past participle (painted) setelah objek (house), bukan bentuk -ing atau to-infinitive.
