readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut berdasarkan struktur pelaporan pasif (passive reporting): 'The suspect is a former official. [...] he accepted bribes from several contractors.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur 'It is + past participle + that-clause' (It is alleged that...) digunakan untuk melaporkan klaim atau tuduhan tanpa menyebutkan sumber secara spesifik.

vocab.collocation: It is alleged that the politician accepted illegal donations from corporate lobbyists.
The building is undergoing major renovations and will reopen next month.
The government commissioned an independent report on climate change impacts.
I have my car serviced every six months to maintain its warranty.
All electrical installations must be inspected by a certified engineer before use.
The CEO is purported to have known about the fraud but took no action.
We're getting the office refurbished by a local contractor next week.
They had their entire kitchen renovated to increase the property value.
Serious allegations of misconduct have been made against several board members.
The damage to the property was assessed by an independent surveyor.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Mark sedang membahas persiapan untuk audit perusahaan yang akan datang dan beberapa berita terbaru tentang industri mereka di kantor.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Mark, have you had all the financial records reviewed before the audit next week?
lines.translation: Mark, apakah kamu sudah menyuruh semua catatan keuangan diperiksa sebelum audit minggu depan?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yes, I had them checked by our internal team yesterday. Everything seems to be in order, but I'm getting the final report prepared by Friday.
lines.translation: Ya, saya sudah menyuruh tim internal memeriksa kemarin. Semuanya tampaknya sudah beres, tapi saya akan menyelesaikan laporan akhir sebelum Jumat.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good. Did you hear about TechCorp? It is alleged that their CEO has been involved in insider trading. The news broke this morning.
lines.translation: Bagus. Apakah kamu dengar tentang TechCorp? Dikabarkan bahwa CEO mereka terlibat dalam perdagangan orang dalam. Beritanya keluar pagi ini.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yes, I saw that. He is reported to have sold millions in shares just before the company announced poor quarterly results. It's quite a scandal.
lines.translation: Ya, saya lihat itu. Dia dilaporkan telah menjual saham jutaan sebelum perusahaan mengumumkan hasil kuartalan yang buruk. Ini cukup skandal.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: It is believed that the investigation will take months. This reminds me—we should get our compliance procedures updated immediately.
lines.translation: Dipercaya bahwa investigasi akan memakan waktu berbulan-bulan. Ini mengingatkan saya—kita harus segera memperbarui prosedur kepatuhan kita.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Absolutely. I'll have our legal team draft new guidelines and get them approved by the board by the end of this month.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Saya akan menyuruh tim legal kami membuat pedoman baru dan mendapatkan persetujuan dewan pada akhir bulan ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang project manager yang sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul (AI Tutor yang berperan sebagai consultant) tentang persiapan proyek besar. Gunakan causative structures dan passive reporting untuk menjelaskan apa yang sudah dan akan dilakukan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning! I understand you're managing the new infrastructure project. Can you tell me what preparations have been completed so far?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning! Yes, we've made good progress. I've had the site surveyed by engineers, and we got all the permits approved last week.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent. What about the environmental impact assessment? I heard there were some concerns raised by local residents.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It is reported that some residents have concerns, but we had the environmental study conducted by an independent firm. Their findings show minimal impact.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's reassuring. Have you arranged for the equipment and materials to be delivered? When will construction actually begin?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm getting all the heavy equipment delivered next Monday. We're having the construction team briefed on safety protocols this week, and work is expected to start by the 15th.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Sounds well organized. What about quality control? How will you ensure standards are maintained throughout the project?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We'll have inspections carried out weekly by certified inspectors. It is understood that quality cannot be compromised, so we've built in multiple checkpoints at every phase.

quiz.question: The company ___ all its computers upgraded to the latest operating system last month.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'had' dalam struktur causative 'have something done'. Kalimat ini menjelaskan bahwa perusahaan menyuruh orang lain meng-upgrade komputer (bukan melakukannya sendiri). Bentuk past simple 'had' digunakan karena ada penanda waktu 'last month'.

quiz.question: It ___ that the merger will be completed by the end of the fiscal year.
quiz.explanation: Dalam impersonal passive reporting structure dengan 'It', kita menggunakan 'is + past participle'. 'It is expected that...' adalah pola standar untuk melaporkan ekspektasi atau prediksi tanpa menyebutkan sumber spesifik. Ini sangat umum dalam konteks bisnis dan berita.

quiz.question: The minister is reported ___ secret meetings with foreign diplomats last year.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'is reported', gunakan 'to + infinitive'. Karena aksi terjadi di masa lalu (last year) dan sebelum waktu pelaporan, gunakan perfect infinitive 'to have held'. Struktur ini (Subject + is reported + to have done) menunjukkan aksi lampau yang dilaporkan sekarang.

quiz.question: We need to get the contract ___ by a lawyer before we sign it.
quiz.explanation: Dalam causative 'get something done', objek (the contract) diikuti oleh past participle (reviewed). Ini menunjukkan bahwa kita akan menyuruh atau mengatur lawyer untuk mereview kontrak, bukan kita yang mereview sendiri. Past participle menunjukkan bahwa kontrak akan 'diterima' aksi tersebut (pasif).

quiz.question: The CEO ___ to be considering resignation following the allegations of financial misconduct.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan passive form 'is believed' dalam struktur pelaporan impersonal. Pola 'Subject + is believed + to be doing' menunjukkan bahwa orang-orang percaya CEO sedang mempertimbangkan pengunduran diri saat ini. 'To be considering' (continuous infinitive) menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung.

modules.title: Bioethics, Genetic Engineering & Medical Innovations
modules.objective: Mendiskusikan implikasi etis manipulasi genetik, kloning, dan teknologi medis mutakhir.

theory.summary: Modul ini membekali Anda dengan kemampuan untuk mendiskusikan isu-isu bioetika kompleks dalam bahasa Inggris tingkat lanjut. Anda akan mempelajari cara menyampaikan argumen berimbang tentang topik kontroversial seperti manipulasi genetik, kloning, dan inovasi medis. Di level B2, penting untuk menguasai struktur argumen yang nuanced, menggunakan modal verbs untuk menyatakan kemungkinan etis (could, might, should), serta conditional sentences untuk hipotesis ilmiah. Anda juga akan belajar hedging language untuk menyampaikan pendapat secara akademis tanpa terdengar absolut, seperti 'It could be argued that...', 'There appears to be...', 'To some extent...'
rules: Gunakan passive voice untuk fokus pada tindakan ilmiah: 'Genes can be modified' (bukan 'Scientists can modify genes') untuk menunjukkan objektivitas akademis.

Terapkan hedging language dengan adverbs seperti 'potentially', 'arguably', 'presumably': 'This technology could potentially revolutionise medicine' menunjukkan kehati-hatian intelektual yang tepat untuk diskusi etis.
Struktur argumen dengan discourse markers kompleks: 'While it is true that... / Nevertheless... / On balance...' untuk menunjukkan pemikiran kritis tingkat lanjut dalam debat bioetika.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan: Absolut vs Nuanced Statement
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa B2 sering membuat pernyataan terlalu absolut dalam diskusi etis, yang tidak sesuai dengan register akademis. Dalam bioetika, hampir tidak ada jawaban hitam-putih, sehingga penggunaan bahasa yang terlalu pasti menunjukkan kurangnya sophisticated thinking.
commonTrap.wrong: Genetic engineering is completely wrong and should be banned immediately.
commonTrap.correct: Genetic engineering raises significant ethical concerns that warrant careful consideration, although it may offer certain medical benefits.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang paling tepat menggunakan passive voice untuk menunjukkan objektivitas akademis dalam diskusi ilmiah mengenai manipulasi genetik.
options: Researchers manipulate embryos to study genetic diseases.
Embryos are manipulated by researchers to study genetic diseases.
We manipulate embryos to study genetic diseases.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam penulisan akademis, passive voice digunakan untuk mengalihkan fokus dari pelaku (peneliti) ke objek tindakan (embrio), sehingga memberikan kesan objektivitas yang lebih tinggi.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah pernyataan berikut yang paling mencerminkan penggunaan bahasa yang bernuansa (nuanced) dan akademis dalam diskusi bioetika?
options: Genetic engineering is inherently evil and should be banned immediately.
Genetic engineering is the only way to save humanity from future diseases.
While genetic engineering offers significant medical benefits, it arguably raises complex ethical concerns that warrant careful consideration.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pilihan ketiga menggunakan struktur 'While... it arguably...' yang menunjukkan pemikiran kritis dan menghindari pernyataan absolut, sesuai dengan standar bahasa B2.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut dengan discourse marker yang tepat untuk menunjukkan argumen berimbang: 'Many argue that cloning is unnatural. [...], it could potentially revolutionise regenerative medicine.'
options: Nevertheless, it could potentially revolutionise regenerative medicine.
It is definitely true that it could potentially revolutionise regenerative medicine.
Because it is wrong, it could potentially revolutionise regenerative medicine.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Nevertheless' adalah discourse marker yang tepat untuk memperkenalkan argumen tandingan atau sudut pandang lain yang berlawanan namun tetap berimbang.

vocab.collocation: Genetic manipulation has opened up possibilities that were once confined to science fiction.
The use of human embryos in research remains one of the most contentious issues in bioethics.
We need to carefully consider the long-term implications of editing the human genome.
Therapeutic cloning differs significantly from reproductive cloning in both purpose and ethical considerations.
Stem cell research offers promising treatments for degenerative diseases like Parkinson's.
Gene therapy could potentially eliminate hereditary diseases from future generations.
Informed consent becomes problematic when we're making decisions that affect unborn individuals.
Allowing designer babies could set a dangerous precedent for genetic discrimination.
Medical intervention at the genetic level raises questions about playing God.
The social ramifications of genetic enhancement technology extend far beyond medicine.

dialogue.context: Dr. Sarah Chen, seorang ahli bioetika, sedang berdiskusi dengan jurnalis James tentang kontroversi seputar teknologi CRISPR gene editing dalam sebuah podcast ilmiah.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Dr. Chen, CRISPR technology has been hailed as revolutionary, but it's also deeply controversial. Where do you stand on its use in human embryos?
lines.translation: Dr. Chen, teknologi CRISPR telah dipuji sebagai revolusioner, tetapi juga sangat kontroversial. Bagaimana pendapat Anda tentang penggunaannya pada embrio manusia?

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: It's a nuanced issue. While CRISPR could potentially eliminate hereditary diseases like sickle cell anaemia, we must consider the unintended consequences. We're essentially making decisions for future generations without their consent.
lines.translation: Ini adalah isu yang bernuansa. Meskipun CRISPR berpotensi menghilangkan penyakit turun-temurun seperti anemia sel sabit, kita harus mempertimbangkan konsekuensi yang tidak diinginkan. Kita pada dasarnya membuat keputusan untuk generasi mendatang tanpa persetujuan mereka.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: But surely preventing suffering is ethically justifiable? If we can stop a child from inheriting a debilitating condition, don't we have a moral obligation to do so?
lines.translation: Tetapi tentu mencegah penderitaan dapat dibenarkan secara etis? Jika kita bisa menghentikan seorang anak mewarisi kondisi yang melemahkan, bukankah kita punya kewajiban moral untuk melakukannya?

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: That's a compelling argument, and I partly agree. However, the slippery slope concerns me. Once we permit genetic intervention for medical purposes, where do we draw the line? Enhancement for intelligence or physical traits could follow.
lines.translation: Itu argumen yang menarik, dan saya sebagian setuju. Namun, lereng licin itu membuat saya khawatir. Begitu kita mengizinkan intervensi genetik untuk tujuan medis, di mana kita menarik garisnya? Peningkatan untuk kecerdasan atau sifat fisik bisa menyusul.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: The designer baby scenario. Do you think regulations can effectively prevent that?
lines.translation: Skenario bayi desainer. Apakah menurut Anda regulasi dapat secara efektif mencegah itu?

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: Regulations help, but enforcement across borders is challenging. What's banned in one country might be permitted elsewhere. We need international consensus, which, frankly, seems unlikely given the diverse ethical frameworks worldwide.
lines.translation: Regulasi membantu, tetapi penegakan lintas batas itu menantang. Apa yang dilarang di satu negara mungkin diizinkan di tempat lain. Kita perlu konsensus internasional, yang, sejujurnya, tampaknya tidak mungkin mengingat kerangka etis yang beragam di seluruh dunia.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: So what's the way forward? Should we halt research until society reaches consensus?
lines.translation: Jadi apa jalan ke depan? Haruskah kita menghentikan penelitian sampai masyarakat mencapai konsensus?

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: Not necessarily halt, but proceed with extreme caution. Transparent oversight, public dialogue, and restricting applications to severe medical conditions would be prudent. We must balance innovation with responsibility to humanity's future.
lines.translation: Belum tentu berhenti, tetapi lanjutkan dengan sangat hati-hati. Pengawasan transparan, dialog publik, dan pembatasan aplikasi pada kondisi medis parah akan menjadi bijaksana. Kita harus menyeimbangkan inovasi dengan tanggung jawab terhadap masa depan umat manusia.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang peneliti muda yang sedang mempresentasikan proposal penelitian stem cell kepada Mr. Khoirul, yang berperan sebagai ketua komite etik penelitian. Anda perlu meyakinkan beliau bahwa penelitian Anda etis dan bermanfaat sambil merespons kekhawatirannya secara profesional.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning. I've reviewed your stem cell research proposal. While the potential benefits are clear, I have some concerns about the ethical implications. Could you explain your position on using embryonic stem cells?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning. I understand your concerns completely. Our research focuses on adult stem cells, which circumvents the ethical issues surrounding embryonic sources. We believe this approach offers comparable therapeutic potential without the moral dilemmas.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's reassuring, but what about informed consent? How will you ensure that donors fully understand the implications of donating biological material for genetic research?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We've developed a comprehensive consent process involving multiple consultations, written materials in accessible language, and a mandatory cooling-off period. Donors can withdraw consent at any stage before the research commences.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I appreciate the thoroughness. However, there's the issue of unforeseen consequences. What if your research leads to applications you hadn't anticipated, potentially problematic ones?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's precisely why we've built ethical review checkpoints throughout the research process. Any deviation from the approved protocol or unexpected findings that raise ethical questions will be immediately reported to this committee for guidance before proceeding.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent. One final question: how do you justify the significant funding this requires when resources could go to more immediate healthcare needs?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: While I acknowledge that tension, investment in regenerative medicine could dramatically reduce long-term healthcare costs by providing curative rather than palliative treatments. The cost-benefit analysis over a twenty-year horizon strongly supports this research direction.

quiz.question: The ethical ___ of genetic modification extend far beyond the laboratory, affecting society's fundamental values.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'implications' adalah pilihan tepat karena merujuk pada konsekuensi tidak langsung dan dampak luas dari tindakan. Dalam konteks etika, kita membahas implikasi (akibat mendalam) bukan sekadar aplikasi (penerapan) atau medikasi (obat-obatan). Collocation 'ethical implications' sangat umum dalam diskusi bioetika tingkat B2.

quiz.question: While gene therapy ___ eliminate certain hereditary diseases, we must consider the long-term consequences for future generations.
quiz.explanation: 'Could potentially' menunjukkan hedging language yang tepat untuk diskusi ilmiah tingkat B2. Pilihan ini mengekspresikan kemungkinan tanpa kepastian absolut, yang penting dalam konteks etis di mana banyak hal masih belum pasti. 'Will definitely' dan 'must absolutely' terlalu pasti dan tidak sesuai dengan register akademis yang memerlukan nuansa.

quiz.question: Informed ___ becomes problematic when making decisions that will affect individuals who cannot yet provide it.
quiz.explanation: 'Consent' (persetujuan) adalah istilah etis standar yang merujuk pada izin sadar dan terinformasi. 'Informed consent' adalah collocation tetap dalam bioetika. 'Comment' (komentar) dan 'content' (konten) tidak masuk akal dalam konteks pengambilan keputusan medis dan etis ini.

quiz.question: ___ it is true that CRISPR offers medical benefits, we must acknowledge the potential for misuse in non-therapeutic applications.
quiz.explanation: 'While' adalah discourse marker yang menunjukkan kontras dan concession (pengakuan), tepat untuk argumen berimbang di level B2. Struktur 'While X, Y' mengakui satu sisi argumen sambil memperkenalkan counterpoint. 'Because' menunjukkan sebab-akibat yang tidak sesuai, dan 'therefore' menunjukkan kesimpulan yang juga tidak tepat untuk kalimat kontras ini.

quiz.question: The research committee decided that human cloning experiments should be prohibited ___ the significant ethical concerns they raise.
quiz.explanation: 'Given' (mengingat, mempertimbangkan) digunakan untuk memperkenalkan alasan atau justifikasi, cocok untuk konteks formal ini. Struktur 'given that' atau 'given + noun' umum dalam argumentasi akademis B2. 'Despite' berarti 'meskipun' yang berlawanan dengan logika kalimat, dan 'unless' (kecuali jika) menunjukkan kondisi yang tidak sesuai konteks.

modules.title: Subjunctive Mood & Formal Demands: It is Vital That He Be Informed
modules.objective: Menguasai penggunaan subjunctive mood dalam resolusi resmi, rekomendasi mendesak, dan protokol hukum.

theory.summary: Subjunctive mood adalah bentuk khusus dalam bahasa Inggris formal yang digunakan untuk menyatakan tuntutan, rekomendasi, atau keharusan. Berbeda dengan bentuk biasa, subjunctive menggunakan bare infinitive (bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa -s/-es) setelah kata kerja atau ungkapan tertentu, bahkan untuk subjek orang ketiga tunggal. Struktur ini sangat penting dalam dokumen hukum, resolusi perusahaan, rekomendasi formal, dan komunikasi profesional tingkat tinggi.
rules: Formula dasar: Subject + demand/insist/recommend/suggest/require + that + subject + BARE INFINITIVE (be, go, do, submit). Contoh: The board insists that he BE present (bukan 'is' atau 'be present').
Dengan ekspresi formal: It is vital/essential/imperative/crucial + that + subject + BARE INFINITIVE. Contoh: It is essential that every member SUBMIT their report by Friday.

Bentuk negatif menggunakan 'not' sebelum bare infinitive: The lawyer recommended that the witness NOT answer that question. Untuk ekspresi formal: It is important that she NOT be disturbed during the meeting.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Menambahkan -s atau Menggunakan 'is/are'
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa level B2 secara otomatis menambahkan -s untuk orang ketiga tunggal atau menggunakan 'is/are' karena terbiasa dengan grammar biasa. Dalam subjunctive mood, SELALU gunakan bare infinitive tanpa perubahan apapun, tidak peduli subjeknya.
commonTrap.wrong: The committee demands that he submits his resignation immediately. / It is vital that she is informed of the changes.
commonTrap.correct: The committee demands that he SUBMIT his resignation immediately. / It is vital that she BE informed of the changes.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah pernyataan yang BENAR mengenai kaidah pada topik "It is Vital That He Be Informed"?
options: Pola ini hanya boleh digunakan dalam situasi santai
Formula dasar: Subject + demand/insist/recommend/suggest/require + that + subject + BAR...
Tenses dan susunan subjek tidak perlu diperhatikan
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kaidah inti topik ini: Subjunctive mood adalah bentuk khusus dalam bahasa Inggris formal yang digunakan untuk menyatakan tuntutan, rekomendasi, atau keharusan.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Perhatikan jebakan umum pada materi "It is Vital That He Be Informed". Manakah kalimat yang SUDAH TEPAT?
options: The committee demands that he SUBMIT his resignation immediately
It is vital that she is informed of the changes
The committee demands that he submits his resignation immediately
readinessQuestions.explanation: Banyak siswa level B2 secara otomatis menambahkan -s untuk orang ketiga tunggal atau menggunakan 'is/are' karena terbiasa dengan grammar biasa. Dalam subjunctive mood, SELALU gunakan bare infinitive tanpa perubahan apapun, tidak peduli subjeknya.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
General Counsel: "We need to finalize the board resolution for the merger. It's imperative that every director be notified at least 48 hours in advance."
Corporate Secretary: "[...]"
options: Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
Understood. The regulations also stipulate that the resolution be filed with the regulatory authority within five business days.
The committee demands that he submits his resignation immediately
readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "Understood. The regulations also stipulate that the resolution be filed with the regulatory authority within five business days." ("Dimengerti. Peraturan juga menetapkan bahwa resolusi harus diajukan ke otoritas pengawas dalam lima hari kerja.") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Corporate Secretary.

vocab.collocation: The CEO insists that all managers attend the quarterly review meeting.
It is imperative that the security protocols be updated before the system goes live.
The new regulation mandates that every organization report their carbon emissions annually.
The contract stipulates that payment be made within thirty days of invoice date.
Full compliance with data protection regulations requires that all user information be encrypted.
The board passed a resolution requiring that the CFO present financial reports monthly.
The audit committee's recommendation is that the company adopt stricter internal controls.
Safety protocols demand that all visitors be accompanied by authorized personnel at all times.
The policy designates that a senior officer be present during all disciplinary hearings.
We urgently request that you expedite the approval process for this critical application.

dialogue.context: Diskusi formal antara General Counsel (penasihat hukum umum) dan Corporate Secretary mengenai resolusi dewan direksi untuk merger perusahaan.

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: We need to finalize the board resolution for the merger. It's imperative that every director be notified at least 48 hours in advance.
lines.translation: Kita perlu menyelesaikan resolusi dewan untuk merger. Sangat penting bahwa setiap direktur diberitahu setidaknya 48 jam sebelumnya.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: Understood. The regulations also stipulate that the resolution be filed with the regulatory authority within five business days.
lines.translation: Dimengerti. Peraturan juga menetapkan bahwa resolusi harus diajukan ke otoritas pengawas dalam lima hari kerja.

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: Exactly. I recommend that we also insist the auditors submit their due diligence report before the vote takes place.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Saya merekomendasikan kita juga menuntut auditor menyerahkan laporan uji tuntas mereka sebelum pemungutan suara berlangsung.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: Good point. Should we mandate that all shareholders be given access to the merger documents two weeks prior?
lines.translation: Poin yang bagus. Haruskah kita mewajibkan semua pemegang saham diberi akses ke dokumen merger dua minggu sebelumnya?

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: Absolutely. It's vital that full transparency be maintained throughout this process. Any legal challenges could delay everything.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Sangat penting bahwa transparansi penuh dijaga sepanjang proses ini. Tantangan hukum apapun bisa menunda semuanya.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: I'll draft the resolution language accordingly. One more thing—do we require that the CFO be present at the shareholder meeting?
lines.translation: Saya akan menyusun bahasa resolusinya sesuai dengan itu. Satu hal lagi—apakah kita mewajibkan CFO hadir di rapat pemegang saham?

lines.speaker: General Counsel
lines.text: Yes, protocol demands that both the CEO and CFO attend to answer any financial questions. Let's ensure the notice reflects that.
lines.translation: Ya, protokol menuntut bahwa CEO dan CFO hadir untuk menjawab pertanyaan keuangan apapun. Mari kita pastikan pemberitahuan mencerminkan hal itu.

lines.speaker: Corporate Secretary
lines.text: Perfect. I'll have the draft on your desk by end of day. We need to move quickly on this.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Saya akan memberikan draf ke meja Anda pada akhir hari. Kita perlu bergerak cepat dalam hal ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang Legal Compliance Officer yang sedang berlatih menyusun rekomendasi formal dengan Mr. Khoirul. Gunakan subjunctive mood dengan tepat dalam skenario profesional ini.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're practicing formal recommendations using the subjunctive mood. Imagine you're writing a compliance memo. How would you recommend that all employees complete cybersecurity training?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I recommend that all employees complete the mandatory cybersecurity training by the end of this quarter.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of the subjunctive! Now, make it more urgent using 'It is imperative that...' and include a deadline.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It is imperative that every employee complete the cybersecurity training before March 31st to ensure full compliance with our security protocols.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Now let's try a negative form. How would you insist that contractors NOT access confidential files without authorization?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The company insists that contractors not access any confidential files without prior written authorization from the department head.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Outstanding! Notice you used 'not access' rather than 'do not access'—that's the correct subjunctive form. For your final task, create a formal demand using 'stipulate' about document retention.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The regulation stipulates that all financial records be retained for a minimum of seven years and that they be stored in secure, auditable formats.

quiz.question: The board of directors demands that the CEO ___ at the emergency meeting tomorrow.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'demands that', kita harus menggunakan bare infinitive (attend), bukan bentuk present tense biasa (attends). Subjunctive mood tidak mengikuti aturan orang ketiga tunggal yang biasa menambahkan -s.

quiz.question: It is essential that every document ___ reviewed by the legal team before publication.
quiz.explanation: Dengan ekspresi 'It is essential that', kita menggunakan bare infinitive 'be', bukan 'is' atau 'will be'. Ini adalah aturan subjunctive mood dalam bahasa Inggris formal yang wajib digunakan dalam konteks tuntutan dan rekomendasi.

quiz.question: The contract stipulates that payment ___ made within 30 days of invoice receipt.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'stipulate' memicu subjunctive mood, sehingga kita menggunakan 'be' (bare infinitive), bukan 'is' atau 'must be'. Struktur subjunctive sudah mengandung makna keharusan, jadi 'must' tidak diperlukan.

quiz.question: The safety protocol requires that all visitors ___ protective equipment in the laboratory area.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'requires that', kita menggunakan bare infinitive 'wear' untuk semua subjek, termasuk orang ketiga tunggal. Ini berbeda dari kalimat biasa dimana 'visitors' akan menggunakan 'wear' dalam present simple, tapi di sini konteksnya adalah subjunctive formal.

quiz.question: The committee recommends that the policy ___ implemented until further review is completed.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk negatif dalam subjunctive mood adalah 'not + bare infinitive', jadi 'not be' adalah yang benar. 'Is not' menggunakan present tense biasa, dan 'not to be' adalah bentuk infinitive yang salah dalam konteks ini. Ingat: subjunctive negatif = not + bare infinitive.

modules.title: Financial Markets, Risk Hedging & Macroeconomic Indicators
modules.objective: Memahami analisa inflasi, suku bunga acuan bank sentral, portofolio investasi, dan fluktuasi mata uang.

theory.summary: Modul ini membahas bahasa Inggris profesional untuk analisis pasar keuangan dan indikator makroekonomi. Anda akan mempelajari cara mendiskusikan inflasi, kebijakan suku bunga bank sentral, diversifikasi portofolio investasi, dan dampak fluktuasi mata uang terhadap ekonomi. Materi mencakup terminologi teknis yang digunakan dalam laporan keuangan, presentasi bisnis, dan diskusi ekonomi formal. Fokus utama adalah kemampuan menjelaskan tren ekonomi, menginterpretasikan grafik pasar, dan memberikan komentar tentang kebijakan fiskal dengan bahasa yang tepat dan kredibel di level B2.
rules: Gunakan present perfect untuk menggambarkan tren ekonomi yang berdampak hingga sekarang: 'Interest rates have risen by 2% since January' atau 'The central bank has maintained its hawkish stance'

Gunakan conditional sentences (tipe 1 dan 2) untuk analisis risiko dan proyeksi: 'If inflation continues to rise, the Fed will likely increase rates' atau 'If the currency were to depreciate further, exporters would benefit'
Gunakan passive voice untuk laporan objektif: 'The benchmark rate was raised to 5.25%' atau 'Portfolio diversification is recommended to mitigate risk'
Gunakan modal verbs untuk memberikan rekomendasi investasi: 'Investors should hedge against currency risk' atau 'Companies might consider fixed-income securities'
Gunakan comparative dan superlative untuk analisis data: 'Inflation is higher than the target rate' atau 'This represents the sharpest decline in commodity prices this year'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Tenses dalam Analisis Ekonomi
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering mencampur present simple dan present perfect ketika menjelaskan data historis dengan dampak berkelanjutan. Dalam konteks finansial, present perfect digunakan untuk tren yang masih relevan, sedangkan past simple untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lampau.
commonTrap.wrong: The central bank increased interest rates three times this year and inflation decreases significantly.
commonTrap.correct: The central bank has increased interest rates three times this year, and inflation has decreased significantly.

Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:

David: "[...]"

Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
I've been following the news. The Fed has already raised the benchmark rate three times this year. How is that affecting my investments?

("Saya sudah mengikuti beritanya. The Fed sudah menaikkan suku bunga acuan tiga kali tahun ini. Bagaimana itu mempengaruhi investasi saya?") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh David.

dialogue.context: Sarah, seorang financial analyst, sedang briefing kepada kliennya David mengenai strategi investasi di tengah kondisi ekonomi yang tidak stabil dengan inflasi tinggi dan kebijakan suku bunga yang ketat.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: David, I've reviewed your portfolio, and given the current macroeconomic climate, I think we need to discuss some adjustments. Inflation has remained above the central bank's target for six consecutive months.
lines.translation: David, saya sudah meninjau portofolio Anda, dan mengingat iklim makroekonomi saat ini, saya rasa kita perlu mendiskusikan beberapa penyesuaian. Inflasi tetap di atas target bank sentral selama enam bulan berturut-turut.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I've been following the news. The Fed has already raised the benchmark rate three times this year. How is that affecting my investments?
lines.translation: Saya sudah mengikuti beritanya. The Fed sudah menaikkan suku bunga acuan tiga kali tahun ini. Bagaimana itu mempengaruhi investasi saya?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Higher interest rates typically strengthen the dollar, which impacts your international equity holdings. We're also seeing increased volatility in emerging markets. I'd recommend hedging your currency exposure.
lines.translation: Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi biasanya memperkuat dolar, yang berdampak pada kepemilikan saham internasional Anda. Kami juga melihat peningkatan volatilitas di pasar negara berkembang. Saya merekomendasikan lindung nilai terhadap eksposur mata uang Anda.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: What about fixed-income securities? I heard bond yields have become more attractive lately.
lines.translation: Bagaimana dengan sekuritas pendapatan tetap? Saya dengar hasil obligasi menjadi lebih menarik akhir-akhir ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Exactly. Treasury yields have increased substantially, making them a viable option for more conservative asset allocation. However, if inflation persists, real returns could still be negative.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Hasil obligasi pemerintah telah meningkat secara substansial, menjadikannya opsi yang layak untuk alokasi aset yang lebih konservatif. Namun, jika inflasi berlanjut, hasil riil masih bisa negatif.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: So what's your recommendation? Should we shift more towards defensive positions?
lines.translation: Jadi apa rekomendasi Anda? Haruskah kita bergeser lebih ke posisi defensif?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I suggest a balanced approach: maintain diversification across sectors, increase your allocation to commodities as an inflation hedge, and consider short-duration bonds to minimize interest rate risk.
lines.translation: Saya menyarankan pendekatan seimbang: pertahankan diversifikasi di berbagai sektor, tingkatkan alokasi Anda ke komoditas sebagai lindung nilai inflasi, dan pertimbangkan obligasi berdurasi pendek untuk meminimalkan risiko suku bunga.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That sounds prudent. Let's schedule a follow-up meeting next quarter to reassess based on the central bank's monetary policy decisions.
lines.translation: Kedengarannya bijaksana. Mari jadwalkan pertemuan lanjutan kuartal depan untuk menilai ulang berdasarkan keputusan kebijakan moneter bank sentral.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang economic analyst yang sedang mempresentasikan laporan triwulanan kepada Mr. Khoirul, yang berperan sebagai kepala divisi investasi. Diskusikan tren ekonomi terkini, interpretasi data inflasi, dan rekomendasi penyesuaian portofolio investasi perusahaan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning. I've read your preliminary report on the Q3 economic outlook. Could you walk me through the key macroeconomic indicators you've been tracking?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning. Certainly. The most significant trend has been persistent inflation, which has averaged 4.2% over the past quarter, well above the central bank's 2% target.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. And how has the central bank responded to this inflationary pressure? What's your assessment of their monetary policy stance?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The central bank has adopted a hawkish stance, raising the benchmark rate by 75 basis points in total. This monetary tightening aims to cool down demand and bring inflation under control.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Given these developments, what's happening with currency markets? I'm particularly concerned about our exposure to emerging market currencies.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Currency fluctuations have been significant. The dollar has strengthened by approximately 8% against major currencies. Our emerging market positions have faced headwinds, and I recommend we hedge this exposure.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: What specific adjustments are you proposing for our portfolio allocation? We need to balance risk mitigation with maintaining reasonable returns.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I propose increasing our allocation to inflation-protected securities and commodities, reducing exposure to long-duration bonds due to interest rate risk, and diversifying into sectors that historically perform well during tightening cycles, such as financials and energy.

quiz.question: The central bank has ___ the benchmark rate three times this year to combat rising inflation.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja yang benar adalah 'raised' (transitive verb) karena memerlukan objek 'the benchmark rate'. 'Risen' adalah intransitive verb yang tidak memerlukan objek, sedangkan 'raise' adalah bentuk infinitive tanpa 'to' atau present tense yang tidak sesuai dengan present perfect tense dalam kalimat ini.

quiz.question: If inflation ___ to rise above 5%, investors should consider reallocating their portfolios toward defensive assets.
quiz.explanation: Dalam first conditional (real condition), klausa 'if' menggunakan present simple ('continues'), bukan future ('will continue'). 'Continued' adalah past tense yang tidak tepat untuk kondisi di masa depan yang mungkin terjadi.

quiz.question: Portfolio diversification ___ recommended by financial advisors to mitigate risk during periods of market volatility.
quiz.explanation: Subject 'portfolio diversification' adalah singular noun phrase, sehingga memerlukan verb 'is'. Ini adalah passive voice dalam present simple untuk menyatakan fakta umum. 'Are' digunakan untuk plural subject, sedangkan 'being' tidak lengkap tanpa auxiliary verb.

quiz.question: The government's expansionary fiscal policy ___ economic growth, but it may also contribute to inflationary pressures.
quiz.explanation: Pola yang benar dengan verb 'aim' adalah 'aim to + infinitive' untuk menyatakan tujuan atau niat. 'Aims stimulating' salah karena setelah 'aim' harus menggunakan 'to'. 'Is aiming stimulate' salah karena setelah 'aiming' perlu preposisi 'to' sebelum infinitive atau bisa langsung 'at stimulating'.

quiz.question: Market volatility has increased significantly, ___ makes it crucial for investors to review their risk tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 'Which' adalah relative pronoun yang tepat untuk non-defining relative clause (dengan koma) yang merujuk ke seluruh klausa sebelumnya. 'What' tidak bisa digunakan sebagai relative pronoun dengan antecedent yang jelas. 'That' tidak bisa digunakan setelah koma dalam non-defining relative clause.

modules.title: Participle Clauses for Concise Writing & Narrative Flow
modules.objective: Menyingkat klausa adverbial menggunakan present and past participle clauses (Having finished, Seen from above).

theory.summary: Participle clauses adalah cara efektif untuk membuat tulisan lebih ringkas dan mengalir natural. Teknik ini umum digunakan dalam penulisan akademis, jurnalistik, dan narasi profesional. Participle clauses menggantikan klausa adverbial penuh (while, when, because, after) dengan bentuk verb yang lebih singkat. Ada tiga jenis: present participle (-ing), past participle (-ed/V3), dan perfect participle (having + V3). Penggunaan yang tepat membuat tulisan Anda terdengar lebih sophisticated dan efisien.
rules: Present Participle Clause: V-ing menunjukkan aksi yang terjadi bersamaan dengan aksi utama atau sebagai alasan. Formula: V-ing + ..., subject + main verb. Contoh: 'Walking through the park, I noticed the cherry blossoms.' (= While I was walking...)

Past Participle Clause: V3 digunakan untuk makna pasif atau kondisi. Formula: V3 + ..., subject + main verb. Contoh: 'Seen from above, the city looks like a miniature model.' (= When it is seen from above...)

Perfect Participle Clause: Having + V3 menunjukkan aksi yang selesai sebelum aksi utama. Formula: Having + V3 + ..., subject + main verb. Contoh: 'Having finished the report, she submitted it to her manager.' (= After she had finished...)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Dangling Participle - Subjek Tidak Konsisten
commonTrap.explanation: Kesalahan paling umum adalah dangling participle, di mana subjek dari participle clause berbeda dengan subjek kalimat utama. Ini menciptakan kalimat yang rancu atau bahkan lucu. Subjek participle clause HARUS sama dengan subjek kalimat utama.
commonTrap.wrong: Walking through the park, the flowers looked beautiful.
commonTrap.correct: Walking through the park, I noticed the flowers looked beautiful.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah pernyataan yang BENAR mengenai kaidah pada topik "Participle Clauses for Concise Writing & Narrative Flow"?
options: Pola ini hanya boleh digunakan dalam situasi santai
Tenses dan susunan subjek tidak perlu diperhatikan
Present Participle Clause: V-ing menunjukkan aksi yang terjadi bersamaan dengan aksi ut...
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kaidah inti topik ini: Participle clauses adalah cara efektif untuk membuat tulisan lebih ringkas dan mengalir natural.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Di antara pilihan berikut, manakah kalimat yang menggunakan tata bahasa baku yang tepat?
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kesalahan paling umum adalah dangling participle, di mana subjek dari participle clause berbeda dengan subjek kalimat utama. Ini menciptakan kalimat yang rancu atau bahkan lucu. Subjek participle clause HARUS sama dengan subjek kalimat utama.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
David: "Looking at our draft proposal, I think we need to make it more concise. It's running to 15 pages."
Amara: "[...]"
options: Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
You're right. Having reviewed similar successful proposals, I noticed they rarely exceed 10 pages. We should use more participle clauses.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "You're right. Having reviewed similar successful proposals, I noticed they rarely exceed 10 pages. We should use more participle clauses." ("Benar juga. Setelah mengulas proposal sukses yang serupa, aku perhatikan jarang yang melebihi 10 halaman. Kita sebaiknya pakai lebih banyak participle clauses.") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Amara.

vocab.collocation: The executive summary should be concise yet comprehensive, covering all key points in two pages.
Having analyzed the data thoroughly, several patterns began to emerge from the research.
Working on multiple projects simultaneously, the team managed to meet all deadlines efficiently.
Faced with such intricate problems, the engineers developed innovative solutions over several months.
Having read the instructions carefully, most students were able to comprehend the assignment requirements.
Viewed from a historical perspective, this decision marked a turning point in the company's development.
Working tirelessly for months, their efforts culminated in a successful product launch last week.
Overwhelmed by the positive response, the small business struggled to keep up with orders.
Having established the foundation, subsequent phases focused on implementation and testing procedures.
Considering the merits of both proposals, the committee decided to combine elements from each approach.

dialogue.context: Dua kolega sedang mendiskusikan strategi penulisan untuk proposal proyek penting mereka di kantor.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Looking at our draft proposal, I think we need to make it more concise. It's running to 15 pages.
lines.translation: Melihat draft proposal kita, menurutku perlu dibuat lebih ringkas. Ini sudah sampai 15 halaman.

lines.speaker: Amara
lines.text: You're right. Having reviewed similar successful proposals, I noticed they rarely exceed 10 pages. We should use more participle clauses.
lines.translation: Benar juga. Setelah mengulas proposal sukses yang serupa, aku perhatikan jarang yang melebihi 10 halaman. Kita sebaiknya pakai lebih banyak participle clauses.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Good idea. For example, instead of 'Because we conducted extensive market research,' we could write 'Having conducted extensive market research...'
lines.translation: Ide bagus. Misalnya, daripada 'Because we conducted extensive market research,' kita bisa tulis 'Having conducted extensive market research...'

lines.speaker: Amara
lines.text: Exactly. And we can replace 'When the data is viewed from a regional perspective' with 'Viewed from a regional perspective.' Much cleaner.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Dan kita bisa ganti 'When the data is viewed from a regional perspective' dengan 'Viewed from a regional perspective.' Jauh lebih bersih.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I'm concerned about one thing though. We need to avoid dangling participles. I saw this sentence: 'Working on the budget, several errors were found.'
lines.translation: Tapi aku khawatir satu hal. Kita perlu hindari dangling participles. Aku lihat kalimat ini: 'Working on the budget, several errors were found.'

lines.speaker: Amara
lines.text: Oh yes, that's wrong because 'errors' weren't working on the budget. It should be 'Working on the budget, we found several errors.' The subject must match.
lines.translation: Oh iya, itu salah karena 'errors' tidak sedang mengerjakan anggaran. Seharusnya 'Working on the budget, we found several errors.' Subjeknya harus cocok.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Perfect. Let's spend the next hour revising together. Combining our skills, we should finish this by the end of the day.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Mari kita habiskan satu jam ke depan merevisi bersama. Dengan menggabungkan kemampuan kita, harusnya selesai akhir hari ini.

lines.speaker: Amara
lines.text: Agreed. Having worked on this for weeks, I really want to submit our best version tomorrow morning.
lines.translation: Setuju. Setelah mengerjakan ini berminggu-minggu, aku benar-benar ingin kirimkan versi terbaik kita besok pagi.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang cara meningkatkan gaya penulisan akademis Anda dengan menggunakan participle clauses secara efektif.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I've noticed your recent essays show good content, but the writing style could be more sophisticated. Have you tried using participle clauses to make your sentences flow better?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! I've heard about them but I'm not entirely confident using them. Could you give me a practical example?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Of course! Instead of writing 'Because I studied the literature thoroughly, I understood the key theories,' you could write 'Having studied the literature thoroughly, I understood the key theories.' See how much more concise it is?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That does sound more academic! So the participle clause replaces the conjunction and makes it shorter?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Exactly! But be careful about one common mistake. What's wrong with this sentence: 'Walking into the library, the books were everywhere.' Can you identify the problem?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Oh, I think the books weren't walking into the library! The subject should be a person. Maybe 'Walking into the library, I saw books everywhere'?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! That's called avoiding a dangling participle. The subject of both clauses must be the same. Now, try transforming this sentence: 'After we completed the experiment, we analyzed the results.'

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Let me try... 'Having completed the experiment, we analyzed the results.' Is that correct?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent work! You've got it. Keep practicing this in your next essay, and your writing will sound much more fluent and professional.

quiz.question: Having ___ all the requirements, the application was submitted successfully.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'met' (past participle) karena ini adalah perfect participle clause (Having + V3) yang menunjukkan aksi selesai sebelum aksi utama. 'Having met all the requirements' berarti 'setelah memenuhi semua persyaratan'. Subjeknya implisit sama dengan subjek utama (the applicant/we).

quiz.question: ___ from a business perspective, the proposal offers significant cost savings.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'Viewed' (past participle) karena ini makna pasif - proposal 'dilihat' bukan 'melihat'. Past participle clause digunakan untuk kondisi atau keadaan pasif. Kalimat lengkapnya adalah 'When it is viewed from a business perspective'.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses a participle clause without a dangling participle?
options: Driving through the city, the traffic was terrible.
Driving through the city, we encountered terrible traffic.
Driving through the city, terrible traffic was everywhere.
quiz.answer: Driving through the city, we encountered terrible traffic.
quiz.explanation: Opsi ini benar karena subjek participle clause (we - yang sedang mengemudi) sama dengan subjek kalimat utama (we). Opsi pertama dan ketiga salah karena 'traffic' tidak bisa 'driving' - ini adalah dangling participle yang harus dihindari.

quiz.question: ___ the instructions carefully, most students completed the task without difficulty.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'Having read' (perfect participle) karena aksi membaca selesai SEBELUM aksi menyelesaikan tugas. Perfect participle clause (Having + V3) menunjukkan urutan waktu yang jelas: siswa sudah selesai membaca, baru kemudian berhasil menyelesaikan tugas.

quiz.question: Which sentence is INCORRECT due to improper participle clause usage?
options: Working late every night, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
Working late every night, the team completed the project ahead of schedule.
Having worked late every night, the team felt exhausted but satisfied.
quiz.answer: Working late every night, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini salah karena dangling participle: 'the project' tidak bisa 'working late every night'. Subjek participle clause harus orang (the team), bukan benda (the project). Dua opsi lainnya benar karena subjeknya konsisten.

modules.title: Artificial Intelligence, Automation & The Future of Human Labor
modules.objective: Mendebat transformasi pasar tenaga kerja akibat AI, otomatisasi cerdas, dan pergeseran keahlian manusia.

theory.summary: Modul ini membahas dampak revolusioner kecerdasan buatan (AI) dan otomatisasi terhadap pasar tenaga kerja global. Di level B2, Anda akan belajar mengekspresikan argumen kompleks tentang pergeseran ekonomi, mendiskusikan implikasi etis dari penggantian pekerjaan manusia, dan menganalisis keahlian baru yang dibutuhkan di era digital. Kemampuan untuk berargumen dengan struktur yang koheren, menggunakan kosakata ekonomi-teknologi, dan menyatakan posisi dengan nuansa sangat penting untuk diskusi profesional dan akademis.
rules: Gunakan modal verbs untuk spekulasi masa depan: 'may/might/could replace', 'is likely to transform', 'will inevitably change'. Contoh: 'AI might displace up to 30% of jobs by 2030.'

Gunakan passive voice untuk fokus pada proses dan dampak: 'Jobs are being automated', 'Workers will be required to reskill', 'Traditional roles have been replaced'. Contoh: 'Routine tasks are increasingly being performed by machines.'

Gunakan conditional sentences untuk skenario hipotetis: 'If automation continues at this pace, workers will need...', 'Should companies invest in retraining, employees could...'. Contoh: 'If governments fail to adapt education systems, unemployment rates could surge.'

Gunakan cohesive devices untuk argumen: 'Nevertheless', 'On the contrary', 'Furthermore', 'Consequently', 'In spite of this'. Contoh: 'Nevertheless, human creativity remains irreplaceable in many sectors.'

Gunakan hedging language untuk nuansa akademis: 'It appears that', 'There is evidence to suggest', 'To some extent', 'arguably'. Contoh: 'It appears that soft skills will become increasingly valuable.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Modal Verbs untuk Prediksi
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar B2 menggunakan 'will' terlalu pasti untuk prediksi masa depan yang masih spekulatif. Dalam konteks debat AI dan tenaga kerja, gunakan 'may', 'might', 'could' untuk kemungkinan, dan 'will' hanya untuk prediksi yang sangat yakin atau fakta logis.
commonTrap.wrong: AI will definitely replace all human workers in the next decade.
commonTrap.correct: AI may replace certain categories of workers, though human roles will likely evolve rather than disappear entirely.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang paling tepat menggunakan modal verbs untuk menyatakan prediksi spekulatif tentang masa depan AI di pasar tenaga kerja.
options: AI will replace every single human job by 2030 without exception.
AI might displace a significant number of routine jobs in the coming years.
AI can replacing human workers because it is faster and more efficient.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Penggunaan 'might' adalah modal verb yang tepat untuk menyatakan kemungkinan atau spekulasi. Pilihan pertama terlalu absolut, dan pilihan ketiga salah secara tata bahasa (seharusnya 'can replace').

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat dan bernuansa akademis untuk memprediksi dampak AI, menghindari penggunaan 'will' yang terlalu pasti?
options: It is certain that AI will destroy all traditional jobs immediately.
AI may lead to significant job displacement, though it could also create new opportunities.
AI will definitely make every worker redundant in the next five years.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Penggunaan 'may' dan 'could' memberikan nuansa spekulatif yang tepat untuk prediksi masa depan, berbeda dengan 'will' yang terlalu absolut dan kurang akademis dalam konteks debat.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut mengenai tanggung jawab perusahaan: 'Many employees fear their roles will become [...]. Therefore, companies must prioritize [...] to keep their workforce relevant.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Redundant' (tidak diperlukan lagi) adalah kata yang tepat untuk menggambarkan ketakutan karyawan akan kehilangan pekerjaan, dan 'upskilling' (peningkatan keterampilan) adalah solusi yang tepat untuk menjaga relevansi tenaga kerja.

vocab.meaning: otomatisasi, penggunaan teknologi untuk menjalankan tugas tanpa campur tangan manusia
vocab.collocation: The automation of manufacturing processes has led to significant productivity gains but also job displacement.

vocab.meaning: perpindahan, penggantian (dalam konteks pekerjaan yang hilang)
vocab.collocation: Job displacement due to AI is a growing concern among economists and policymakers.

vocab.meaning: peningkatan keterampilan, proses belajar kemampuan baru untuk tetap relevan
vocab.collocation: Companies are investing heavily in upskilling programs to prepare their workforce for digital transformation.

vocab.meaning: mubazir, tidak diperlukan lagi (sering untuk pekerjaan yang digantikan)
vocab.collocation: As machines take over repetitive tasks, many manual labor positions may become redundant.

vocab.meaning: menambah, memperkuat (AI yang membantu, bukan mengganti manusia)
vocab.collocation: Rather than replacing doctors, AI can augment their diagnostic capabilities and improve patient outcomes.

vocab.meaning: gangguan besar, perubahan drastis pada sistem yang ada
vocab.collocation: The technological disruption in the labor market requires urgent policy responses from governments.

vocab.meaning: pelatihan ulang, belajar keterampilan baru untuk pekerjaan berbeda
vocab.collocation: Reskilling initiatives are essential for workers whose jobs have been eliminated by automation.

vocab.meaning: algoritma, serangkaian instruksi untuk komputer memecahkan masalah
vocab.collocation: Advanced algorithms can now perform complex decision-making tasks previously done by humans.

vocab.meaning: kognitif, berkaitan dengan proses mental seperti berpikir dan memahami
vocab.collocation: Even cognitive tasks like legal research and financial analysis are being automated by AI systems.
The workforce will inevitably need to adapt as technology continues to advance at an unprecedented pace.

dialogue.context: Maya, seorang konsultan HR, sedang berdiskusi dengan Daniel, seorang engineer AI, tentang dampak otomatisasi terhadap tenaga kerja di sebuah konferensi industri.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Daniel, I've been reading alarming statistics about job displacement. Do you think AI will inevitably lead to mass unemployment?
lines.translation: Daniel, saya baru membaca statistik yang mengkhawatirkan tentang penggantian pekerjaan. Apakah menurutmu AI pasti akan menyebabkan pengangguran massal?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's a common misconception, Maya. While automation will certainly make some roles redundant, history shows that technology also creates new job categories we can't even imagine yet.
lines.translation: Itu adalah kesalahpahaman yang umum, Maya. Meskipun otomatisasi pasti akan membuat beberapa peran menjadi mubazir, sejarah menunjukkan bahwa teknologi juga menciptakan kategori pekerjaan baru yang bahkan belum bisa kita bayangkan.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Nevertheless, the transition period could be devastating for workers, particularly those in routine manual labor. What's your view on corporate responsibility in this disruption?
lines.translation: Namun demikian, periode transisi bisa sangat merugikan pekerja, terutama mereka yang bekerja di bidang tenaga kerja manual rutin. Apa pandanganmu tentang tanggung jawab perusahaan dalam gangguan ini?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Absolutely. Companies should invest in upskilling and reskilling programs. At our firm, we're committed to retraining employees whose positions are being automated rather than simply laying them off.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Perusahaan harus berinvestasi dalam program peningkatan dan pelatihan ulang keterampilan. Di perusahaan kami, kami berkomitmen untuk melatih kembali karyawan yang posisinya sedang diotomatisasi daripada hanya memberhentikan mereka.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's encouraging, but isn't there a limit? Can a 50-year-old factory worker realistically transition to become a data analyst?
lines.translation: Itu menggembirakan, tapi bukankah ada batasnya? Bisakah seorang pekerja pabrik berusia 50 tahun secara realistis bertransisi menjadi analis data?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Perhaps not everyone, which is why we need policy solutions too. Universal basic income, for instance, might address the challenges that reskilling alone cannot solve.
lines.translation: Mungkin tidak semua orang, itulah mengapa kita juga memerlukan solusi kebijakan. Pendapatan dasar universal, misalnya, mungkin dapat mengatasi tantangan yang tidak bisa diselesaikan hanya dengan pelatihan ulang.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I see your point. So you're saying AI should augment human capabilities rather than completely replace them. How do we ensure that's the path we take?
lines.translation: Saya paham maksudmu. Jadi kamu bilang AI seharusnya memperkuat kemampuan manusia daripada sepenuhnya menggantikan mereka. Bagaimana kita memastikan itu adalah jalur yang kita ambil?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Through regulation, ethical AI development, and most importantly, designing systems that prioritize human-machine collaboration. The future of work depends on the choices we make today.
lines.translation: Melalui regulasi, pengembangan AI yang etis, dan yang paling penting, merancang sistem yang memprioritaskan kolaborasi manusia-mesin. Masa depan pekerjaan bergantung pada pilihan yang kita buat hari ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda akan berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang dampak AI terhadap profesi Anda sendiri atau profesi yang Anda minati. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pendapat Anda dan membantu Anda mengembangkan argumen yang koheren dengan bahasa B2.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll discuss how AI and automation might affect your career or a profession you're interested in. First, could you tell me what field you work in or would like to work in?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I work in marketing, specifically digital content creation.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting choice! Marketing is certainly being transformed by AI. What aspects of your work do you think are most vulnerable to automation, and which ones will remain uniquely human?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I believe routine tasks like data analysis and basic copywriting might be automated, but creative strategy and understanding human emotions will remain human skills.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent analysis. Now, let's think about this from another angle. Some argue that AI could actually augment creative work rather than replace it. How might AI tools enhance your capabilities as a marketer?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: AI could help me analyze consumer behavior patterns more quickly, allowing me to focus more time on developing innovative campaign concepts.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a balanced perspective. Nevertheless, many professionals fear they'll become redundant. What steps do you think workers in your field should take to remain competitive in an AI-driven market?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We should invest in upskilling, particularly in areas that AI cannot easily replicate, such as emotional intelligence, strategic thinking, and cross-cultural communication.

quiz.question: The company is investing heavily in ___ programs to prepare employees for the transition to automated systems.
quiz.explanation: Upskilling adalah istilah yang tepat untuk program peningkatan keterampilan karyawan agar mereka tetap relevan dengan teknologi baru. Downsizing berarti pengurangan karyawan, dan outsourcing berarti mengalihdayakan pekerjaan ke pihak luar, keduanya bukan solusi untuk mempersiapkan karyawan menghadapi otomatisasi.

quiz.question: Many economists argue that technological ___ in the labor market requires urgent policy interventions from governments.
quiz.explanation: Disruption (gangguan/perubahan drastis) adalah kata yang tepat untuk menggambarkan dampak besar teknologi terhadap pasar tenaga kerja. Continuation (kelanjutan) dan stabilization (stabilisasi) memiliki makna yang berlawanan dengan perubahan drastis yang sedang dibahas.

quiz.question: Rather than replacing human workers entirely, AI systems can ___ their capabilities and improve overall productivity.
quiz.explanation: Augment berarti memperkuat atau meningkatkan kemampuan manusia dengan bantuan AI, yang merupakan pandangan optimis tentang kolaborasi manusia-mesin. Diminish (mengurangi) dan eliminate (menghilangkan) memiliki konotasi negatif yang bertentangan dengan konteks kalimat yang menunjukkan AI sebagai alat bantu.

quiz.question: As machines take over repetitive administrative tasks, some traditional office positions may become ___.
quiz.explanation: Redundant berarti tidak diperlukan lagi atau mubazir, yang menggambarkan posisi pekerjaan yang digantikan oleh mesin. Essential (penting) dan promoted (dipromosikan) memiliki makna positif yang tidak sesuai dengan konteks penggantian pekerjaan oleh otomatisasi.

quiz.question: The workforce will ___ need to adapt as artificial intelligence continues to advance at an unprecedented pace.
quiz.explanation: Inevitably (tak terelakkan) menyatakan kepastian bahwa tenaga kerja harus beradaptasi menghadapi kemajuan AI. Occasionally (kadang-kadang) dan rarely (jarang) menunjukkan frekuensi yang rendah dan tidak sesuai dengan konteks yang menekankan keharusan adaptasi menghadapi perubahan teknologi yang cepat.

modules.title: Complex Phrasal Verbs & Prepositional Combinations in Executive Discourse
modules.objective: Menguasai frasa kerja idiomatis dan kolokasi preposisi tingkat mahir dalam konteks eksekutif.

theory.summary: Phrasal verbs kompleks dan kombinasi preposisi adalah elemen kunci dalam komunikasi bisnis tingkat eksekutif. Berbeda dengan phrasal verbs dasar, frasa-frasa ini sering memiliki makna idiomatis yang tidak bisa ditebak dari kata-kata penyusunnya. Dalam konteks profesional, penguasaan ekspresi seperti 'iron out difficulties', 'boil down to essentials', 'branch out into new markets', dan 'factor in variables' menunjukkan kemahiran bahasa yang tinggi dan pemahaman nuansa bisnis. Phrasal verbs eksekutif ini sering digunakan dalam presentasi, negosiasi, laporan strategis, dan diskusi manajemen senior.
rules: Iron out = menyelesaikan masalah atau kesulitan secara detail | Formula: iron out + [problem/issue/difficulty] | Contoh: 'We need to iron out the contractual issues before signing.'
Boil down to = pada intinya adalah, bermuara pada | Formula: [situation] + boil down to + [core issue] | Contoh: 'The dispute boils down to a difference in interpretation.'
Branch out (into) = memperluas bisnis ke area baru | Formula: branch out into + [new market/field/area] | Contoh: 'The company is branching out into renewable energy sectors.'
Factor in = memasukkan dalam perhitungan, mempertimbangkan | Formula: factor in + [variable/cost/consideration] | Contoh: 'Have you factored in the potential regulatory changes?'
Phase out = menghentikan secara bertahap | Formula: phase out + [product/system/practice] | Contoh: 'We're phasing out the legacy system over the next quarter.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Pemisahan Partikel
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar B2 salah memisahkan atau menggabungkan partikel phrasal verb dengan objeknya. Beberapa phrasal verbs dapat dipisahkan (separable), sementara yang lain tidak (inseparable). Phrasal verbs tiga kata seperti 'boil down to' dan 'factor in' memiliki aturan posisi khusus.
commonTrap.wrong: We need to iron the problems out before the merger completes.
commonTrap.correct: We need to iron out the problems before the merger completes.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan frasa kerja 'branch out into' dengan benar dalam konteks bisnis.
options: The company plans to branch out into the pharmaceutical industry next year.
We need to branch out the new market into our current strategy.
They decided to branch out the services into different departments.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Branch out into' digunakan untuk menyatakan ekspansi bisnis ke area atau pasar baru. Pilihan lain salah karena penggunaan struktur kalimat yang tidak lazim.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar secara tata bahasa terkait penempatan objek untuk phrasal verb 'factor in'?
options: We must factor the risks in before making a final decision.
We must factor in the risks before making a final decision.
We must factor the risks in the decision.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Factor in' adalah phrasal verb yang tidak dipisahkan (inseparable) ketika diikuti oleh objek langsung, sehingga objek harus diletakkan setelah partikel 'in'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut: 'The project seems complicated, but when it [...] the core issue is simply a lack of funding.'
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Boil down to' digunakan untuk menyatakan inti atau kesimpulan dari suatu situasi yang kompleks, yang sangat cocok dengan konteks kalimat tersebut.

vocab.collocation: The legal teams are working to iron out the final details of the acquisition agreement.
After hours of debate, the decision boils down to cost versus quality.
Our retail chain is branching out into e-commerce to capture younger demographics.
When projecting revenue, we must factor in seasonal variations and market volatility.
The government plans to phase out fossil fuel subsidies over the next five years.
Due to budget constraints, we need to scale back our international expansion plans.
The board hasn't fully bought into the digital transformation strategy yet.
The CEO announced she will step down at the end of the fiscal year.
We're rolling out the new customer relationship management system across all departments.
Let's hold off on making any announcements until the audit is complete.

dialogue.context: Jennifer (Chief Strategy Officer) dan Marcus (CFO) sedang membahas rencana ekspansi perusahaan dalam rapat eksekutif di ruang board room.

lines.speaker: Jennifer
lines.text: Marcus, I've reviewed the expansion proposal. The numbers look promising, but have we factored in the regulatory costs for entering the Southeast Asian markets?
lines.translation: Marcus, saya sudah meninjau proposal ekspansi. Angka-angkanya terlihat menjanjikan, tapi apakah kita sudah memasukkan biaya regulasi untuk masuk ke pasar Asia Tenggara dalam perhitungan?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Good question. We've included preliminary estimates, but there are still some compliance issues we need to iron out with local authorities before we can finalize the budget.
lines.translation: Pertanyaan bagus. Kami sudah memasukkan estimasi awal, tapi masih ada beberapa masalah kepatuhan yang perlu kami selesaikan dengan otoritas lokal sebelum kami bisa menyelesaikan anggaran.

lines.speaker: Jennifer
lines.text: I see. The board is eager to branch out into new markets, but they want assurance that we're not overextending ourselves financially.
lines.translation: Saya paham. Dewan komisaris sangat ingin memperluas ke pasar baru, tapi mereka menginginkan jaminan bahwa kita tidak memaksakan diri secara finansial.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Absolutely. When it all boils down to it, we're looking at a three-year break-even timeline. But if currency fluctuations worsen, we may need to scale back our initial investment.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Pada intinya, kita melihat timeline impas tiga tahun. Tapi jika fluktuasi mata uang memburuk, kita mungkin perlu mengurangi investasi awal kita.

lines.speaker: Jennifer
lines.text: That's prudent. Should we hold off on the announcement until after Q2 results, or roll out the strategy now to boost investor confidence?
lines.translation: Itu bijaksana. Haruskah kita menunda pengumuman sampai setelah hasil Q2, atau meluncurkan strategi sekarang untuk meningkatkan kepercayaan investor?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: I'd recommend we iron out the legal framework first, then make the announcement. We don't want to commit publicly before all the pieces are in place.
lines.translation: Saya merekomendasikan kita selesaikan kerangka hukum dulu, baru buat pengumuman. Kita tidak ingin berkomitmen secara publik sebelum semua bagian sudah siap.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang manajer proyek yang sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang strategi peluncuran produk baru. Gunakan phrasal verbs eksekutif yang telah dipelajari untuk menjelaskan rencana dan keputusan bisnis Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning! I understand you're leading the new product launch. What's the current status of the project?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Khoirul. We're making good progress, but we still need to iron out some supply chain issues with our overseas manufacturers.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. Have you factored in the potential delays from the shipping disruptions we've been experiencing?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, we've factored in an additional three-week buffer in our timeline. The real challenge boils down to coordinating with multiple vendors simultaneously.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That makes sense. Are you still planning to branch out into the European market, or should we hold off on that expansion?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We're recommending we hold off on Europe for now and focus on consolidating our position in North America first. We may need to scale back our initial targets.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wise decision. When do you plan to roll out the marketing campaign?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We'll roll out the campaign in phases, starting with digital channels in early November, followed by traditional media in December.

quiz.question: The negotiations are complex, but when everything ___ to it, we're only disagreeing about the delivery schedule.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'boils down' karena ungkapan 'boil down to' berarti 'pada intinya adalah' atau 'bermuara pada'. Dalam konteks ini, pembicara mengatakan bahwa meskipun negosiasi kompleks, inti permasalahannya hanya tentang jadwal pengiriman. 'Iron out' berarti menyelesaikan masalah detail, sedangkan 'phase out' berarti menghentikan secara bertahap.

quiz.question: Before we finalize the merger, we need to ___ all the intellectual property issues with both legal teams.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'iron out' yang berarti menyelesaikan atau meluruskan masalah-masalah detail. Dalam konteks merger, masalah hak kekayaan intelektual perlu diselesaikan secara mendetail sebelum finalisasi. 'Branch out' berarti memperluas ke area baru, dan 'factor in' berarti memasukkan dalam perhitungan, keduanya tidak sesuai dengan konteks menyelesaikan masalah.

quiz.question: The retail company is planning to ___ into financial services to diversify its revenue streams.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'branch out' yang berarti memperluas bisnis ke bidang atau area baru. Dalam konteks ini, perusahaan ritel ingin merambah ke layanan keuangan untuk diversifikasi. 'Step down' berarti mengundurkan diri dari jabatan, dan 'hold off' berarti menunda, keduanya tidak sesuai dengan konteks ekspansi bisnis.

quiz.question: When calculating the project budget, don't forget to ___ the cost of training and change management.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'factor in' yang berarti memasukkan dalam perhitungan atau mempertimbangkan. Dalam konteks perencanaan anggaran, biaya pelatihan dan manajemen perubahan harus dimasukkan dalam kalkulasi. 'Scale back' berarti mengurangi skala, dan 'roll out' berarti meluncurkan, keduanya tidak sesuai dengan konteks memasukkan biaya dalam perhitungan.

quiz.question: Due to environmental concerns, the government will ___ single-use plastics over the next two years.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'phase out' yang berarti menghentikan atau menghapuskan secara bertahap. Dalam konteks kebijakan lingkungan, plastik sekali pakai akan dihentikan penggunaannya secara bertahap selama dua tahun. 'Buy into' berarti menerima ide atau membeli saham, dan 'iron out' berarti menyelesaikan masalah detail, keduanya tidak sesuai dengan konteks penghentian bertahap.

modules.title: Negotiation Tactics: Concessions, Leverage & Overcoming Deadlocks
modules.objective: Menerapkan taktik tawar-menawar strategis, memberikan konsesi kondisional, dan memecahkan kebuntuan perundingan.

theory.summary: Negosiasi tingkat lanjut memerlukan kemampuan untuk memberikan konsesi secara strategis, memanfaatkan leverage (daya tawar), dan memecahkan deadlock (kebuntuan). Di level B2, Anda akan mempelajari bagaimana menggunakan conditional concessions (konsesi bersyarat) seperti 'I'd be willing to... provided that...', framing win-win solutions dengan bahasa diplomatik, dan teknik untuk keluar dari situasi buntu tanpa kehilangan posisi tawar. Keterampilan ini sangat penting dalam konteks bisnis, diplomasi, dan negosiasi profesional di mana hasil saling menguntungkan adalah tujuan utama.
rules: Conditional Concessions: Gunakan struktur 'If... then...' atau 'Provided that... we could...' untuk menunjukkan konsesi bersyarat. Formula: 'I'd be willing to + [concession] + if/provided that + [condition]'. Contoh: 'I'd be willing to reduce the price by 10% provided that you commit to a two-year contract.'

Leverage Language: Gunakan frasa yang menunjukkan kekuatan posisi Anda tanpa terdengar agresif. Formula: 'Given that + [your advantage], + it would make sense to + [your proposal]'. Contoh: 'Given that we're the market leader, it would make sense to establish a premium pricing tier.'

Deadlock Breaking: Gunakan frasa reframing seperti 'Perhaps we could look at this from a different angle' atau 'What if we were to...'. Contoh: 'We seem to be at an impasse. What if we were to explore a phased implementation instead?'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar level B2 memberikan konsesi tanpa syarat atau menggunakan bahasa yang terlalu langsung sehingga terdengar konfrontatif. Hindari memberikan konsesi secara absolut tanpa mendapatkan sesuatu sebagai balasan.
commonTrap.wrong: We can lower the price to $50,000. That's our final offer.
commonTrap.correct: We'd be prepared to lower the price to $50,000, provided that you're able to confirm the order by the end of this week.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat menggunakan struktur 'conditional concession' untuk menawarkan kompromi dalam negosiasi?
options: I'd be willing to extend the payment deadline, provided that you increase the order volume.
I'd be willing to extend the payment deadline, although you increase the order volume.
I'd be willing to extend the payment deadline, so you increase the order volume.
