readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur 'I'd be willing to + [concession] + provided that + [condition]' adalah cara yang tepat untuk memberikan konsesi bersyarat. Opsi lainnya salah karena menggunakan kata hubung yang tidak logis untuk menyatakan syarat.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam negosiasi, Anda harus menghindari memberikan konsesi tanpa syarat. Manakah kalimat yang menunjukkan cara yang benar untuk memberikan konsesi?
options: We can lower the price to $10,000 for you immediately.
We'd be prepared to lower the price to $10,000, provided that you sign a long-term agreement.
We can lower the price to $10,000, so you should be happy with that.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Memberikan konsesi harus selalu disertai dengan syarat (conditional) agar Anda mendapatkan sesuatu sebagai balasan. Opsi 0 dan 2 adalah konsesi tanpa syarat yang merugikan posisi tawar Anda.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam situasi negosiasi yang buntu (impasse), manakah respon yang paling tepat dan profesional untuk memecahkan kebuntuan tersebut?
options: What if we were to explore a phased delivery schedule instead?
Perhaps we could just ignore the delivery date for now.
Given that we are the market leader, you must accept our timeline.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Frasa 'What if we were to...' adalah teknik reframing yang efektif untuk memecahkan kebuntuan tanpa terdengar agresif atau tidak profesional.

vocab.meaning: daya tawar, pengaruh yang dapat digunakan untuk mencapai hasil yang diinginkan
vocab.collocation: We need to use our market position as leverage in these negotiations.

vocab.meaning: konsesi, pengorbanan atau kompromi yang diberikan dalam negosiasi
vocab.collocation: I'm willing to make some concessions on delivery time if you can be flexible on payment terms.

vocab.meaning: kebuntuan, situasi di mana tidak ada kemajuan yang dapat dibuat
vocab.collocation: We've reached a deadlock on the pricing issue and need to find a creative solution.

vocab.meaning: jalan buntu, situasi sulit yang tampaknya tidak ada solusinya
vocab.collocation: After three hours of discussion, we seem to have reached an impasse.

vocab.meaning: kompromi, kesepakatan yang dicapai dengan saling memberi dan menerima
vocab.collocation: Both parties need to be willing to compromise if we want to reach an agreement.
Our offer is contingent upon receiving board approval by next Friday.
We're looking for a reciprocal arrangement where both sides benefit equally.
There's one stipulation: the contract must include a performance guarantee clause.

vocab.meaning: terobosan, kemajuan penting dalam situasi sulit
vocab.collocation: We finally made a breakthrough when we proposed the revenue-sharing model.

vocab.meaning: kebuntuan total, situasi di mana tidak ada pihak yang dapat maju
vocab.collocation: To break the stalemate, we need to introduce some fresh ideas into the discussion.

dialogue.context: Sarah (pembeli) dan Michael (penjual) sedang bernegosiasi tentang kontrak pembelian perangkat lunak perusahaan. Mereka telah mencapai kebuntuan mengenai harga dan durasi kontrak.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Michael, we seem to have reached an impasse on the pricing. Your quote of $200,000 is simply beyond our approved budget.
lines.translation: Michael, sepertinya kita sudah sampai di jalan buntu soal harga. Penawaran Anda sebesar $200,000 benar-benar di luar anggaran yang sudah kami setujui.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: I understand your position, Sarah. However, given that our software includes premium features and 24/7 support, the price reflects the value we're offering. What if we were to explore a different approach?
lines.translation: Saya memahami posisi Anda, Sarah. Namun, mengingat perangkat lunak kami menyertakan fitur premium dan dukungan 24/7, harga tersebut mencerminkan nilai yang kami tawarkan. Bagaimana kalau kita coba pendekatan yang berbeda?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm listening. What do you have in mind?
lines.translation: Saya mendengarkan. Apa yang Anda pikirkan?

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: I'd be willing to reduce the price to $175,000, provided that you commit to a three-year contract instead of the two-year term you initially requested.
lines.translation: Saya bersedia menurunkan harga menjadi $175,000, dengan syarat Anda berkomitmen pada kontrak tiga tahun, bukan dua tahun seperti yang awalnya Anda minta.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's closer to our budget, but the three-year commitment is a concern. Our offer is contingent upon having an opt-out clause after year two. Could we structure it that way?
lines.translation: Itu lebih mendekati anggaran kami, tapi komitmen tiga tahun jadi masalah. Penawaran kami bergantung pada adanya klausul opt-out setelah tahun kedua. Bisakah kita menyusunnya seperti itu?

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: I see where you're coming from. Here's a reciprocal arrangement: we'll include the opt-out clause, but with one stipulation—if you exit after year two, there's a 15% early termination fee. However, if you continue into year three, we'll provide a 10% discount on any additional modules.
lines.translation: Saya paham maksud Anda. Ini pengaturan timbal balik: kami akan memasukkan klausul opt-out, tapi dengan satu syarat—jika Anda keluar setelah tahun kedua, ada biaya penghentian lebih awal sebesar 15%. Namun, jika Anda melanjutkan ke tahun ketiga, kami akan memberikan diskon 10% untuk modul tambahan apa pun.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Now that's a breakthrough! I think we can work with those terms. Let me run this by our finance team, and I'll get back to you by tomorrow with our final decision.
lines.translation: Nah, ini terobosan! Saya rasa kami bisa bekerja dengan syarat-syarat tersebut. Biarkan saya diskusikan ini dengan tim keuangan kami, dan saya akan menghubungi Anda besok dengan keputusan final kami.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Excellent. I appreciate your willingness to find a compromise, Sarah. I'll prepare the revised proposal and send it over this afternoon.
lines.translation: Bagus sekali. Saya menghargai kesediaan Anda untuk menemukan kompromi, Sarah. Saya akan menyiapkan proposal yang telah direvisi dan mengirimkannya sore ini.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang manajer pembelian yang sedang bernegosiasi dengan Mr. Khoirul, seorang supplier, mengenai kontrak pengadaan bahan baku. Terjadi deadlock karena perbedaan harga dan syarat pembayaran. Gunakan taktik negosiasi untuk mencapai kesepakatan win-win.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning! Thank you for meeting with me today. I understand we've hit a bit of a stalemate on the pricing for the raw materials contract. Shall we try to work through this?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Khoirul. Yes, I'm hoping we can find some common ground. Your current quote is $15 per unit, but our budget only allows for $12 per unit.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. The challenge is that $15 per unit already reflects our costs and a minimal margin. However, I'm wondering if we could look at this from a different angle. What order volume are we talking about?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We're looking at approximately 10,000 units per month. I'd be willing to increase our commitment to 15,000 units per month, provided that you could meet us at $13 per unit.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's an interesting proposal. Given that larger volumes would reduce our per-unit costs, I think we're getting closer. My offer is contingent upon one stipulation though—payment terms would need to be net 30 days instead of the net 60 you initially requested.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Net 30 is tight for our cash flow, but I understand your position. What if we were to compromise on net 45 days? That would give us some breathing room while still improving your payment timeline.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I think we've just made a breakthrough! I'd be prepared to accept $13 per unit with net 45 payment terms, provided the 15,000 unit monthly commitment is firm for at least 12 months. We'd also include a 5% discount if you pay within 15 days.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That sounds like a reciprocal arrangement that works for both of us. I'll need to get final approval from our CFO, but I'm confident we can move forward with these terms. Can you send me the revised contract by tomorrow?

quiz.question: I'd be willing to extend the warranty period to three years, ___ that you agree to an annual maintenance contract.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'provided' (dengan syarat) digunakan untuk membuat konsesi kondisional, menunjukkan bahwa konsesi diberikan hanya jika syarat tertentu dipenuhi. Ini adalah struktur penting dalam negosiasi strategis untuk memastikan konsesi yang Anda berikan diimbangi dengan sesuatu yang bernilai.

quiz.question: We seem to have reached an ___. Perhaps we could explore a phased implementation approach instead?
quiz.explanation: 'Impasse' berarti kebuntuan atau jalan buntu dalam negosiasi. Frasa ini digunakan untuk mengakui bahwa kemajuan telah terhenti, dan biasanya diikuti dengan saran untuk pendekatan alternatif—sebuah teknik penting dalam memecahkan deadlock.

quiz.question: ___ that we're offering exclusive distribution rights in your region, it would make sense to discuss a premium pricing structure.
quiz.explanation: 'Given that' (mengingat bahwa) digunakan untuk memperkenalkan leverage atau keunggulan posisi Anda dalam negosiasi. Struktur ini membantu membangun argumen logis untuk proposal Anda dengan mereferensikan fakta atau keuntungan yang Anda tawarkan.

quiz.question: Our acceptance of the terms is ___ upon receiving board approval by next Friday.
quiz.explanation: 'Contingent upon' (bergantung pada) adalah frasa formal yang digunakan dalam konteks negosiasi profesional untuk menunjukkan bahwa kesepakatan atau tindakan bergantung pada kondisi tertentu yang harus dipenuhi terlebih dahulu. Ini lebih formal dan tepat dibanding 'dependent on' dalam konteks bisnis.

quiz.question: Let's try to find a ___ that benefits both parties rather than continuing this deadlock.
quiz.explanation: 'Compromise' (kompromi) adalah kata kunci dalam negosiasi win-win, menunjukkan kesediaan untuk mencari solusi tengah di mana kedua belah pihak memberi dan menerima. Ini mencerminkan pendekatan kolaboratif, bukan kompetitif, dalam menyelesaikan kebuntuan.

modules.title: Academic Paper Deconstruction: Abstract Writing, Literature Review & Citation Registers
modules.objective: Menyusun ringkasan penelitian akademik, meninjau literatur, dan mengutip bukti secara ilmiah.

theory.summary: Penulisan akademik memerlukan register bahasa yang formal dan objektif. Abstract adalah ringkasan penelitian yang padat (150-250 kata) mencakup tujuan, metode, hasil, dan kesimpulan. Literature review mensintesis penelitian terdahulu untuk membangun konteks. Dalam penulisan akademik, gunakan hedging language untuk menunjukkan kehati-hatian ilmiah: 'suggests' bukan 'proves', 'appears to' bukan 'is', 'indicates' bukan 'shows definitively'. Citation menggunakan format standar (APA, Harvard, MLA) untuk memberikan credit dan memungkinkan pembaca melacak sumber. Hindari bahasa emosional atau absolut; gunakan passive voice dan nominalisasi untuk objektivitas.
rules: Hedging verbs: suggest, indicate, appear to, seem to, tend to | Contoh: 'The data suggests a correlation' bukan 'The data proves'
Reporting verbs dengan nuansa: argue, claim, assert (kuat) vs propose, suggest, imply (lemah) | Contoh: 'Smith (2024) argues that...' vs 'The findings suggest that...'
Abstract structure: Background + Aim + Method + Results + Conclusion | Contoh: 'This study investigates... Using a mixed-method approach... The results indicate... These findings suggest...'
In-text citation: (Author, Year) atau Author (Year) states... | Contoh: 'Recent research (Johnson, 2025) indicates...' atau 'Johnson (2025) found that...'
Nominalisasi untuk formalitas: 'The implementation of the policy' bukan 'When we implemented the policy' | Contoh: 'The analysis revealed...' bukan 'We analyzed and found...'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum
commonTrap.explanation: Mahasiswa sering menggunakan bahasa terlalu absolut dalam penulisan akademik, yang tidak mencerminkan kehati-hatian ilmiah. Pernyataan definitif tanpa hedging terdengar tidak profesional dan mengabaikan kemungkinan interpretasi alternatif.
commonTrap.wrong: This research proves that social media causes depression in teenagers.
commonTrap.correct: This research suggests that social media use may be associated with depressive symptoms in adolescents.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah dari kalimat berikut yang menggunakan 'hedging language' dengan tepat untuk penulisan akademik?
options: The experiment proves that the hypothesis is correct.
The data suggests that there is a correlation between the variables.
We analyzed the data and found that the results are definitely true.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam penulisan akademik, penggunaan kata kerja seperti 'suggests' lebih disarankan daripada 'proves' untuk menunjukkan kehati-hatian ilmiah dan menghindari klaim absolut.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk menghindari kesalahan umum penggunaan bahasa yang terlalu absolut dalam karya ilmiah?
options: This study proves that climate change causes extreme weather patterns.
This study demonstrates that climate change is the only cause of extreme weather.
This study indicates that climate change may contribute to the frequency of extreme weather patterns.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Penggunaan kata 'may contribute' dan 'indicates' mencerminkan kehati-hatian ilmiah, berbeda dengan pernyataan absolut yang mengabaikan kemungkinan interpretasi lain.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam diskusi mengenai literature review, Sarah ingin memperbaiki cara penyajiannya agar lebih bersifat sintesis. Manakah respon yang paling tepat?
options: I will group the studies by theme and discuss how they converge on similar findings.
I will list each author's findings in chronological order to make it clear.
I will remove the citations to make the text flow better and sound more original.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Sintesis dalam literature review yang baik melibatkan pengelompokan studi berdasarkan tema untuk membangun konteks, bukan sekadar mendaftar temuan penulis satu per satu.

vocab.meaning: berdasarkan observasi atau pengalaman, bukan teori
vocab.collocation: The study provides empirical evidence supporting the hypothesis about language acquisition.

vocab.meaning: sistem metode yang digunakan dalam penelitian
vocab.collocation: The methodology section describes the qualitative and quantitative approaches employed.

vocab.meaning: menggabungkan elemen berbeda menjadi satu kesatuan
vocab.collocation: The literature review synthesizes findings from 47 studies conducted between 2020 and 2025.
Additional data is needed to substantiate the claim that remote work increases productivity.

vocab.meaning: hubungan timbal balik antara dua variabel
vocab.collocation: The analysis revealed a strong positive correlation between study time and exam performance.

vocab.meaning: konsekuensi atau makna yang tersirat dari temuan
vocab.collocation: These findings have important implications for educational policy and classroom practice.
The research design underwent rigorous peer review before data collection commenced.
This section aims to elucidate the theoretical framework underpinning the investigation.

vocab.meaning: kelompok subjek penelitian dengan karakteristik sama
vocab.collocation: The study tracked a cohort of 500 participants over a five-year period.

vocab.meaning: memperluas kesimpulan ke situasi yang lebih luas
vocab.collocation: We cannot extrapolate these findings to other demographic groups without further research.

dialogue.context: Dr. Martinez dan seorang mahasiswa PhD, Sarah, sedang mendiskusikan draft abstract untuk paper Sarah yang akan disubmit ke konferensi internasional.

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Sarah, I've reviewed your abstract. The structure is solid, but your language is too definitive. For instance, you wrote 'this proves that AI improves learning outcomes.'
lines.translation: Sarah, saya sudah meninjau abstract kamu. Strukturnya bagus, tapi bahasanya terlalu pasti. Misalnya, kamu menulis 'ini membuktikan bahwa AI meningkatkan hasil belajar.'

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Oh, I see. Should I use hedging language instead? Maybe 'the findings suggest that AI may enhance learning outcomes'?
lines.translation: Oh, saya mengerti. Sebaiknya saya gunakan bahasa hedging ya? Mungkin 'temuan menunjukkan bahwa AI mungkin meningkatkan hasil belajar'?

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Exactly. Also, your literature review needs more synthesis. Right now, you're just listing what each author said. Try connecting the studies thematically.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Juga, literature review kamu perlu lebih banyak sintesis. Sekarang kamu hanya mencantumkan apa yang dikatakan setiap penulis. Coba hubungkan studi-studi tersebut secara tematik.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: So instead of 'Johnson found X, then Smith found Y,' I should write something like 'Recent studies converge on the view that...' and cite multiple sources?
lines.translation: Jadi daripada 'Johnson menemukan X, lalu Smith menemukan Y,' saya harus menulis seperti 'Studi-studi terkini konvergen pada pandangan bahwa...' dan mengutip beberapa sumber?

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Perfect. That demonstrates critical analysis, not just summarization. One more thing: check your citation format. You're mixing APA and Harvard styles.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Itu menunjukkan analisis kritis, bukan hanya ringkasan. Satu hal lagi: periksa format kutipan kamu. Kamu mencampur gaya APA dan Harvard.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right, I didn't notice that. I'll standardize everything to APA 7th edition. Should I also add more recent sources from 2025 and 2026?
lines.translation: Benar, saya tidak menyadarinya. Saya akan standarisasi semuanya ke APA edisi ke-7. Apakah saya juga perlu menambah sumber lebih baru dari 2025 dan 2026?

lines.speaker: Dr. Martinez
lines.text: Absolutely. It shows your research is current. Aim for at least 60% of your references from the last three years for a study in this rapidly evolving field.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Itu menunjukkan riset kamu mutakhir. Usahakan minimal 60% referensi kamu dari tiga tahun terakhir untuk studi di bidang yang berkembang pesat ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Got it. I'll revise the abstract with more hedging, synthesize the literature review, fix the citations, and update my references. Thank you, Dr. Martinez.
lines.translation: Mengerti. Saya akan revisi abstract dengan lebih banyak hedging, sintesis literature review, perbaiki kutipan, dan perbarui referensi. Terima kasih, Dr. Martinez.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul membantu Anda berlatih menyusun bagian-bagian dari academic paper. Dia akan memberikan skenario penelitian, dan Anda diminta merespons dengan bahasa akademik yang tepat, termasuk hedging dan citation.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice academic writing skills. Imagine you conducted a study on remote work productivity. Your data shows a 23% increase in output. How would you state this finding using appropriate hedging language?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The data suggests that remote work arrangements may be associated with increased productivity, with participants demonstrating approximately 23% higher output compared to the control group.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent hedging with 'suggests' and 'may be associated with.' Now, let's work on citation. How would you reference a study by Dr. Chen published in 2024 that supports your finding? Use in-text citation format.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: These findings align with previous research indicating that flexible work environments can enhance employee performance (Chen, 2024).

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect integration. Now for your literature review, you need to synthesize three studies: Roberts (2023) found remote work reduces stress, Liu (2024) found it increases autonomy, and Chen (2024) found it improves productivity. Can you synthesize these rather than just listing them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Recent literature converges on the positive outcomes of remote work arrangements, with studies highlighting reduced workplace stress (Roberts, 2023), enhanced employee autonomy (Liu, 2024), and improved productivity metrics (Chen, 2024).

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirol
turns.text: Brilliant synthesis! One final challenge: write a one-sentence abstract opener that states your research aim using appropriate academic register and nominalization.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: This investigation examines the relationship between remote work implementation and employee productivity in the technology sector during the post-pandemic period.

quiz.question:
Which sentence demonstrates appropriate hedging language for academic writing?
A research team found a link between sleep and memory performance.
options: This study proves that sleep deprivation destroys memory function.
The findings suggest that inadequate sleep may negatively impact memory performance.
Sleep definitely causes memory problems in all participants.
quiz.answer: The findings suggest that inadequate sleep may negatively impact memory performance.
quiz.explanation: Opsi ini menggunakan hedging yang tepat dengan 'suggest' dan 'may', menunjukkan kehati-hatian ilmiah. Pilihan lain terlalu absolut dengan 'proves', 'destroys', dan 'definitely' yang tidak sesuai dengan register akademik formal.

quiz.question:
Select the correct way to synthesize multiple sources in a literature review:
You need to discuss three studies about online learning effectiveness.
options: Smith (2023) said online learning is good. Then, Jones (2024) said it's effective. Also, Brown (2025) found positive results.
Numerous studies demonstrate that online learning sucks and traditional is better.
Emerging research indicates converging evidence for the effectiveness of online learning modalities (Smith, 2023; Jones, 2024; Brown, 2025).
quiz.answer: Emerging research indicates converging evidence for the effectiveness of online learning modalities (Smith, 2023; Jones, 2024; Brown, 2025).
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah sintesis yang benar karena menggabungkan beberapa sumber dalam satu pernyataan tematik dengan kutipan yang tepat. Opsi pertama hanya daftar kronologis tanpa sintesis, dan opsi kedua menggunakan bahasa tidak formal dan bias.

quiz.question:
Which abstract structure follows the correct academic format?
You're writing an abstract for an experimental study.
options: Background: Climate change is a problem. Aim: To study it. Method: We did research. Results: We found stuff. Conclusion: It's important.

This study investigates the impact of urban green spaces on air quality. Using sensor data from 15 cities over 12 months, the analysis reveals a 31% reduction in particulate matter. These findings suggest significant implications for urban planning policy.
I think green spaces are really amazing and everyone should have them because they make cities beautiful and people happy.
quiz.answer: This study investigates the impact of urban green spaces on air quality. Using sensor data from 15 cities over 12 months, the analysis reveals a 31% reduction in particulate matter. These findings suggest significant implications for urban planning policy.
quiz.explanation: Abstract ini mengikuti struktur standar: aim (investigates), method (sensor data dari 15 kota), results (31% reduction), dan conclusion (implications). Menggunakan bahasa formal, objektif, dan hedging yang tepat dengan 'suggest'.

quiz.question:
Identify the appropriate reporting verb for a strong, confident claim by a researcher:
Dr. Taylor makes a definitive statement about causation in her paper.
options: Dr. Taylor (2025) hints that there might possibly be some kind of relationship.
Dr. Taylor (2025) argues that the intervention directly caused the observed behavioral changes.
Dr. Taylor (2025) thinks maybe it could be related.
quiz.answer: Dr. Taylor (2025) argues that the intervention directly caused the observed behavioral changes.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'argues' cocok untuk klaim yang kuat dan percaya diri. Opsi lain terlalu lemah ('hints', 'possibly', 'thinks maybe') yang tidak sesuai jika peneliti membuat pernyataan definitif tentang kausalitas.

quiz.question:
Which sentence correctly uses nominalization for academic formality?
You need to describe the process of implementing a new teaching method.
options: When we implemented the new method, students performed better and we were happy with the results.
The implementation of the new pedagogical approach resulted in enhanced student performance outcomes.
We did the new teaching thing and kids did good on their tests so it worked great.
quiz.answer: The implementation of the new pedagogical approach resulted in enhanced student performance outcomes.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan nominalisasi ('implementation', 'approach', 'outcomes') yang membuat tulisan lebih formal dan objektif. Menghindari kata ganti orang pertama dan bahasa kasual. Opsi lain terlalu personal atau informal untuk penulisan akademik.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan B2.2: Evaluasi Komprehensif Keberfasihan Profesional & Akademik
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level B2.3

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan B2.2 ini mengukur kemampuan komprehensif Anda dalam empat keterampilan bahasa: mendengarkan percakapan bisnis kompleks tentang negosiasi dan manajemen krisis, membaca artikel akademik tentang AI dan bioetika, menulis dengan struktur gramatikal tingkat lanjut (inversion, subjunctive, causative, participle clauses), dan berbicara dalam konteks debat eksekutif. Ujian ini dirancang untuk memastikan Anda siap menggunakan bahasa Inggris dalam situasi profesional dan akademik yang menuntut presisi, diplomasi, dan pemikiran kritis.
rules: Inversion: Struktur inversi digunakan untuk penekanan formal. Formula: Negative adverb + auxiliary + subject + main verb. Contoh: 'Never have I seen such dedication.' / 'Rarely does the board approve this quickly.'

Subjunctive Mood: Digunakan dalam klausa noun setelah verb/adjective yang menyatakan permintaan, saran, atau keharusan. Formula: Subject + verb (insist/suggest/demand) + that + subject + base verb. Contoh: 'The CEO insists that every manager attend the meeting.' / 'It is essential that he be informed immediately.'

Causative Structures: Menyatakan seseorang menyebabkan orang lain melakukan sesuatu. Formula: Have/Get + object + past participle (passive) atau base verb/infinitive (active). Contoh: 'We had the system upgraded.' / 'She got them to reconsider the proposal.'

Participle Clauses: Menggantikan klausa relatif atau adverbial untuk efisiensi. Formula: Present/Past participle + complement, main clause. Contoh: 'Having reviewed the data, the committee made a decision.' / 'Faced with criticism, the company revised its policy.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dalam Struktur Tingkat Lanjut
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa B2 sering salah dalam urutan inversi atau lupa menggunakan base form verb dalam subjunctive mood. Mereka juga sering mencampur causative 'have' dan 'get' tanpa memahami perbedaan nuansanya.
commonTrap.wrong: Never I have seen such a crisis. / The board demands that he goes immediately. / We had them installing the software.
commonTrap.correct: Never have I seen such a crisis. / The board demands that he go immediately. / We had them install the software.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah dari kalimat berikut yang menggunakan struktur inversi (inversion) untuk penekanan formal dengan benar?
options: Rarely the board approves this quickly.
Rarely does the board approve this quickly.
Rarely the board does approve this quickly.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur inversi memerlukan kata kerja bantu (auxiliary verb) seperti 'does' diletakkan sebelum subjek setelah kata keterangan negatif (Rarely).

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar dalam penggunaan subjunctive mood setelah kata kerja yang menyatakan tuntutan (insist)?
options: The manager insists that she attends the meeting.
The manager insists that she attend the meeting.
The manager insists that she to attend the meeting.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Setelah kata kerja seperti 'insist', klausa 'that' harus menggunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja (base form) tanpa akhiran -s atau -es, terlepas dari subjeknya.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi kalimat berikut untuk menunjukkan tindakan yang diminta kepada tim: 'We need to [...] before the press conference starts.'
options: have our PR team prepare the statement
have our PR team to prepare the statement
get our PR team prepared the statement
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur causative 'have' + object + base verb (active) digunakan untuk menyatakan seseorang menyebabkan orang lain melakukan sesuatu. Opsi lain salah karena penggunaan 'to' atau bentuk kata kerja yang tidak tepat.

vocab.collocation: The negotiation broke down after both parties failed to reach a compromise on the budget allocation.
All stakeholders must be consulted before we implement the new compliance framework.
The committee on bioethics raised concerns about the implications of genetic modification in humans.

vocab.meaning: belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya, tanpa preseden
vocab.collocation: The company faced an unprecedented crisis when the data breach exposed millions of customer records.
Our risk mitigation strategy includes diversifying suppliers and investing in cybersecurity infrastructure.
Public sentiment has shifted dramatically against the use of artificial intelligence in hiring decisions.
We plan to deploy the new software across all departments by the end of the quarter.
The startup successfully leveraged social media platforms to build brand awareness rapidly.
Establishing clear lines of accountability is crucial when managing cross-functional teams.
Granting employees greater autonomy in decision-making has been shown to improve innovation and job satisfaction.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara seorang Chief Operating Officer (COO) dan seorang Crisis Management Consultant yang sedang membahas strategi penanganan krisis reputasi perusahaan setelah insiden keamanan data.

lines.speaker: Margaret Chen (COO)
lines.text: Thank you for coming on such short notice. As you're aware, we're facing an unprecedented situation. The data breach has affected over 200,000 customers, and public sentiment is turning against us rapidly.
lines.translation: Terima kasih telah datang dengan pemberitahuan yang begitu singkat. Seperti yang Anda tahu, kami menghadapi situasi yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Pelanggaran data telah memengaruhi lebih dari 200.000 pelanggan, dan sentimen publik berbalik melawan kami dengan cepat.

lines.speaker: David Park (Consultant)
lines.text: I understand the gravity of the situation, Margaret. Never have I seen a crisis escalate this quickly in the financial sector. What mitigation measures have you implemented so far?
lines.translation: Saya memahami keseriusan situasinya, Margaret. Tidak pernah saya melihat krisis meningkat secepat ini di sektor keuangan. Langkah mitigasi apa yang telah Anda terapkan sejauh ini?

lines.speaker: Margaret Chen
lines.text: We've had our legal team draft a comprehensive statement, and we're offering affected customers two years of credit monitoring. However, the board insists that we take more proactive steps to restore trust.
lines.translation: Kami telah meminta tim hukum kami menyusun pernyataan komprehensif, dan kami menawarkan pemantauan kredit selama dua tahun kepada pelanggan yang terkena dampak. Namun, dewan bersikeras agar kami mengambil langkah lebih proaktif untuk memulihkan kepercayaan.

lines.speaker: David Park
lines.text: That's a good start, but I'd recommend you get your communications team to deploy a multi-channel transparency campaign immediately. It's crucial that stakeholders see you're taking full accountability.
lines.translation: Itu awal yang baik, tetapi saya sarankan Anda meminta tim komunikasi Anda menerapkan kampanye transparansi multi-saluran segera. Sangat penting bahwa para pemangku kepentingan melihat Anda mengambil akuntabilitas penuh.

lines.speaker: Margaret Chen
lines.text: We're prepared to do that. Having consulted with our PR advisors, we believe a press conference within 48 hours would demonstrate our commitment to transparency. What's your take on timing?
lines.translation: Kami siap melakukan itu. Setelah berkonsultasi dengan penasihat PR kami, kami yakin konferensi pers dalam 48 jam akan menunjukkan komitmen kami terhadap transparansi. Bagaimana pendapat Anda tentang waktu pelaksanaannya?

lines.speaker: David Park
lines.text: Timing is critical. Not only should you address the media, but I also suggest you leverage your executive leadership to engage directly with affected customers through town hall sessions. This shows genuine concern beyond corporate messaging.
lines.translation: Waktu pelaksanaan sangat kritis. Tidak hanya Anda harus berbicara kepada media, tetapi saya juga menyarankan Anda memanfaatkan kepemimpinan eksekutif Anda untuk terlibat langsung dengan pelanggan yang terkena dampak melalui sesi town hall. Ini menunjukkan kepedulian tulus di luar pesan korporat.

lines.speaker: Margaret Chen
lines.text: That makes sense. Rarely do we see executives taking such direct action, but given the severity, I agree it's necessary. Let's schedule an emergency board meeting to formalize this strategy.
lines.translation: Itu masuk akal. Jarang kita melihat eksekutif mengambil tindakan langsung seperti itu, tetapi mengingat tingkat keparahannya, saya setuju ini diperlukan. Mari kita jadwalkan rapat dewan darurat untuk meresmikan strategi ini.

lines.speaker: David Park
lines.text: Excellent. I'll prepare a detailed crisis response framework for the board. The key is demonstrating that you've learned from this incident and are implementing systemic changes to prevent recurrence.
lines.translation: Bagus sekali. Saya akan menyiapkan kerangka kerja respons krisis yang terperinci untuk dewan. Kuncinya adalah menunjukkan bahwa Anda telah belajar dari insiden ini dan menerapkan perubahan sistemik untuk mencegah terulangnya.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang Product Manager yang sedang menjalani simulasi debat eksekutif bersama Mr. Khoirul tentang keputusan peluncuran produk AI kontroversial. Anda harus membela proposal Anda dengan argumen yang logis, mengantisipasi keberatan, dan menunjukkan kemampuan diplomasi dalam negosiasi tingkat tinggi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon. I've reviewed your proposal to deploy the AI-powered recruitment system across all divisions. While the technology is impressive, I have significant concerns about the ethical implications. How do you respond to critics who argue that such systems perpetuate bias?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Khoirul. I appreciate your concern. Our team has conducted extensive bias audits, and we've implemented multiple safeguards. Not only have we trained the AI on diverse datasets, but we've also built in human oversight at critical decision points.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's reassuring, but what about accountability? If the system makes a discriminatory decision, who bears responsibility? The board insists that we have clear lines of accountability before any deployment.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Absolutely. We propose that the hiring manager retains final authority on all decisions. The AI serves as a recommendation tool, not the decision-maker. Should any concerns arise, we have a transparent audit trail that documents every stage of the process.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. However, some stakeholders worry that leveraging AI in hiring could damage our reputation, especially given recent controversies in the industry. How would you mitigate this reputational risk?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We've developed a comprehensive communication strategy. We plan to publish a transparency report detailing our methodology and safeguards. Additionally, we'll establish an ethics committee to review the system quarterly. This proactive approach demonstrates our commitment to responsible AI deployment.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Those are strong points. One final question: Given the investment required and the potential risks, why should we proceed now rather than waiting for the technology to mature further?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Timing is crucial. Our competitors are already implementing similar systems, and delaying puts us at a strategic disadvantage. Moreover, by being early adopters with strong ethical frameworks, we position ourselves as industry leaders in responsible AI. The risk of inaction may be greater than the risk of thoughtful implementation.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Our projections indicate that unless we secure additional funding within the next quarter, we'll be forced to scale back operations significantly. The board has made it clear that they expect a detailed contingency plan by Friday. Never before have we faced such pressure from investors.' What is the speaker's main concern?
options: The company has too many investors
The company needs funding urgently to avoid operational cutbacks
The board is planning to replace management
quiz.answer: The company needs funding urgently to avoid operational cutbacks
quiz.explanation: Pembicara dengan jelas menyatakan bahwa tanpa pendanaan tambahan dalam kuartal berikutnya, mereka akan dipaksa untuk mengurangi operasi secara signifikan. Ini menunjukkan kebutuhan mendesak akan dana untuk menghindari pemotongan operasional. Pilihan lain tidak mencerminkan kekhawatiran utama yang disampaikan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'During the negotiation, we had the legal team review every clause before proceeding. It became apparent that the other party was not willing to compromise on intellectual property rights. Faced with this impasse, we decided to propose a licensing arrangement instead.' What action did the speaker's team take?
options: They agreed to give up intellectual property rights
They proposed a licensing arrangement as an alternative
They hired a new legal team
quiz.answer: They proposed a licensing arrangement as an alternative
quiz.explanation: Teks audio dengan jelas menyebutkan bahwa ketika menghadapi kebuntuan mengenai hak kekayaan intelektual, tim pembicara memutuskan untuk mengusulkan pengaturan lisensi sebagai alternatif. Ini menunjukkan strategi negosiasi yang fleksibel ketika menghadapi hambatan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'The crisis management team insisted that we deploy social media monitoring tools immediately. Little did we know that the negative sentiment would spread so rapidly. Within hours, we were trending on multiple platforms, and our customer service lines were overwhelmed.' What happened after the social media monitoring tools were deployed?
options: The negative sentiment was successfully contained
Negative sentiment spread rapidly and overwhelmed customer service
The company's social media accounts were shut down
quiz.answer: Negative sentiment spread rapidly and overwhelmed customer service
quiz.explanation: Pembicara menjelaskan bahwa meskipun alat pemantauan media sosial telah diterapkan, sentimen negatif menyebar dengan cepat. Dalam hitungan jam, mereka menjadi trending di berbagai platform dan jalur layanan pelanggan mereka kewalahan. Ini menunjukkan bahwa situasi memburuk dengan cepat meskipun ada tindakan mitigasi.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Having analyzed the market trends, our research team concluded that consumer preferences are shifting toward sustainable products. The CEO demands that every department incorporate sustainability metrics into their quarterly objectives. This represents a fundamental shift in our corporate strategy.' What does the CEO require?
options: Every department must hire sustainability consultants
Every department must include sustainability metrics in quarterly objectives
All products must be discontinued immediately
quiz.answer: Every department must include sustainability metrics in quarterly objectives
quiz.explanation: CEO dengan jelas menuntut (demands) bahwa setiap departemen memasukkan metrik keberlanjutan ke dalam tujuan kuartalan mereka. Perhatikan penggunaan subjunctive mood 'incorporate' (bukan 'incorporates') setelah 'demands that', yang menunjukkan permintaan atau perintah formal.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Artificial intelligence is transforming healthcare in unprecedented ways. Machine learning algorithms can now analyze medical images with accuracy rivaling experienced radiologists. However, bioethics experts warn that algorithmic decision-making raises questions about accountability. Should an AI system misdiagnose a patient, determining liability becomes complex. Furthermore, the autonomy of medical professionals may be compromised if they become overly reliant on AI recommendations.' According to the passage, what concern do bioethics experts have about AI in healthcare?
options: AI is too expensive for hospitals to implement
Accountability becomes unclear when AI systems make errors
AI cannot analyze medical images accurately
quiz.answer: Accountability becomes unclear when AI systems make errors
quiz.explanation: Teks dengan jelas menyatakan bahwa para ahli bioetika memperingatkan bahwa pengambilan keputusan algoritmik menimbulkan pertanyaan tentang akuntabilitas, dan bahwa menentukan tanggung jawab menjadi kompleks jika sistem AI salah mendiagnosis pasien. Ini adalah kekhawatiran utama yang diidentifikasi dalam bacaan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'The debate over genetic modification in agriculture continues to divide scientists and policymakers. Proponents argue that genetically modified crops can address food security challenges by increasing yields and enhancing nutritional content. Critics, however, contend that insufficient research exists regarding long-term environmental impacts. Moreover, they question whether corporations should have the authority to patent living organisms, raising fundamental questions about the commodification of nature.' What is the critics' main argument against genetic modification?
options: Genetically modified crops taste worse than natural crops
There is insufficient research on long-term environmental impacts
quiz.answer: There is insufficient research on long-term environmental impacts
quiz.explanation: Kritikus menyatakan bahwa penelitian yang tidak memadai ada mengenai dampak lingkungan jangka panjang dari modifikasi genetik. Ini adalah argumen utama mereka terhadap teknologi ini, seperti yang dijelaskan dalam bacaan. Pilihan lain tidak didukung oleh teks.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Blockchain technology promises to revolutionize supply chain management by providing unprecedented transparency and traceability. Each transaction is recorded in an immutable ledger, making it nearly impossible to falsify records. Companies leveraging blockchain can verify the authenticity of products from origin to consumer, significantly reducing counterfeit goods. Nevertheless, implementing blockchain requires substantial initial investment and technical expertise, creating barriers for smaller enterprises.' What advantage does blockchain offer for supply chain management?
options: It reduces the cost of products significantly
It provides transparency and makes falsifying records nearly impossible
It eliminates the need for technical expertise
It guarantees that all products will sell faster
quiz.answer: It provides transparency and makes falsifying records nearly impossible
quiz.explanation: Teks menjelaskan bahwa blockchain memberikan transparansi yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya dan keterlacakan, dengan setiap transaksi dicatat dalam buku besar yang tidak dapat diubah, sehingga hampir tidak mungkin untuk memalsukan catatan. Ini adalah keunggulan utama yang disebutkan untuk manajemen rantai pasokan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'The concept of corporate social responsibility (CSR) has evolved significantly. Whereas companies once viewed CSR as peripheral to core business operations, leading organizations now integrate social and environmental considerations into strategic planning. This shift reflects changing stakeholder expectations and growing recognition that sustainable practices can enhance long-term profitability. However, critics argue that some CSR initiatives amount to little more than public relations exercises, lacking genuine commitment to systemic change.' How has the view of CSR changed according to the passage?
options: Companies now see CSR as separate from business operations
Leading organizations now integrate CSR into strategic planning
CSR is only about public relations
quiz.answer: Leading organizations now integrate CSR into strategic planning
quiz.explanation: Bacaan menjelaskan bahwa sementara perusahaan dulu memandang CSR sebagai periferal terhadap operasi bisnis inti, organisasi terkemuka sekarang mengintegrasikan pertimbangan sosial dan lingkungan ke dalam perencanaan strategis. Ini menunjukkan perubahan signifikan dalam pendekatan terhadap CSR.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Rewrite using inversion: 'We have rarely encountered such a complex regulatory environment.'
options: Rarely we have encountered such a complex regulatory environment.
Rarely have we encountered such a complex regulatory environment.
We rarely have encountered such a complex regulatory environment.
Rarely encountered we have such a complex regulatory environment.
quiz.answer: Rarely have we encountered such a complex regulatory environment.
quiz.explanation: Struktur inversi yang benar dengan negative adverb (rarely) memerlukan urutan: Negative adverb + auxiliary verb (have) + subject (we) + past participle (encountered). Inversi menciptakan penekanan formal dan cocok untuk konteks profesional. Pilihan pertama salah karena tidak menginversi auxiliary dan subject.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete with correct subjunctive form: 'The compliance officer recommends that each manager ___ the updated guidelines immediately.'
quiz.explanation: Setelah verb yang menyatakan saran atau rekomendasi (recommend, suggest, insist, demand), subjunctive mood menggunakan base form verb tanpa -s, bahkan untuk subject singular. Bentuk 'review' (bukan 'reviews') adalah benar karena ini adalah konstruksi subjunctive formal yang umum dalam konteks bisnis dan akademik.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct causative structure: 'The IT department ___ all workstations ___ before the security audit.'
quiz.explanation: Struktur causative 'have something done' menggunakan past participle untuk menunjukkan bahwa subjek menyebabkan orang lain melakukan tindakan kepada objek (passive causative). 'Had all workstations upgraded' berarti departemen IT menyuruh orang lain meng-upgrade workstation tersebut. Ini berbeda dari 'got them to upgrade' yang akan membutuhkan objek orang.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Combine using a participle clause: 'The board reviewed the proposal carefully. The board approved the merger.'
options: The board reviewed the proposal carefully and approved the merger.
Having reviewed the proposal carefully, the board approved the merger.
The board, which reviewed the proposal carefully, approved the merger.
After the board reviewed the proposal carefully, it approved the merger.
quiz.answer: Having reviewed the proposal carefully, the board approved the merger.
quiz.explanation: Participle clause 'Having reviewed' (perfect participle) menunjukkan bahwa tindakan pertama (reviewing) selesai sebelum tindakan kedua (approving). Struktur ini lebih ringkas dan formal dibandingkan klausa relatif atau adverbial penuh, sehingga cocok untuk penulisan profesional dan akademik. Pilihan lain benar secara gramatikal tetapi tidak menggunakan participle clause seperti yang diminta.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You are presenting a controversial policy change to the executive board. A board member challenges: 'This policy seems rushed and poorly researched.' What is the most diplomatic and persuasive response?
options: I disagree completely. We've done extensive research.
I appreciate your concern. Let me walk you through the six-month research process and the data that informed this decision.
That's not true at all. Everyone else on the team supports this.
You clearly haven't read the proposal carefully.
quiz.answer: I appreciate your concern. Let me walk you through the six-month research process and the data that informed this decision.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan diplomasi dengan mengakui kekhawatiran pembicara ('I appreciate your concern'), kemudian menawarkan bukti konkret tanpa bersikap defensif. Pendekatan ini membangun kredibilitas dengan menyebutkan durasi penelitian (enam bulan) dan berkomitmen untuk transparansi. Pilihan lain terlalu konfrontatif atau defensif untuk konteks eksekutif profesional.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] During a negotiation, the other party says: 'Your pricing is completely unreasonable. We can get the same service elsewhere for half the cost.' How should you respond to maintain leverage while staying diplomatic?
options: Then perhaps you should go elsewhere if you think that's better.

I understand price is a concern. However, our value proposition extends beyond cost—we offer 24/7 support, guaranteed uptime, and integration with your existing systems. Could we explore which specific features are most valuable to your organization?
That's impossible. No one can offer our quality at that price.
You're mistaken about the market rates.
quiz.answer: I understand price is a concern. However, our value proposition extends beyond cost—we offer 24/7 support, guaranteed uptime, and integration with your existing systems. Could we explore which specific features are most valuable to your organization?
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan teknik negosiasi profesional: mengakui kekhawatiran, mengalihkan fokus dari harga ke nilai (value-based selling), memberikan diferensiasi spesifik, dan mengajukan pertanyaan yang membuka dialog konstruktif. Ini mempertahankan leverage sambil tetap diplomatis dan berorientasi pada solusi, yang penting dalam negosiasi tingkat eksekutif.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You need to deliver difficult feedback to a senior colleague who has missed multiple deadlines. What is the most effective and professionally appropriate opening?
options: I've noticed a pattern with recent project timelines that I'd like to discuss. Can we talk about what challenges you're facing and how we might address them?
You've been missing too many deadlines. This needs to stop.
Everyone is complaining about your performance lately.
Is everything okay? You seem to be struggling.
quiz.answer: I've noticed a pattern with recent project timelines that I'd like to discuss. Can we talk about what challenges you're facing and how we might address them?
quiz.explanation: Pembukaan ini efektif karena: (1) menggunakan observasi objektif ('a pattern with recent project timelines') bukan serangan personal, (2) menggunakan bahasa inklusif ('we') yang menunjukkan kemitraan, (3) menunjukkan empati dengan bertanya tentang tantangan, dan (4) berorientasi pada solusi. Pendekatan ini mempertahankan hubungan profesional sambil mengatasi masalah kinerja secara langsung.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] In an executive debate, someone presents a counterargument to your proposal. What response demonstrates both confidence and openness to different perspectives?
options: That's an interesting perspective. While I see merit in your concern about implementation costs, our analysis shows the ROI within 18 months offsets this initial investment. However, I'm open to exploring hybrid approaches if that addresses your reservations.
I've already considered that and it's not a valid concern.
Let's agree to disagree on this point.
Maybe you're right. I'll revise my entire proposal.
quiz.answer: That's an interesting perspective. While I see merit in your concern about implementation costs, our analysis shows the ROI within 18 months offsets this initial investment. However, I'm open to exploring hybrid approaches if that addresses your reservations.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan kepemimpinan eksekutif yang matang dengan: (1) mengakui perspektif lawan dengan hormat, (2) menunjukkan bahwa kekhawatiran telah dipertimbangkan dengan data konkret (ROI 18 bulan), (3) mempertahankan posisi dengan percaya diri tetapi tidak kaku, dan (4) menawarkan fleksibilitas dengan solusi alternatif. Ini adalah keseimbangan ideal antara ketegasan dan kolaborasi dalam debat tingkat tinggi.

modules.title: Architectural Philosophy, Urban Planning & Sustainable Megacities
modules.group: B2.3 - Strategic Debate & Bridge to C1
modules.objective: Membahas konsep tata kota megapolitan, zonasi lingkungan, dan estetika arsitektur berkelanjutan.

theory.summary: Modul ini membahas konsep perencanaan kota modern dan arsitektur berkelanjutan. Di level B2, Anda akan belajar mengartikulasikan ide kompleks tentang tata ruang kota, kebijakan zonasi, dan prinsip desain ramah lingkungan menggunakan struktur kalimat yang sophisticated. Fokus utama adalah menguasai kosakata teknis urban planning, memahami conditional sentences untuk mendiskusikan skenario hipotetis pembangunan kota, serta menggunakan passive voice dalam konteks formal untuk menjelaskan regulasi dan proses perencanaan. Anda juga akan berlatih menyampaikan argumentasi terstruktur tentang trade-off antara pertumbuhan ekonomi dan keberlanjutan lingkungan.
rules: Mixed Conditionals untuk Urban Planning: Gunakan kombinasi type 2 dan type 3 untuk mendiskusikan konsekuensi keputusan perencanaan. Formula: 'If + past perfect, would/could + base verb' atau 'If + past simple, would have + past participle'. Contoh: 'If the city had implemented zoning regulations earlier, we wouldn't be facing such severe traffic congestion now.'

Passive Voice dalam Konteks Teknis: Gunakan passive constructions untuk menjelaskan proses dan regulasi secara objektif. Formula: 'be + past participle (+ by agent)'. Contoh: 'Green spaces are integrated into the urban fabric to mitigate heat island effects.' atau 'The proposal was rejected by the planning commission due to environmental concerns.'

Nominal Phrases untuk Presisi Teknis: Gunakan noun phrases yang kompleks dengan premodifiers dan postmodifiers untuk mendeskripsikan konsep arsitektur. Formula: 'determiner + adjective(s) + noun + prepositional phrase/relative clause'. Contoh: 'The ambitious retrofitting program aimed at reducing carbon emissions' atau 'A comprehensive master plan that prioritizes pedestrian accessibility'.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan dalam Collocations Urban Planning
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa B2 sering salah menggunakan verb-noun collocations dalam konteks perencanaan kota. Kata 'implement', 'enforce', 'adopt', dan 'carry out' memiliki nuansa berbeda yang harus dipahami. 'Implement' digunakan untuk kebijakan dan rencana, 'enforce' untuk regulasi dan hukum, 'adopt' untuk strategi atau pendekatan baru, sementara 'carry out' untuk penelitian atau survei.
commonTrap.wrong: The government enforced a new urban development strategy last year.
commonTrap.correct: The government adopted a new urban development strategy last year and is now implementing it across all districts.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang benar menggunakan Mixed Conditional untuk mendiskusikan konsekuensi keputusan perencanaan kota di masa lalu terhadap kondisi saat ini?
options: If the city had invested in public transport years ago, we wouldn't be dealing with such severe traffic congestion today.
If the city invested in public transport years ago, we wouldn't have dealt with traffic congestion.
If the city had invested in public transport years ago, we would have dealt with traffic congestion.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan Mixed Conditional (If + past perfect, would + base verb) yang tepat untuk menghubungkan aksi di masa lalu (investasi transportasi) dengan situasi saat ini (kemacetan).

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan verb-noun collocation yang tepat untuk konteks kebijakan kota.
options: The city council decided to enforce a new sustainability strategy to reduce carbon emissions.
The city council decided to adopt a new sustainability strategy and is now implementing it across the metropolitan area.
The city council decided to carry out a new sustainability strategy to reduce carbon emissions.
readinessQuestions.explanation: 'Adopt' digunakan untuk strategi baru, dan 'implement' digunakan untuk menjalankan kebijakan tersebut. 'Enforce' biasanya untuk hukum/regulasi, sedangkan 'carry out' untuk riset atau survei.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi dialog berikut: Prof. Chen: 'Your proposal for vertical densification is ambitious. How will you ensure the infrastructure supports it?' Sarah: '[...]'
options: We've integrated a transit-oriented development plan that ensures all high-density zones are within walking distance of public transport hubs.
We are planning to sprawl the city outward to ensure that everyone has enough space to build their own private gardens.
The current zoning regulations are too strict, so we will ignore them to build as high as we want.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Jawaban ini paling relevan dengan konsep densifikasi vertikal yang dibahas dalam modul, yaitu mengintegrasikan transportasi publik untuk mendukung kepadatan tinggi, berbeda dengan 'sprawl' (perluasan kota).

vocab.meaning: renovasi atau modifikasi bangunan lama dengan teknologi modern
vocab.collocation: The city council approved a large-scale retrofitting initiative to improve energy efficiency in older residential buildings.

vocab.meaning: pembagian area kota berdasarkan fungsi tertentu (residensial, komersial, industri)
vocab.collocation: Strict zoning regulations prevent industrial facilities from being built near residential neighborhoods.

vocab.meaning: perluasan kota yang tidak terkendali ke area pinggiran
vocab.collocation: Urban sprawl has led to increased reliance on private vehicles and longer commute times.

vocab.meaning: fasilitas atau fitur yang meningkatkan kenyamanan hidup
vocab.collocation: The new development includes various amenities such as parks, community centers, and cycling paths.

vocab.meaning: peningkatan kepadatan bangunan atau populasi di suatu area
vocab.collocation: Strategic densification around transit hubs can reduce car dependency and support public transportation.

vocab.meaning: jalur hijau yang menghubungkan habitat alami untuk mendukung kehidupan satwa
vocab.collocation: The master plan incorporates biodiversity corridors to allow wildlife movement between fragmented green spaces.

vocab.meaning: kawasan yang menggabungkan fungsi residensial, komersial, dan rekreasi
vocab.collocation: Mixed-use developments promote walkability by integrating shops, offices, and apartments in the same area.

vocab.meaning: total emisi gas rumah kaca yang dihasilkan oleh aktivitas tertentu
vocab.collocation: The city aims to reduce its carbon footprint by 40% through sustainable building practices and renewable energy.

vocab.meaning: proses perubahan area menjadi lebih mewah yang menggeser penduduk berpenghasilan rendah
vocab.collocation: Critics argue that the urban renewal project may trigger gentrification and displace long-time residents.

vocab.meaning: permukaan yang dapat menyerap air untuk mencegah banjir
vocab.collocation: Installing permeable surfaces in parking lots helps manage stormwater runoff and replenish groundwater.

dialogue.context: Sarah, seorang arsitek muda, sedang berdiskusi dengan Prof. Chen, pakar perencanaan kota, tentang proposal proyek revitalisasi kawasan pusat kota yang berkelanjutan.

lines.speaker: Prof. Chen
lines.text: Sarah, I've reviewed your proposal for the downtown revitalization. The concept of creating a biodiversity corridor through the commercial district is quite innovative. How do you plan to balance this with the need for densification?
lines.translation: Sarah, saya sudah meninjau proposal Anda untuk revitalisasi pusat kota. Konsep menciptakan koridor biodiversitas melalui distrik komersial cukup inovatif. Bagaimana Anda berencana menyeimbangkan ini dengan kebutuhan densifikasi?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Thank you, Professor. I believe we can achieve both through vertical mixed-use development. By building upward rather than outward, we can increase density while preserving ground-level green spaces that serve as ecological corridors.
lines.translation: Terima kasih, Professor. Saya percaya kita bisa mencapai keduanya melalui pembangunan vertikal multifungsi. Dengan membangun ke atas, bukan ke samping, kita dapat meningkatkan kepadatan sambil melestarikan ruang hijau di permukaan tanah yang berfungsi sebagai koridor ekologis.

lines.speaker: Prof. Chen
lines.text: That's a sound approach. However, have you considered the implications for existing zoning regulations? The current codes may not permit the density levels you're proposing.
lines.translation: Itu pendekatan yang masuk akal. Namun, apakah Anda sudah mempertimbangkan implikasi terhadap regulasi zonasi yang ada? Peraturan saat ini mungkin tidak mengizinkan tingkat kepadatan yang Anda usulkan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, that's actually addressed in section three. I'm proposing an overlay zone that would allow for increased density in exchange for environmental amenities like green roofs, permeable surfaces, and public access to ground-level gardens.
lines.translation: Ya, itu sebenarnya dibahas di bagian tiga. Saya mengusulkan zona overlay yang memungkinkan peningkatan kepadatan sebagai imbalan untuk amenitas lingkungan seperti atap hijau, permukaan permeabel, dan akses publik ke taman permukaan tanah.

lines.speaker: Prof. Chen
lines.text: Interesting. But won't this kind of development trigger gentrification? We've seen this pattern in other cities where sustainable retrofitting inadvertently displaces lower-income residents.
lines.translation: Menarik. Tapi bukankah pembangunan seperti ini akan memicu gentrifikasi? Kita sudah melihat pola ini di kota-kota lain di mana retrofitting berkelanjutan secara tidak sengaja menggeser penduduk berpenghasilan rendah.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're absolutely right to raise that concern. That's why I've included an affordable housing requirement and a community land trust model. If we had ignored the social dimension, the project would have failed its sustainability goals entirely.
lines.translation: Anda benar sekali mengangkat kekhawatiran itu. Itulah mengapa saya menyertakan persyaratan perumahan terjangkau dan model community land trust. Jika kita mengabaikan dimensi sosial, proyek ini akan gagal total dalam tujuan keberlanjutannya.

lines.speaker: Prof. Chen
lines.text: Excellent. One last question—how will you address urban sprawl prevention? Your focus seems primarily on the downtown core.
lines.translation: Bagus sekali. Satu pertanyaan terakhir—bagaimana Anda akan menangani pencegahan urban sprawl? Fokus Anda tampaknya terutama pada inti pusat kota.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: The proposal is actually part of a broader city strategy. By making the downtown more livable and reducing its carbon footprint, we create a model that can be replicated in other neighborhoods, reducing pressure for outward expansion. The goal is to demonstrate that sustainable densification is both viable and desirable.
lines.translation: Proposal ini sebenarnya bagian dari strategi kota yang lebih luas. Dengan membuat pusat kota lebih layak huni dan mengurangi jejak karbonnya, kita menciptakan model yang dapat direplikasi di lingkungan lain, mengurangi tekanan untuk ekspansi ke luar. Tujuannya adalah menunjukkan bahwa densifikasi berkelanjutan itu layak dan diinginkan.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang konsultan perencanaan kota yang sedang mempresentasikan ide kepada Mr. Khoirul, yang berperan sebagai kepala dewan perencanaan kota. Diskusikan proposal Anda untuk mengubah zona industri tua menjadi kawasan berkelanjutan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning! I understand you have a proposal for redeveloping the old industrial zone on the east side. What's your vision for that area?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning! Yes, I propose transforming it into a mixed-use sustainable district. The key is retrofitting existing structures rather than demolishing them, which reduces our carbon footprint significantly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Retrofitting sounds cost-effective, but those buildings are decades old. How would you ensure they meet modern environmental standards?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We'd implement comprehensive energy upgrades including solar panels, improved insulation, and rainwater harvesting systems with permeable surfaces for stormwater management. The industrial aesthetic can actually become a design feature.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. What about zoning? Currently, it's designated for industrial use only. Changing that requires community input and can be politically challenging.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's why I'm suggesting a phased approach. We'd start with an overlay zone allowing creative studios and light commercial uses, then gradually introduce residential units. This prevents sudden gentrification while building community support.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting strategy. How does your plan address the broader issue of urban sprawl that our city is experiencing?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: By creating an attractive, high-amenity district close to the city center, we reduce the demand for suburban development. Strategic densification here means we can preserve green spaces on the city's periphery and establish biodiversity corridors.

quiz.question: If the city ___ stricter zoning regulations ten years ago, we wouldn't be dealing with such chaotic urban sprawl today.
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah mixed conditional yang menggabungkan kondisi masa lalu (type 3) dengan hasil di masa sekarang (type 2). Karena membahas kondisi di masa lalu yang tidak terjadi ('ten years ago'), kita gunakan past perfect 'had implemented'. Hasilnya menggunakan 'would + be dealing' karena merujuk ke situasi sekarang. Formula: If + past perfect, would + base verb (present result).

quiz.question: The new master plan includes several environmental ___ such as rooftop gardens, cycling infrastructure, and community green spaces.
quiz.explanation: 'Amenities' adalah kata yang tepat untuk mendeskripsikan fitur-fitur yang meningkatkan kualitas hidup dan kenyamanan di suatu area. 'Facilities' terlalu umum dan biasanya merujuk pada bangunan fisik seperti sekolah atau rumah sakit. 'Utilities' merujuk pada layanan dasar seperti air, listrik, dan gas. Dalam konteks perencanaan kota, 'amenities' mencakup fitur-fitur yang membuat area lebih menarik dan layak huni.

quiz.question: Green roofs and permeable parking lots ___ throughout the district to manage stormwater runoff and reduce flooding risks.
quiz.explanation: Passive voice dalam present continuous ('are being installed') adalah pilihan tepat karena fokusnya pada tindakan yang sedang dilakukan terhadap objek (green roofs dan permeable parking lots), bukan siapa yang melakukannya. Ini adalah struktur umum dalam konteks teknis dan formal untuk menjelaskan proses implementasi. 'Have installed' adalah active voice dan memerlukan subjek pelaku, sementara 'are installing' juga active dan tidak tepat karena subjek kalimat adalah objek yang dipasang, bukan yang memasang.

quiz.question: Critics worry that the urban renewal project may accelerate ___ and force long-time residents to move due to rising property costs.
quiz.explanation: 'Gentrification' adalah proses di mana area yang dulunya terjangkau menjadi lebih mahal dan eksklusif, mengakibatkan perpindahan penduduk berpenghasilan rendah. Ini sesuai dengan konteks 'rising property costs' dan 'force residents to move'. 'Densification' hanya berarti peningkatan kepadatan tanpa konotasi perpindahan sosial-ekonomi. 'Sprawl' adalah ekspansi kota ke luar, yang merupakan kebalikan dari konteks urban renewal di area yang sudah ada.

quiz.question: The proposal recommends ___ a comprehensive biodiversity corridor that connects fragmented green spaces across the metropolitan area.
quiz.explanation: 'Establishing' (mendirikan/membentuk) adalah verb yang tepat untuk menciptakan sesuatu yang baru seperti koridor biodiversitas. 'Enforcing' digunakan untuk regulasi atau hukum yang perlu ditegakkan, bukan untuk membuat infrastruktur fisik. 'Adopting' lebih cocok untuk mengambil kebijakan atau strategi yang sudah ada, bukan menciptakan sesuatu yang fisik dan baru. Dalam konteks perencanaan kota, kita 'establish corridors', 'enforce regulations', dan 'adopt policies'.

modules.title: Cleft Sentences for Rhetorical Precision & Thematic Highlighting
modules.group: B2.3 - Strategic Debate & Bridge to C1
modules.objective: Menggunakan cleft sentences (It is... that, What we need is..., All they wanted was...) untuk penekanan retoris.

theory.summary: Cleft sentences adalah struktur kalimat yang digunakan untuk memberikan penekanan retoris pada informasi tertentu. Dalam debat, presentasi, atau argumentasi level B2-C1, struktur ini membantu Anda mengarahkan perhatian audiens ke poin yang paling penting. Ada tiga tipe utama: It-cleft (memfokuskan elemen spesifik), Wh-cleft (menekankan tindakan atau kebutuhan), dan All-cleft (membatasi fokus hanya pada satu hal). Struktur ini sangat efektif untuk persuasi karena menempatkan informasi kunci di posisi yang menonjol secara gramatikal.
rules: It-cleft: It + be + fokus + that/who + sisa kalimat. Contoh: 'It was the CEO who approved the budget' (bukan orang lain). Pola ini memecah kalimat biasa untuk menonjolkan satu elemen.

Wh-cleft: What/All + clause + be + fokus. Contoh: 'What we need is transparency' atau 'All they wanted was recognition'. Struktur ini menempatkan informasi baru atau penting di akhir kalimat untuk dampak maksimal.
Pseudo-cleft terbalik: Fokus + be + what + clause. Contoh: 'Transparency is what we need'. Variasi ini menempatkan fokus di awal untuk penekanan langsung, cocok untuk konteks formal dan akademis.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Verb 'Be' dan Tense
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa level B2 lupa menyesuaikan bentuk 'be' dalam cleft sentence dengan waktu kalimat asli. It-cleft harus mencerminkan tense yang sesuai dengan konteks, dan wh-cleft memerlukan kecocokan subject-verb agreement yang tepat.
commonTrap.wrong: It is in 2019 that we launched the product. What he need is more time.
commonTrap.correct: It was in 2019 that we launched the product. What he needs is more time.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang menggunakan struktur It-cleft dengan benar untuk memberikan penekanan pada subjek?
options: It was the marketing team who designed this campaign.
It the marketing team who designed this campaign.
It was designed this campaign by the marketing team.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Struktur It-cleft yang benar adalah 'It + be + fokus + who/that + sisa kalimat'. Opsi pertama memenuhi aturan ini. Opsi kedua salah karena tidak ada kata kerja 'be', dan opsi ketiga salah karena struktur kalimat pasif yang tidak tepat.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang benar secara tata bahasa untuk menekankan kebutuhan subjek dalam Wh-cleft sentence.
options: What he need is more time to finish the project.
What he needs is more time to finish the project.
What he needs are more time to finish the project.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi kedua benar karena 'What' (singular) memerlukan 'is' dan kata kerja 'needs' (singular) sesuai dengan subjek 'he'. Opsi pertama salah karena 'need' tidak sesuai dengan subjek 'he'. Opsi ketiga salah karena 'time' adalah uncountable noun, sehingga harus menggunakan 'is', bukan 'are'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan berikut untuk menekankan bahwa kualitas produk adalah hal yang paling penting bagi pelanggan: 'Customer: The price is high, but I don't mind. [...]'
options: What matters to me is the product quality.
It is the product quality that matter to me.
It is the product quality what matters to me.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi pertama menggunakan Wh-cleft yang benar (What + clause + be + fokus). Opsi kedua salah karena subjek 'product quality' tunggal memerlukan kata kerja 'matters'. Opsi ketiga salah karena penggunaan 'what' setelah 'that' tidak diperlukan dan tidak gramatikal.

vocab.collocation: The report places great emphasis on sustainability and long-term growth strategies.

vocab.meaning: retoris, berkaitan dengan seni persuasi dalam berbicara atau menulis
vocab.collocation: Her rhetorical skills made the presentation incredibly convincing and memorable.
What the shareholders demand is complete transparency in financial reporting.
It was the CEO's pivotal decision that saved the company from bankruptcy.
What stakeholders expect is regular updates and meaningful engagement.
All they asked for was greater accountability from the leadership team.
It was her compelling evidence that convinced the board to change direction.
That is precisely what we've been trying to achieve for the past year.
What undermines trust most is inconsistency between words and actions.

vocab.meaning: integritas, kejujuran dan prinsip moral yang kuat
vocab.collocation: It is integrity that distinguishes truly great leaders from merely competent ones.

dialogue.context: Diskusi antara dua analis bisnis yang sedang membahas faktor kunci kesuksesan sebuah startup teknologi yang baru-baru ini berkembang pesat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I've been analyzing TechVision's rapid growth. What really stands out is their user retention rate.
lines.translation: Saya telah menganalisis pertumbuhan cepat TechVision. Yang benar-benar menonjol adalah tingkat retensi pengguna mereka.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Agreed, but it was their pivot to B2B services that actually saved the company in 2024.
lines.translation: Setuju, tapi perubahan strategi mereka ke layanan B2B-lah yang sebenarnya menyelamatkan perusahaan di tahun 2024.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's true. What investors appreciated most was the transparency in their quarterly reports.
lines.translation: Itu benar. Yang paling dihargai investor adalah transparansi dalam laporan kuartalan mereka.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Precisely. It wasn't just the numbers that impressed them—it was the CEO's willingness to acknowledge challenges openly.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Bukan hanya angka-angkanya yang mengesankan mereka—tetapi kesediaan CEO untuk mengakui tantangan secara terbuka.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All they needed was someone who could articulate a clear vision. The CEO delivered exactly that.
lines.translation: Yang mereka butuhkan hanyalah seseorang yang bisa mengartikulasikan visi yang jelas. CEO memberikan persis itu.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Right. What we're seeing now is the result of strategic patience and stakeholder alignment.
lines.translation: Benar. Yang kita lihat sekarang adalah hasil dari kesabaran strategis dan penyelarasan pemangku kepentingan.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It is this combination of factors that makes their case study so compelling for our analysis.
lines.translation: Kombinasi faktor-faktor inilah yang membuat studi kasus mereka begitu menarik untuk analisis kita.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Absolutely. What remains to be seen is whether they can maintain this momentum in the next fiscal year.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Yang masih harus dilihat adalah apakah mereka bisa mempertahankan momentum ini di tahun fiskal berikutnya.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih dengan Mr. Khoirul untuk mempersiapkan presentasi bisnis. Mr. Khoirul akan membantu Anda melatih penggunaan cleft sentences untuk memberikan penekanan retoris yang kuat dalam argumen Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice using cleft sentences to make your arguments more persuasive. Let's start with a scenario: You need to explain why your project succeeded. Try using an it-cleft to emphasize the key factor.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Okay. It was our team's dedication that made the project successful, not just the budget we received.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! The emphasis on 'team's dedication' is very clear. Now, imagine you're addressing concerns about transparency. Use a wh-cleft starting with 'What we need is...' to state your solution.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: What we need is complete transparency in our communication with all stakeholders.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! That puts the focus right on 'transparency.' Now, try this: A client says they want many features. Use an all-cleft to narrow down what they truly need.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: All they really need is a reliable system that integrates with their existing infrastructure.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very persuasive! You've successfully simplified their needs. For our final practice, tell me what makes a good leader using a pseudo-cleft structure with 'What makes...' or 'It is... that...'

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It is integrity and accountability that make a truly effective leader, not just technical skills.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Outstanding work! You've mastered all three types of cleft sentences. Your rhetorical precision has improved significantly. Keep using these structures in your presentations!

quiz.question: It ___ the lack of communication that caused the project to fail, not the technical challenges.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'was' karena kita berbicara tentang peristiwa masa lalu (proyek yang gagal). It-cleft harus menggunakan tense yang sesuai dengan waktu kejadian. 'The project failed' adalah past tense, maka 'It was' adalah bentuk yang tepat.

quiz.question: What the investors ___ is detailed financial projections for the next five years.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'want' karena subjek 'the investors' adalah jamak (plural). Dalam wh-cleft, verb harus sesuai dengan subject yang sesungguhnya. Meskipun 'What' di awal kalimat, kita tetap harus melihat siapa yang melakukan aksi—dalam hal ini 'investors' (jamak).

quiz.question: All they needed ___ a clear explanation of the policy changes.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'was' karena yang dibutuhkan adalah satu hal: 'a clear explanation' (singular).
